acceptance/current-build then final shipment evide… <!-- P-006 -->\n## Product shaping\n\n```product-shaping\n{\n  \"audience\": \"Avi and people configuring user-facing workflow automations in Papercusp.\",\n  \"problem\": \"Six trigger mechanisms execute separately, so pause, armed state, rate limits, staleness and dedupe differ even when Workflows displays them together.\",\n  \"outcome\": \"User-facing event, schedule and predicate automations share Trigger/Action/Policy and one durable run ledger, while existing executors and timer infrastructure remain authoritative.\",\n  \"nonGoals\": [\n    \"Re-architect plan-run, goal or blueprint-operation executors.\",\n    \"Change provider ingestion or portable Cupboard trigger-pack ownership.\",\n    \"Replace DBOS or ephemeral timers; migrate infrastructure routines.\"\n  ],\n  \"sourceRefs\": [\n    \"session_turn:claude:ce1b2267-0bb7-4759-94a1-9b049254e2a5:0\",\n    \"session_turn:claude:ce1b2267-0bb7-4759-94a1-9b049254e2a5:10\"\n  ],\n  \"context\": [\n    {\n      \"kind\": \"owner-request\",\n      \"text\": \"Review workflow triggers and draft a consolidation plan; immediate defects and dispatcher re-arm were handled separately.\",\n      \"sourceRefs\": [\n        \"session_turn:claude:ce1b2267-0bb7-4759-94a1-9b049254e2a5:0\",\n        \"session_turn:claude:ce1b2267-0bb7-4759-94a1-9b049254e2a5:10\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"kind\": \"observed-fact\",\n      \"text\": \"Bindings already own a durable outbox, defaults for storm caps and max age, disarm cancellation and existing action executors.\",\n      \"sourceRefs\": [\n        \"file:packages/operator-core/lib/external-triggers/binding-engine.ts\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"kind\": \"observed-fact\",\n      \"text\": \"Plan schedules materialize routine rows; event reactions and predicate watches retain separate dispatch paths; Workflows merges mechanism inputs.\",\n      \"sourceRefs\": [\n        \"file:packages/operator-core/lib/harness/routines/materialize-plan-schedule.ts\",\n        \"file:packages/operator-core/lib/events/durable-exec.ts\",\n        \"file:packages/operator-core/lib/events/await/predicate-watch.ts\",\n        \"file:apps/operator-vite/src/components/adv/workflows-model.ts\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"kind\": \"assumption\",\n      \"text\": \"Keep the draft's infrastructure-routine exclusion: git-sync, checkpoint, GC and system timers remain on their maintained scheduler paths.\",\n      \"recommendation\": \"Inventory and explicitly classify each row before moving user-facing automations.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"kind\": \"assumption\",\n      \"text\": \"Implement per-action spend pause before mechanism migrations, following the draft's proposed order.\",\n      \"recommendation\": \"A pause holds model-spending actions and lets deterministic actions drain; no user pause is silently removed.\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"kind\": \"observed-fact\",\n      \"text\": \"D-001 assigns provider-delivery dedupe retention to the data source and preserves rows when no horizon is configured; D-002 preserves triggers:bind for packs.\",\n      \"sourceRefs\": [\n        \"plan:trigger-automation-consolidation-2026-10-01#D-001\",\n        \"plan:trigger-automation-consolidation-2026-10-01#D-002\"\n      ]\n    }\n  ],\n  \"scenarios\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"SC-001\",\n      \"title\": \"Know what will move\",\n      \"kind\": \"normal\",\n      \"trigger\": \"Consolidation begins\",\n      \"action\": \"Inventory every live/inactive row in the six mechanisms and classify its target and policy\",\n      \"outcome\": \"Every row has a reproducible migration mapping or an explicit infrastructure exclusion.\",\n      \"requirementIds\": [\n        \"R-1\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"SC-002\",\n      \"title\": \"Pause model spend\",\n      \"kind\": \"authorization\",\n      \"trigger\": \"A spend pause is active with queued actions of different spend classes\",\n      \"action\": \"Drain eligible nonspending actions through the common dispatcher\",\n      \"outcome\": \"Spending actions remain held and visible while nonspending actions complete.\",\n      \"requirementIds\": [\n        \"R-2\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"SC-003\",\n      \"title\": \"Scheduled automation fires once\",\n      \"kind\": \"normal\",\n      \"trigger\": \"An armed plan or user-facing blueprint schedule becomes due\",\n      \"action\": \"Existing timers enqueue the scheduled fire into the binding outbox\",\n      \"outcome\": \"One run identity reaches the existing executor; recurrence and overlap policy are retained.\",\n      \"requirementIds\": [\n        \"R-3\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"SC-004\",\n      \"title\": \"Event or predicate fires once\",\n      \"kind\": \"normal\",\n      \"trigger\": \"A canonical event matches or a predicate crosses its configured edge\",\n      \"action\": \"Queue a common binding run\",\n      \"outcome\": \"One durable run invokes the existing authorized action with the declared dedupe and bound lifecycle.\",\n      \"requirementIds\": [\n        \"R-4\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"SC-005\",\n      \"title\": \"Explain why an automation did not run\",\n      \"kind\": \"failure\",\n      \"trigger\": \"An automation is disarmed, spend-paused, stale or rate-capped\",\n      \"action\": \"Open Workflows\",\n      \"outcome\": \"The common read model names the reason and preserves the automation's supported control.\",\n      \"requirementIds\": [\n        \"R-5\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"SC-006\",\n      \"title\": \"Migrate without replay or lost work\",\n      \"kind\": \"recovery\",\n      \"trigger\": \"A stack's migration is retried or interrupted\",\n      \"action\": \"Resume idempotent per-stack migration and verify residual rows\",\n      \"outcome\": \"No fire is duplicated, no pending intent is lost and the old path retires only after zero remaining eligible rows.\",\n      \"requirementIds\": [\n        \"R-6\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"SC-007\",\n      \"title\": \"Installed packs remain controllable\",\n      \"kind\": \"boundary\",\n      \"trigger\": \"An existing materialized trigger pack is listed, armed, disarmed or deleted\",\n      \"action\": \"Use the established triggers:bind facade\",\n      \"outcome\": \"Lifecycle and default-disarmed installation behavior remain compatible through consolidation.\",\n      \"requirementIds\": [\n        \"R-6\"\n      ]\n    }\n  ],\n  \"considerations\": [\n    {\n      \"category\": \"Authorization and spend\",\n      \"disposition\": \"covered\",\n      \"reason\": \"Preserve action authorization and existing owner arming; model-spend pauses are selective.\",\n      \"scenarioIds\": [\n        \"SC-002\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"category\": \"Concurrency, retries and dedupe\",\n      \"disposition\": \"covered\",\n      \"reason\": \"Migration maps overlap/catchup semantics before routing through one outbox.\",\n      \"scenarioIds\": [\n        \"SC-003\",\n        \"SC-004\",\n        \"SC-006\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"category\": \"Data retention\",\n      \"disposition\": \"covered\",\n      \"reason\": \"D-001's source-level delivery horizon remains authoritative; no automatic provider row deletion.\",\n      \"scenarioIds\": [\n        \"SC-006\"\n      ]\n    },\n    {\n      \"category\": \"Credentials and outward-facing actions\",\n      \"disposition\": \"covered\",\n      \"reason\": \"Existing executors retain consent and credential checks; this plan adds no credential acquisition or sending authority.\",\n      \"scenarioIds\": [\n        \"SC-002\",\n        \"SC-007\"\n      ]\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n## Why\n\nThe 2026-10-01 trigger review (owner directive #1210, su-6e9bdedd) found that the Workflows tab already *displays* six mechanisms as one list, but *executes* them through six separate stacks. Each has its own arming, pausing, rate-limiting and dedupe rules, so every safety property has to be re-invented (and is usually missing) per stack:\n\n| mechanism | trigger | where it lives | measured 2026-10-01 |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| trigger bindings | external event pattern + filter | `external-triggers/binding-engine.ts`, `trigger_bindings` / `trigger_runs` | 1 armed binding; dispatcher paused 09-15 → 10-01 with nothing visible |\n| event reactions | internal event key | event-reaction rules | 6 rules, 31 fires in 30 days |\n| predicate watches | predicate over state | `watch:create` | 5 active |\n| cron routines | cron | `harness_shared.routines` | 1,174 rows, 844 inactive |\n| plan schedules | recurrence on a plan | `plans:set-schedule` / `plans:arm-schedule` | not measured |\n| blueprint schedules | `triggers.schedule` on a blueprint | ephemeral executor | not measured |\n\nDefects that came from that split, found in the same review:\n- A pause was all-or-nothing: the whole external-trigger dispatcher was classed as LLM spend, so a spend pause stopped every action type (review item 4).\n- Staleness existed nowhere: re-arming would have fired a two-week backlog (WI-10004920, fixed for bindings only).\n- Pause state was invisible to the surface that shows the workflows (WI-10004922, fixed for the trigger dispatcher only).\n- Ledger retention was absent (WI-10004921, fixed for `trigger_deliveries` only).\n\nEach fix is per-stack. Consolidation makes the next one land once.\n\n## Relationship to prior work\n\n`dbos-scheduler-consolidation-2026-06-03` (shipped) unified the timer *execution* layer: two mechanisms (DBOS durable / ephemeral tier) plus one declaration surface. That rule stands and constrains this plan: this plan adds NO scheduler. It unifies the *automation model* above the timers — what fires, what it does, under which policy.\n\n## Target model\n\n```\nTrigger  = event(pattern, filter) | schedule(cron / recurrence) | predicate(watch)\nAction   = launch-plan | start-goal | create-work-item | blueprint-operation | emit-event\nPolicy   = { armed, spendClass, rateCap{maxRuns, windowSeconds}, maxAgeSeconds, dedupe{key, horizon}, concurrency }\nRun      = one durable outbox row per (automation, fire) → one dispatcher → the action's existing executor\n```\n\nPrinciples:\n- **Reuse, don't rewrite, the executors.** Actions keep going through the existing plan-run / goal / work-item / blueprint-operation paths, as bindings already do.\n- **Bindings are the seed.** `trigger_bindings` + `trigger_runs` already have armed state, a storm cap, max age (WI-10004920), dedupe and an outbox. Generalize them rather than invent a seventh table.\n- **Spend class per action, not per dispatcher.** A spend pause holds `launch-plan` / `start-goal` and lets cheap actions (create-work-item, emit-event) through (review item 4).\n- **One pause/visibility surface.** Every paused or disarmed automation is visible in the Workflows tab from the same model, not by special-casing one routine name (as WI-10004922 had to).\n\n## Original proposed phases\n\n1. **Inventory + mapping.** Map every live row of the six stacks (incl. the 844 inactive routines) onto Trigger/Action/Policy; list what does not fit (routine `concurrency`/`catchup`, ephemeral-tier timing). Output: mapping table + gaps. No code.\n2. **Policy unification on bindings.** Add `spendClass` and per-action pause to bindings; a spend pause holds only spend-class actions. Retires \"pause the whole dispatcher\".\n3. **Schedule triggers on the binding model.** Plan schedules + blueprint schedules become `schedule` triggers on the same outbox/dispatcher, still fired by the existing DBOS/ephemeral timers. Infrastructure routines (git-sync, green-checkpoint, GC sweeps) stay routines.\n4. **Predicate + event-reaction triggers.** `watch:create` predicates and event reactions become `predicate` / `event` triggers on the same model.\n5. **Workflows tab reads the one model.** Replace the per-mechanism merge with one read; paused / stale / rate-capped states render uniformly.\n6. **Retire the duplicate stacks** once each has zero live rows, one migration per stack.\n\n## Original open questions and execution assumptions\n\n- **Scope of \"routines\".** Draft assumption: infrastructure routines stay outside; only user-facing automations move. Agree?\n- **Delivery-ledger row horizon.** WI-10004921 strips payloads but keeps `trigger_deliveries` rows indefinitely as dedupe identity. How long must dedupe cover a provider resync (e.g. 90 days) before rows may be deleted?\n- **Order.** Phase 2 (spend-class pause) is small and independently valuable — ship it first even if the rest waits?\n\n## Not in scope\n\n- Re-architecting the executors (plan runs, goals, blueprint operations).\n- Provider ingestion (sources → canonical events → sinks), which the review rated sound.\n\n## Decisions\n\n### D-001 — Seam with enterprise-data-sources: data sources own ingestion + delivery dedupe horizon; this plan owns trigger_bindings/trigger_runs\nDate: 2026-10-01\n[self-imposed: su-6e9bdedd, plan author, 2026-10-01 20:20Z; draft still pending Avi's review] Accepts enterprise-data-sources-2026-10-01#D-010. This plan owns trigger_bindings / trigger_runs (Trigger / Action / Policy) and does not own provider ingestion. Event triggers bind to canonical events, never to source rows. The trigger_deliveries dedupe horizon (the open question WI-10004949 deferred here) is retention_policy.deliveryDedupeHorizonDays on the data source (harness_shared.trigger_sources); absent means keep (today's behaviour). Rationale: dedupe keys are scoped to the source, so the horizon belongs on the source; keep-when-absent removes no data until someone sets a horizon.\n\n### D-002 — Portable trigger packs are owned by generalized-integrations; preserve the triggers:bind facade\nDate: 2026-10-05\nCross-plan ruling from [[generalized-integrations-google-migration-cupboard-workflows-2026-10-05]]#D-007 (su-a973d2b0, under Avi directive #1317, 2026-10-05). That plan owns Cupboard trigger-pack export, install, materialization, review, arming, update and uninstall, and builds them only on the existing triggers:bind facade and binding engine (this plan's declared seed). This plan keeps unifying the other five mechanisms and any table consolidation, and must keep the triggers:bind facade (create disarmed binding, arm, disarm, delete, list by owner) working for materialized packs when it changes the underlying tables. Neither plan depends on the other being activated.\n\n## Execution scope\n\nThe current owner-authorized kickoff permits execution of this exact plan. Preparation retains the draft defaults: infrastructure routines stay outside, per-action spend pause precedes migration, and the D-001 source-level dedupe horizon remains unset/keep unless explicitly configured. These are disclosed interpretations of the existing draft, not new product requirements. No credential/consent authority or independent acceptance is waived.\n\n\n## Requirements\n\n**R-1 — Reproducible inventory.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"An inventory accounts for each row in all six current mechanism populations, including inactive routines, with an explicit Trigger/Action/Policy mapping or a reasoned infrastructure exclusion.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"An inventory accounts for each row in all six current mechanism populations, including inactive routines, with an explicit Trigger/Action/Policy mapping or a reasoned infrastructure exclusion.\",\"falsifier\":\"A row is omitted, counted from historical prose, or declared migratable without mapping its catchup/concurrency/lifecycle semantics.\"},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Read the six canonical row populations at one recorded observation time, identify their writer paths, and reconcile each row against the saved mapping and exclusion ledger.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"instrument\",\"instrumentKey\":\"none\"}}}\n```\n\n**R-2 — Selective spend pause.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"A spend pause holds spending binding actions while eligible nonspending binding actions continue through the existing dispatcher.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"A spend pause holds spending binding actions while eligible nonspending binding actions continue through the existing dispatcher.\",\"falsifier\":\"A paused spending action executes or a nonspending action is blocked only because it shares the dispatcher.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"integration\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run binding-engine integration scenarios with mixed actions under paused and unpaused spend policy; verify held/completed ledger outcomes and the negative executor calls.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/external-triggers/binding-engine.integration.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n**R-3 — Schedules use the shared outbox.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"An armed plan or user-facing blueprint schedule produces one durable binding run for each due fire through the existing timer engine, retaining recurrence, catchup and overlap policy.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"An armed plan or user-facing blueprint schedule produces one durable binding run for each due fire through the existing timer engine, retaining recurrence, catchup and overlap policy.\",\"falsifier\":\"A repeated due fire creates duplicate execution, an eligible fire is lost, or timer migration changes recurrence or overlap behavior.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"integration\",\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run plan and blueprint schedule integration scenarios for due/replayed fires, disarm, recurrence and overlap; assert durable binding-run identities and existing executor receipts.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/harness/routines/materialize-plan-schedule.integration.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/harness/routines/arm-plan-schedule.integration.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/blueprint/materialize-triggers.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n**R-4 — Events and predicates use the shared outbox.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"A matched internal event or predicate edge produces its authorized action through a durable binding run with preserved dedupe and bound-to lifecycle.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"A matched internal event or predicate edge produces its authorized action through a durable binding run with preserved dedupe and bound-to lifecycle.\",\"falsifier\":\"A matching fire bypasses the binding ledger, repeats its side effect, or survives cancellation of its bound subject.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"integration\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run event-reaction and predicate-watch integration scenarios for match, no match, repeated delivery, failure/retry and bound-subject cancellation; inspect common run identity and executor effects.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/events/local-rule-runtime.integration.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/events/await/predicate-watch.integration.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n**R-5 — Uniform workflow state.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Workflows displays automation armed state and the reason for spend-paused, stale or rate-capped execution from the common model across migrated mechanisms.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Workflows displays automation armed state and the reason for spend-paused, stale or rate-capped execution from the common model across migrated mechanisms.\",\"falsifier\":\"Equivalent automation states display differently by mechanism or a blocked automation appears ready without its reason.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Extend the Workflows model's registered tests with the same state fixtures per trigger kind; verify supported controls and reasons, then exercise the journey in isolated current-build Tauri.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"apps/operator-vite/src/components/adv/workflows-model.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n**R-6 — Safe retirement and facade compatibility.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"A duplicate stack retires only after every eligible row has migrated exactly once while triggers:bind lifecycle operations remain compatible.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"A duplicate stack retires only after every eligible row has migrated exactly once while triggers:bind lifecycle operations remain compatible.\",\"falsifier\":\"A legacy stack is removed with eligible rows or pending intent remaining, migration replays an effect, or an installed pack loses its binding lifecycle.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"integration\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run binding-engine and trigger-pack lifecycle integration scenarios before and after per-stack migration including interrupted/repeated migration and pending runs; record the zero-residue census before removal.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/external-triggers/binding-engine.integration.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/cupboard/trigger-pack-lifecycle.integration.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n## Design\n\nExtend trigger_bindings/trigger_runs; add no scheduler or parallel automation store. Keep current executors and the triggers:bind facade. Preserve intentional disarm/spend pause through migration. Determine each stack's exact concurrency, catchup, dedupe and cancellation mapping in P-001 before its implementation. D-001 and D-002 remain governing.\n\n### Bar-to-work map for this plan\n\n| bar | implementing plan items | evidence plane |\n|---|---|---|\n| R-1 | P-001 | live |\n| R-2 | P-002 | tree |\n| R-3 | P-003 | tree |\n| R-4 | P-004 | tree |\n| R-5 | P-005 | tree |\n| R-6 | P-006 | tree |\n\n## Phase 1 — Reproducible inventory\n\n- **P-001** `done` Record the reproducible row inventory and Trigger/Action/Policy mapping of six mechanisms, inactive rows and infrastructure exclusions. Resolve semantic gaps before moving data. (importance: high) — note: Manual inventory delivered and verified: /reports/rpt_e5729633-e051-43f2-96bb-64a442fbea70 indexes 12 source census and 13 per-row mapping reports; proof52902/52903 bound to exact P-001 clauses; work item complete with committed authority. Future phase obligations stay on this plan; no product acceptance claimed.\n\n## Phase 2 — Selective spend pause\n\n- **P-002** `wip` Implement selective per-action spend policy on existing bindings and preserve deliberate pause intent without pausing the whole dispatcher. (importance: high) (blocked-by: P-001) — note: P-001 completed with committed authority and verified per-row census/map; implement selective action spending policy after reading current pause writer paths. Current acceptance rubric vetting requested via existing-session coordinator; preserve that independent gate.\n\n## Phase 3 — Schedules use the shared outbox\n\n- **P-003** `todo` Route plan and user-facing blueprint scheduled fires into binding runs using existing DBOS/ephemeral timers, retaining overlap, catchup and arming semantics. (importance: high) (blocked-by: P-002)\n\n## Phase 4 — Events and predicates use the shared outbox\n\n- **P-004** `todo` Route eligible event reactions and predicate watches into binding runs while preserving match, dedupe, failure/retry and bound lifecycle behavior. (importance: high) (blocked-by: P-003)\n\n## Phase 5 — Uniform workflow state\n\n- **P-005** `todo` Make Workflows consume the common automation read model and explain armed, paused, stale and rate-capped state uniformly. (importance: high) (blocked-by: P-004)\n\n## Phase 6 — Safe retirement and facade compatibility\n\n- **P-006** `todo` Migrate and retire each duplicate stack only after an audited zero-residue census, preserve triggers:bind for existing packs, and obtain independent acceptance/current-build then final shipment evidence. (importance: high) (blocked-by: P-005)\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"voice-final-public-release-2026-10-01","title":"Voice public release — current acceptance and verified shipment","status":"ready","created":"2026-10-01","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Voice public release — current acceptance and verified shipment\nslug: voice-final-public-release-2026-10-01\nstatus: ready\ncreated: 2026-10-01\nupdated: 2026-10-06\n---\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** ⚠ BAR READINESS BLOCKED (2026-10-06, after decision-added): bar_snapshot_grading_missing, bar_snapshot_evidence_plane_unmet, bar_snapshot_proof_missing, bar_snapshot_proof_inadequate. Next repair: Bind evidence at the current spec revision on the declared evidence plane. (R-2). (re-evaluated in the same write by the scope-write cascade, P-030/P-031)\n\nD-005 applied: release matrix v28 has the D-005 scope table (keyless in-scope rows; portal rows conditional on hosted config; unkeyed engines dropped). WI-10006353 done but its files were still uncommitted at 04:41Z (scheduled git-sync fire in flight). Guided session script written: docs/evidence/voice-final-public-release-2026-10-01/guided-session.md. Local voice healthy on :3070 at 04:31Z. WI-10006372 filed (EL health field is format-only). Main frozen by repair queue (su-e6d99ccf, WI-10006055).\n\n**Next:** 1) Confirm the D-005 files commit and push; reload :3170. 2) Run guided-session preflight 0.1–0.9 on :3170. 3) Ask Avi to run parts A–D. 4) Record results; restore prefs; file failures. 5) Re-audit plan for activation; then rubric grading and ship after promotion (R-6 blob binding + agent step E6).\n\n## Promoted\n\n<!-- plan-pipeline: do not edit this block manually -->\n- [ ] WI-10004757 — Build the current client/engine/platform release matrix, audit latest governing decisions and held claims, recheck credentials and serving-runtime routes, and map existing tests/evidence and unresolv… <!-- P-001 -->\n- [ ] WI-10004758 — Exercise the authenticated portal voice journey on current builds and the actual public app, repair confirmed defects through owned work-items, and bind replayable hosted microphone, lifecycle and pr… <!-- P-002 -->\n- [ ] WI-10004759 — Exercise supported desktop/TUI real-microphone paths, recheck the ElevenLabs capability blocker and preserve/restore preferences; obtain retained owner/hardware acceptance without substituting synthe… <!-- P-003 -->\n- [ ] WI-10004760 — Verify and repair voice interruption, stop/cleanup, denial, reconnect/retry, self-audio, transcript consistency and hosted safeguards across the supported matrix; ship durable recurrence tests for ev… <!-- P-004 -->\n- [ ] WI-10004761 — Complete existing portal P-031 / WI-10001112 and applicable voice acceptance residue; refresh evidence and independent grading for this final plan, obtain required author verdict, and verify mandator… <!-- P-005 -->\n- [ ] WI-10004762 — Coordinate promotion with the live gate owner, verify the exact public-host/package artifact containing every required fix, publish truthful release notes in the established destination, run the fina… <!-- P-006 -->\n## Goal\n\nMake the currently supported voice features ready for public release, including the new interface at https://app.papercusp.com/, and carry the result to independently accepted, verified shipped status.\n\n## Background and reuse\n\nOwner source: session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:1 asks for voice status, release blockers and portal parity; turn 5 instructs a plan, AUTO and shipment. The request was recovered after carry-respawn and is the execution authority.\n\nThis is a new October final-acceptance effort, not another voice implementation. Reuse voice-recovery-current-generation-readiness-2026-08-27 and voice-public-release-refresh-2026-08-11 (both shipped), portal-voice-parity-and-release-2026-09-08 (P-031 / WI-10001112 still open), voice-unified-sentinel-pipeline and existing desktop/TUI tests. Preserve voice-public-release-readiness-2026-07-12's unresolved physical-microphone bar; recheck WI-2146515's September credential blocker. Reconcile stale tickets from evidence rather than repeat terminal work.\n\n## Requirements\n\n**R-1 — Release scope is current and explicit.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Get our voice features ready for a public release, including app.papercusp.com, and carry them to shipped status.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The source-backed release matrix identifies the supported voice client, engine, platform and mode combinations.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"The matrix omits a supported voice client/engine/mode, labels an unsupported combination supported, or reports resolved/shipped without current cited evidence. Missing or uncited matrix evidence rates unknown; an unsupported combination labeled supported, omitted required row or unsupported resolved/shipped claim rates broken. BROKEN if the matrix lacks any credential precondition, acceptance evidence or unresolved-bar column for a supported combination, or uses an old shipped label as a substitute for current source/runtime evidence.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"tree\"\n    ],\n    \"role\": \"outcome\",\n    \"mandatory\": true,\n    \"passRatings\": [\n      \"healthy\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Read current voice-engine and transport source, serving-runtime identity, existing voice-plan decisions and work_items:get for release blockers. Record the named client/engine/platform population, source paths, acceptance refs and unsupported combinations in P-001; an independent reviewer compares the matrix to the actual public UI and desktop/TUI source. Missing or uncited matrix evidence rates unknown; an unsupported combination labeled supported, omitted required row or unsupported resolved/shipped claim rates broken. Evidence destination: this plan's Current release matrix section, with canonical source refs and a work-item coverage partition.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"instrument\",\n      \"instrumentKey\": \"none\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-2 — The public portal voice journey works.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Get our voice features ready for a public release, including app.papercusp.com, and carry them to shipped status.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"A signed-in public portal conversation completes the real-microphone-to-audible-reply journey defined by the release matrix.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A declared portal engine/mode cannot complete the signed-in real-microphone-to-audible-reply journey, consent/permission/transcript state disagrees, or the hosted app exposes the excluded desktop-local route. RATING BASIS: no automated test substitutes for real microphone proof; missing per-engine/mode consent, PTT/always-on, transcript, audible-reply or runtime identity evidence rates unknown. Missing consent, lifecycle controls, current approved chat placement/accessibility or the excluded desktop-local route exposed on the hosted portal rates broken. BROKEN if voice settings, current chat placement or accessible control behavior do not match the latest approved design.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"live\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"live\"\n    ],\n    \"role\": \"outcome\",\n    \"mandatory\": true,\n    \"passRatings\": [\n      \"healthy\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"In a signed-in public-portal conversation, use an actual microphone to grant consent/permission, hold/release PTT, switch always-on/off and listen to the spoken reply for each supported configured hosted engine. Record test identity, consent, engine, runtime/artifact, timestamp, transcript and audible-reply evidence; repeat denial/retry/interruption. No synthetic PCM fulfills this check. RATING BASIS: no automated test substitutes for real microphone proof; missing per-engine/mode consent, PTT/always-on, transcript, audible-reply or runtime identity evidence rates unknown. Missing consent, lifecycle controls, current approved chat placement/accessibility or the excluded desktop-local route exposed on the hosted portal rates broken. Evidence destination: docs/evidence/voice-final-public-release-2026-10-01/portal/; use the existing evidence writers and record hashes of transcript/audio plus test identity and artifact.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"instrument\",\n      \"instrumentKey\": \"none\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-3 — Desktop and TUI microphone journeys work.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Get our voice features ready for a public release, including app.papercusp.com, and carry them to shipped status.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The supported desktop and TUI voice paths complete the real-microphone round trips defined by the release matrix.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A declared desktop/TUI voice path fails its real-microphone round trip, provider capability is insufficient, preferences remain altered, or synthetic evidence substitutes for a retained hardware/owner bar. RATING BASIS: retained owner/hardware acceptance must be explicit; synthetic evidence rates unknown. A supported ElevenLabs session failing the convai_write prerequisite, un-restored engine preference, missing PTT/session or wake/always-on transcript/audio trace or inherited hardware bar rates broken or unresolved. BROKEN if local whisper/brain/kokoro or configured ElevenLabs is not tested where supported, or provider capability is not rechecked before temporary engine selection.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"live\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"live\"\n    ],\n    \"role\": \"outcome\",\n    \"mandatory\": true,\n    \"passRatings\": [\n      \"healthy\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"On each declared supported desktop/TUI platform and engine, record a real microphone PTT/session or wake/always-on utterance, its transcript and audible reply; test output mute, off, interruption and self-audio. Recheck ElevenLabs capability with the existing session-mint path; preserve/restore the prior engine. Obtain any retained owner-only acceptance explicitly. RATING BASIS: retained owner/hardware acceptance must be explicit; synthetic evidence rates unknown. A supported ElevenLabs session failing the convai_write prerequisite, un-restored engine preference, missing PTT/session or wake/always-on transcript/audio trace or inherited hardware bar rates broken or unresolved. Evidence destination: docs/evidence/voice-final-public-release-2026-10-01/desktop-tui/; use the existing evidence writers and record hashes of transcript/audio plus test identity and artifact.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"instrument\",\n      \"instrumentKey\": \"none\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-4 — Voice stops and recovers safely.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Get our voice features ready for a public release, including app.papercusp.com, and carry them to shipped status.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"A voice turn retains user control and transcript identity through the lifecycle and recovery scenarios in the verification matrix.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"Any required interruption, mute/off/cleanup, denial, outage/reconnect/retry, self-audio or transcript-identity scenario fails, or hosted credential/tenant/spend isolation is bypassed. Each of interruption, output mute, off/navigation/unmount cleanup, permission denial, provider outage, reconnect/retry, self-audio and turn/transcript identity has a named scenario; a missing scenario is unknown and any failing scenario is broken.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"live\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"live\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"integration\"\n    ],\n    \"role\": \"outcome\",\n    \"mandatory\": true,\n    \"passRatings\": [\n      \"healthy\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run npm run test:file -- packages/operator-core/lib/voice-turn-router.integration.test.ts packages/operator-core/lib/voice-credentials.integration.test.ts and the existing UI/TUI cleanup/reconnect tests identified by P-001. Reproduce denial, outage, reconnect, retry, interruption, off/unmount and self-audio on the accepted live clients; compare capture/session termination and turn/transcript identities to the recorded baseline. Each of interruption, output mute, off/navigation/unmount cleanup, permission denial, provider outage, reconnect/retry, self-audio and turn/transcript identity has a named scenario; a missing scenario is unknown and any failing scenario is broken.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/voice-turn-router.integration.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/voice-credentials.integration.test.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-5 — Release acceptance is independent and current.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Get our voice features ready for a public release, including app.papercusp.com, and carry them to shipped status.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"Current independent voice acceptance resolves the mandatory release bars without waiver.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A mandatory voice acceptance bar or release-critical residue remains unresolved, grading/evidence is stale or author-dependent, or required owner/hardware acceptance is absent. The independent grader must be outside the rubric author's, implementer's and sole-vetting-critic's prohibited lineage; stale grading, missing author verdict, unresolved portal P-031/WI-10001112 or retained physical-microphone/owner bars are blocking.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"tree\"\n    ],\n    \"role\": \"outcome\",\n    \"mandatory\": true,\n    \"passRatings\": [\n      \"healthy\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Read current portal P-031 / WI-10001112 evidence, plans:get shipReadiness, active rubric/spec revisions, independent scorecards, grading audit and author verdict. Reconcile each named release-critical residue. A reviewer independently reruns the evidence and verifies the retained physical-microphone/owner bar; no waiver or tree-only substitution satisfies acceptance. The independent grader must be outside the rubric author's, implementer's and sole-vetting-critic's prohibited lineage; stale grading, missing author verdict, unresolved portal P-031/WI-10001112 or retained physical-microphone/owner bars are blocking.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"instrument\",\n      \"instrumentKey\": \"none\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-6 — Shipped status describes the actual artifact.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Get our voice features ready for a public release, including app.papercusp.com, and carry them to shipped status.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The published voice artifacts match the accepted release scope and revision.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"The publicly served/published artifact lacks a required accepted fix, fails the final voice smoke, release notes overclaim support, or terminal shipped status is asserted before mandatory acceptance. Absent exact runtime/package identifiers or final public voice smoke is unknown; release notes overclaiming the matrix, omitted accepted fixes or premature shipped status are broken. BROKEN if a forced-red deployment or undocumented default-off feature is used to bypass readiness.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"deployed\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"deployed\"\n    ],\n    \"role\": \"outcome\",\n    \"mandatory\": true,\n    \"passRatings\": [\n      \"healthy\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Resolve the exact public artifact/runtime/package revision after the release owner reports promotion/deploy. Verify the public portal artifact and required published desktop/TUI packages contain the accepted fixes, repeat the release voice smoke, record identifiers and URLs/source paths, and compare release notes to the accepted scope before plans:set-plan-status shipped. Absent exact runtime/package identifiers or final public voice smoke is unknown; release notes overclaiming the matrix, omitted accepted fixes or premature shipped status are broken.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"instrument\",\n      \"instrumentKey\": \"none\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-7 — Hosted voice retains its security and cost boundaries.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Get voice ready for public release without regressing existing hosted safeguards.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a0f6a2-1e2f-7722-9842-e933ddc289cb:5\"\n    ],\n    \"constraints\": [\n      \"Preserve portal-voice-parity-and-release-2026-09-08 D-007/D-009/D-011; no desktop-local path in hosted portal.\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"Hosted voice honors the existing credential, tenant, engine availability and spend boundaries.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A browser receives a provider secret, a tenant reaches another tenant's voice resources, an unavailable explicit engine silently substitutes, a spend limit is bypassed, or the hosted portal exposes the excluded desktop-local path; missing boundary evidence rates unknown.\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"live\"\n    ],\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"live\",\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"integration\",\n      \"unit\"\n    ],\n    \"role\": \"outcome\",\n    \"mandatory\": true,\n    \"passRatings\": [\n      \"healthy\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run existing voice-credentials integration, hosted two-tenant acceptance integration and voice-spend enforcement tests, plus the portal server-brokered token/isolation and explicit-engine tests identified by P-001; verify the corresponding accepted hosted-runtime responses with isolated tenants and redact all secrets from evidence.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/voice-credentials.integration.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/hosted-two-tenant-acceptance.integration.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/__tests__/voice-spend-enforcement.test.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Design\n\nUse the existing voice transport/state seams, canonical test suites, test-run ledger, spec-evidence binding, rubric/scorecard acceptance and deployment pipeline. Do not introduce another engine, voice orchestration loop or hosted route to the desktop-local pipeline. Repairs discovered by this effort receive owned change/bug work-items and recurrence tests in the existing suite.\n\nOrdinary implementation and acceptance use staging/current-build routes selected through dev:pipeline_position for the appropriate test class; confirm the serving runtime actually loaded the source. Scorecard must cite the actual outside critique and undergo its required integrity audit.\nRelated: P-001, P-005, P-006\n\n### D-005 — Release scope: owner guided mic session; drop engines without a working key\nDate: 2026-10-06\n2026-10-06 [owner:Avi 2026-10-06, owner-dialog answer to su-d7c6542c under owner directive #1411].\n\nAvi chose these two options:\n(1) 'Guided session': Avi personally performs the real-microphone round trips (portal signed-in at app.papercusp.com, desktop app, TUI). The agent prepares everything else and a step-by-step script, and captures evidence. The R-2/R-3 real-microphone bar is NOT amended. No synthetic audio substitutes for it.\n(2) 'Drop unkeyed engines': any engine without a working key in our environment is marked unavailable for this public release and is not claimed as supported. Measured at 2026-10-06T03:34Z: the ElevenLabs key is set but ConvAI agent fetch returns 401 (WI-2146515: lacks convai_write), and the OpenAI, Cartesia and Picovoice keys are unset. That makes ElevenLabs full-agent (D7/T2), OpenAI TTS (D4/L4), OpenAI Realtime (D8), Cartesia TTS (D5/L5) and Porcupine wake (D9-porcupine) out of scope. ElevenLabs TTS (D3/L3) and hosted ElevenLabs (P2) stay in scope only if a fresh provider call proves that key/route works; otherwise they are dropped too. Keyless paths stay in scope: local Whisper+Kokoro, browser speech, Web Speech input, openWakeWord, and portal Auto/LiveKit where hosted-configured.\n\nImplementation reuses the existing unavailable-engine seam that WI-10004792 built for Gemini Live: a disabled picker option, a scoped alert and rejection on activation. A legacy saved preference is preserved, not deleted. Release notes must name the dropped engines. Re-adding an engine later requires a working key plus its own acceptance.\n\n### D-006 — Add synthetic-voice round-trip testing; real-mic session stays the final check; Avi supplying a new ElevenLabs sk_ key\nDate: 2026-10-06\nDate: 2026-10-06\n2026-10-06. [owner:Avi 2026-10-06, owner-dialog answers to su-5cc3d9e5 under owner directive #1474, ~16:07Z]\n\nAvi asked whether agents can test the microphone themselves with a synthetic voice. Offered options: add synthetic testing and keep his mic test / replace his mic test (amend D-005 + R-2/R-3) / keep as is. **Avi chose: \"Add it, keep my mic test\".** Route: **\"su-d7c6542c\"** (the plan owner) runs it.\n\nMeaning:\n1. Agents now run automated synthetic round trips WITHOUT waiting for Avi: synthesize speech locally (Kokoro, keyless), inject it as the microphone input (headless browser fake-audio capture for the portal; virtual audio source on the headless desktop/TUI rig), capture Papercup's spoken reply and transcribe it back to assert it. Scope: STT, reply, TTS playback, interrupt/stop/cleanup, denial, reconnect/retry. Defects found are fixed before Avi's session.\n2. This does NOT amend D-005 or acceptance bars R-2/R-3: synthetic evidence supplements, never substitutes, the real-microphone bar. Avi's guided BRIO session remains the final check, ideally shortened to a confirmation pass.\n3. Cloud portal synthetic runs need a signed-in test account at app.papercusp.com; if none is available to agents, ask Avi rather than widening the hosted auth boundary.\n\nElevenLabs: the 64-hex value Avi pasted (ending 334f) is an ElevenLabs API KEY ID - api.elevenlabs.io returned 400 api_key_id_used_as_api_key on models/voices/convai/TTS - so it was NOT stored; stored sk_...56fd remains and is rejected 401. **Avi chose: \"I'll paste a new sk_ key\".** When a working sk_ key is verified and stored, the ElevenLabs rows D-005 dropped (EL TTS D3/L3, hosted EL P2, and EL full-agent D7/T2 if the key has ConvAI write) return to scope via the same unavailable-engine seam.\n\n**Update 2026-10-06 ~16:10Z [turn:self] (WI-10006757):** Avi then supplied a real ElevenLabs sk_ key (\"the right elevenlabs key\", directive #1476). Direct probe: v1/models, v1/voices, v1/user/subscription and TTS all 200. Stored via PUT :3070 /api/agent-mcp/operator-credentials (validating route) -> credentials now elevenlabs sk__••••a84b healthy:true; operator-voice-engine-health elevenlabs:true; POST operator-tts-preview engine=elevenlabs -> 200 audio/mpeg 28.9KB. So EL TTS (D3/L3) is keyed and working locally. ConvAI: this account has 0 agents (GET v1/convai/agents -> agents:[]), and the configured elevenLabsAgentId agent_5601kqrp7rgpf59rqvh56aesq2m9 returns 404 document_not_found, so EL full-agent (D7/T2) needs an agent provisioned in this account before it can return to scope. Hosted portal ElevenLabs (P2) uses hosted config, which this write did not touch (unverified).\n\n### D-007 — ElevenLabs release scope after the new sk_ key: local TTS in, hosted portal TTS and full-agent ConvAI out\nDate: 2026-10-06\nDate: 2026-10-06\n2026-10-06 ~16:55Z [self-imposed scope call under AUTO, owner directive #1411; applies D-005 'drop engines without a working key' and D-006's return-to-scope rule].\n\nMeasured (D-006 update, WI-10006757): the new ElevenLabs sk_ key (stored, ••••a84b) answers v1/models, v1/voices, v1/user/subscription and TTS with 200; operator-voice-engine-health reports elevenlabs:true; operator-tts-preview engine=elevenlabs returns 200 audio/mpeg.\n\nRuling:\n1. **EL TTS on desktop and TUI (D3/L3) returns to release scope.** Code: 'elevenlabs' removed from RELEASE_UNAVAILABLE_TTS_ENGINES in packages/operator-core/lib/voice-release-availability.ts (WI-10006763 step 2; 55 tests pass).\n2. **Hosted portal EL TTS (P2) stays out of this release.** The hosted portal reads hosted config that the key write did not touch, and no agent has verified it. Code: new RELEASE_UNAVAILABLE_HOSTED_TTS_ENGINES (shared set + elevenlabs) and isHostedTtsEngineUnavailable, used by the hosted tutorial speech route (packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/routes/hosted-tutorial-progress.ts). It returns only after the hosted credential is verified by a real hosted call; that is a one-line removal from the hosted set.\n3. **EL full-agent ConvAI (D7/T2) stays out of this release.** The account has 0 ConvAI agents (GET v1/convai/agents -> []), and the configured elevenLabsAgentId returns 404 document_not_found. It returns only after an agent is provisioned in Avi's account. Agents will not create resources in his ElevenLabs account for this release.\n\nGrading consequence: R-1..R-7 evidence must not claim P2 EL or D7/T2. Desktop/TUI EL TTS rows are claimable only with synthetic round-trip evidence (D-006) and, per D-005, Avi's real-mic confirmation pass.\n\n### D-008 — ElevenLabs returns as a two-tier voice agent (fast front + Papercup brain tool) plus faster brain path\nDate: 2026-10-06\nDate: 2026-10-06\n2026-10-06. [owner:Avi 2026-10-06, owner-dialog answer to su-5cc3d9e5 ~16:42Z] [turn:self]\nAsked how ElevenLabs should return to Papercup voice given the measured ~22s brain first-word delay (EI-11963, 2026-07-14: STT 0.59s, first brain delta 21.9s). **Avi chose: \"Fast front + faster brain (Recommended)\".**\nMeaning: (1) rebuild the two-tier voice agent properly — a fast model holds the conversation (~1s replies) and calls Papercup's full brain as a tool for anything needing memory/tools (\"let me check\"), reusing the existing ElevenLabs ConvAI engines (desktop elevenlabs-conv.ts, portal voice-elevenlabs.ts), fixing the old flaws: agent created from our code (not by hand on the EL dashboard), Papercup persona + recent context injected, every turn written into the same Papercup conversation. (2) In parallel, EI-11963: a slimmer converse path for voice so more turns can go straight to the brain.\nRationale + trade-offs: WI-10006773. Whether this rebuilt full-agent mode gates THIS public release is NOT decided by this answer [inferred: D-005's dropped EL full-agent rows stay dropped until a plan for the rebuild is approved]. Implementation plan + route still need Avi's approval (AUTO off).\n\n**Owner reasoning added ~16:45Z [turn:self]** — Avi (owner-typed, directive #1479): \"also on the phone we were listening locally. On the cloud app it would b listening on a remote server, if we are sacrifixing that latency anyways, why not use elevenlabs? this supports option #1\". So the fast front is ElevenLabs's hosted agent (option 1, rebuilt properly), at minimum for the cloud app, where the browser already streams audio to ElevenLabs directly (the portal only mints a token; media never transits the portal). Note: the July ~22s delay (EI-11963) was the brain, not listening (STT 0.59s); local listening stays the desktop's offline/fallback path.\n\n### D-009 — Portal synthetic leg reaches the chat-create refusal only; the hosted spoken round trip and mic denial run in the guided session\nDate: 2026-10-06\nDate: 2026-10-06\n2026-10-06 ~18:55Z [self-imposed scope call under AUTO, owner directive #1411; applies D-006 (agents run synthetic round trips without waiting for Avi) and D-005 (Avi's guided real-mic session stays the final check)].\n\nMeasured (WI-10006763 portal synthetic runs 5 and 6; receipt .papercusp/scratch/d006-portal-run6-receipt.json, 18:43Z): a freshly admitted WorkOS TEST tenant signs in to app.papercusp.com (session 200, organizationId set, workspaceId null). GET and POST /api/papercup-chat/conversations both return 403 {\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"portal_chat_workspace_not_selected\"}. A portal chat runs on the selected workspace's own machine (portal/apps/host/src/chat-instance-boundary.ts); a TEST tenant has no workspace, so no conversation and no voice room can exist. Microphone denial is also reachable only with a room: portal/packages/ui/src/voice-session.tsx pushToTalk returns early when there is no session, so no microphone request is ever made.\n\nRuling:\n1. Portal synthetic coverage (D-006) is: the instrument control (Kokoro speech transcribed by Whisper), hosted sign-in, shell entry, the voice control, and the named refusal. On an account without a workspace, choosing a voice mode must say so (\"Voice needs a workspace — create or select one, then retry.\") and open no room and no microphone. The product defect this leg found (control stuck on \"Connecting voice…\" with an empty alert) is WI-10006841, fixed with unit tests.\n2. The hosted spoken round trip (STT, reply, TTS playback, stop and cleanup) and microphone denial on the portal run in Avi's guided session (D-005), on his account, which has a workspace. The spec keeps both tests; they skip with a stated reason when the account has no workspace and run unchanged when it has one.\n3. No synthetic portal round-trip evidence is claimed for this release. Rubric rows that need the hosted portal round trip bind to the guided-session evidence.\n\nNot pursued for this release: a hosted test fixture that provisions a TEST workspace with a connected machine, which would let agents run the hosted round trip themselves.\n\n### D-010 — Hold this release until the two-tier voice agent ships\nDate: 2026-10-06\n[owner:Avi 2026-10-06, owner-typed, directive #1489, session_turn:claude:132e32d0-80b4-403b-983b-13ca112c9885:12] Verbatim: \"i approve thge plan.  you build it yourself now on auto mode.  hold the release.  add spoken questions now.\"\n\"hold the release\" answers D-008's open question: this plan's final shipment (P-006) waits until voice-two-tier-elevenlabs-agent-2026-10-06 P-009 passes. That plan also carries Avi's rulings on the Papercusp ElevenLabs key for tutorial users and on every voice backend working in the cloud (its D-002, D-003). Driver: su-5cc3d9e5.\n"},{"harness_slug":"sb-devboard-hive","plan_slug":"goal-escrow-evaluator-experiment-2026-10-01","title":"Goal escrow — read-only evaluator experiment (D-006 cheap experiment)","status":"superseded","created":"2026-10-01","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Goal escrow — read-only evaluator experiment (D-006 cheap experiment)\nslug: goal-escrow-evaluator-experiment-2026-10-01\nstatus: superseded\ncreated: 2026-10-01\nupdated: 2026-10-01\n---\n\n## Context\nGoal goal-mode-currently-lets-authority-and-completio-f7f555. Kill criterion: falsified if evaluator finds no missing/stale/conflicting deposits across 5-10 sampled goals, or every escrow verdict matches current status.\n\n## Deposits\nimplementation_delta, green_proof_or_no_go_reason, independent_grade, spend_snapshot_with_timestamp, owner_report_or_not_required, closure_verdict.\n\n\n## Phase — Build\n\n- **P-001** `dropped` Build a READ-ONLY goal-escrow evaluator (pure function + vitest tests in the project framework, plus a thin runner) that for a goal id synthesizes the 6 deposits from existing records (goals:get detail, goals:pots spend, linked plans/work-items + completion evidence, testing:runs, scorecards/grades, goal owner-report stamps), marks each present/missing/stale/conflicting, and derives an escrow verdict (close/block/fail/insufficient). No writes to goal/orchestration state. importance: high — note: Moved to goal-stamped work-items WI-10004498 (P-001) and WI-10004499 (P-002) in papercusp; plan harness is outside workspace work-scope.\n- **P-002** `dropped` Run the evaluator over 5-10 recent goals (mix of achieved, killed, active/stuck from goals:list). Produce a table: goal id, current status, per-deposit state, escrow verdict, mismatch?. Post it as a work-item comment and state explicitly whether the kill criterion is met (no missing/stale/conflicting deposits AND all verdicts match). Depends on the evaluator item. importance: high — note: Moved to goal-stamped work-items WI-10004498 (P-001) and WI-10004499 (P-002) in papercusp; plan harness is outside workspace work-scope.\n\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"acceptance-codex-credit-aware-capacity-2026-10-02","title":"Acceptance BAR — Respect Codex usage credits after included allowance exhaustion","status":"active","created":"2026-10-02","owner":"su-760491e1-69bb-40d5-be5b-0c67ac57cd28","archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Acceptance BAR — Respect Codex usage credits after included allowance exhaustion\nslug: acceptance-codex-credit-aware-capacity-2026-10-02\nstatus: active\ntemplate: rubric\ncreated: 2026-10-02\nupdated: 2026-10-02\nowner: su-760491e1-69bb-40d5-be5b-0c67ac57cd28\n---\n\n# Acceptance BAR — Respect Codex usage credits after included allowance exhaustion\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** Rubric-template plan (template:rubric).
