Its structured fields (characteristic,\ncriteria, ratingScale, methodRef) live in `template_data`, queried via\nrubrics:list/get/search; this body is the narrative model/method context. Status\n`draft` ⇒ a proposed rubric.\n\n**Next:** An independent reviewer (or the owner/su) ratifies a proposed rubric by promoting\nthis plan to `active` (rubrics:ratify / plans:set-plan-status); the proposer cannot\nself-ratify. Revise the criteria via plans:set-template-data.\n\n## Background\n\nGrades ONE run of a GOAL-mode agent against every binding clause of the GOAL contract (packages/operator-core/lib/modes/registry.ts:187-329, as rewritten by goal-mode-hardening-2026-08-10 P-007). One criterion per clause, each bound to a deterministic instrument where one honestly exists (GRADE clause 3: compute beats inference). Scale REUSED from su-agent-behavior so GOAL runs stay comparable with every other per-run agent scorecard. v2 (2026-08-10) realigns the rubric after the contract was rewritten clause-by-clause: 2 criteria dropped (one graded behaviour the contract now FORBIDS), 2 renamed project->pot, 4 rebound, 10 added for clauses that had no criterion, and every instrumentKey moved off the deleted numbered OPERATING LOOP onto clause names that survive re-ordering. EVERY REPLICATION DRILL HERE WAS EXECUTED AGAINST LIVE PG ON 2026-08-10, not merely schema-checked (EI-10518: drills must be validated by RUNNING them). Running them caught three type defects that existence-checking cannot, inverted in BOTH directions: session_turn_parts.ts is TIMESTAMPTZ (not bigint epoch-ms) while agent_fleets.created_at is BIGINT epoch-ms (not timestamptz). THREE INSTRUMENTATION WARNINGS, each of which silently costs a whole criterion if missed. (a) Agent code-edit activity is NOT in tool_invocations (MCP tools only, never native Edit/Write) and the transcript store that has it is scoped workspace_id='default' — both wrong reads return a confident zero (EI-20103748074297088). (b) harness_shared.work_items has NO id/state/assignee/created_by/scope columns — they are feature_id/status/taken_by/harness_slug, there is no creator column at all, and harness_shared.goal_projects no longer exists; drills on the intuitive names THROW rather than return zero, which reads as a broken grader rather than a failing agent (plan D-011). (c) A typed column can be DEAD while a jsonb path is live: needs_human_review is 0% populated (0 of 37,679) while payload->>'needsHuman' has 1,577 rows, so 'modernizing' onto the typed column breaks a working drill. releaseGating stays FALSE by decision goal-mode-rubric-v2-2026-08-10#D-025 (P-014 closed 2026-08-12 with its two-graded-run precondition MET: runs EI-20203104876436965 and EI-20207296832797611). Among D-025's grounds: the instrument is sound (no criterion lacks an instrument, no duplicate instrument keys), but the obligation the flag imposes is empirically unmet - the rubric-staleness watchdog enforces a CONTINUOUS 6h freshness window while goal-mode-e2e is a PER-RUN rubric over episodic goal runs, and both graded runs failed or partialed mode-and-subject-integrity on a launch-path defect. FLIP CONDITION: set releaseGating TRUE only when (a) the staleness obligation is satisfiable for a per-run rubric (episodic/per-run freshness semantics in the watchdog, or a sustained cadence of freshly graded goal runs inside the window) AND (b) a current graded run rates mode-and-subject-integrity pass-equivalent - recorded as a new decision on goal-mode-rubric-v2-2026-08-10. the honestly-non-deterministic criteria are reallocates-on-evidence, blender-kept-honest and right-container-for-the-work. Origin: WI-37394 (v1), goal-mode-rubric-v2-2026-08-10 (v2).\n\nv3 (2026-08-17): +1 criterion de-facto-activity-mix - the activity-SHAPE band check (P-007 of goal-mode-design-intent-hardening-2026-08-16; D-002: burst-attributed tool_invocations, never agent_modes).\n\nv49 (2026-09-27): the releaseGating sentence now states D-025's grounds and an explicit flip condition (independent grade on consult conv-mujymvaq found the P-014 wording superseded); prerequisites-are-edges-not-phases replication query 2 now reads harness_shared.work_item_deps (blocked_kind='goal'), the store applyGoalBlockedBy writes (packages/agent-mcp/src/tools/goals/goal-deps.ts), instead of goals.metadata.blockedBy, which no writer sets (reviewer su-b8df29a6, consult conv-mujyhboh).\n\nv51 (2026-10-02, WI-10005180, owner directives #1240/#1241): clause-level coverage audit of goal.md against this rubric (map: WI-10005180 checkpoint / goal-contract-coverage.md). Two criteria added for contract clauses no method enforced: work-placed-into-started-plans (rule 1 default route + planning initiative) and started-plans-staffed-and-claimed (every started plan, lane scoping, pickup verification, launch refusals). Eleven criteria revised: drain fence and spend accounting realigned with the revised contract (both had gone stale), owner-report 60-minute floor, grade/test trigger census, gap-review disposition truth, kickoff outline consult, premiseInvalidated handling, standing scope, receipts sibling-tool leg, scoped-continuation exemption for started-plan enumeration, and scope-aware-planning narrowed to clone/adopt/route. RUBRIC-WIDE RULE: NO PASS FROM ABSENCE (rev 51, WI-10005180): zero acts of the kind this criterion inspects is evidence of compliance only when the contract obligation behind it had NO trigger in the window. Rate unknown (not exercised) when there was no trigger; rate against the trigger census when there was one. Never write pass with evidence of the form \"zero X\" alone.\n\nv53 (2026-10-02, WI-10005180): cleanup of the two non-blocking defects reported at the rev 52 ratification (su-32d1b8df, 01:13Z). (a) spend-reported-and-goals-closed and standing-drain-fleet-per-goal: the superseded ~2x tolerance and positive-leaf mandate are deleted, not layered under SUPERSEDES blocks. (b) The one-item-plan-as-ceremony failure has a single owner, right-container-for-the-work. No criterion added or removed.\n\nv55 (2026-10-02, WI-10005180, review su-32d1b8df 01:28Z): standing-drain-fleet-per-goal driftMarkers no longer state the retired WI-5181 negative-leaf mechanism; the marker now matches method (c). No criterion added or removed.\n\n## Criteria — the structured `template_data`\n\nThe per-criterion model / method / drift markers live in `template_data` (read via\nrubrics:get or plans:get-template-data). Agents read/write the rubric structured, never\nby parsing this markdown.\n\n## Decisions\n\n(Use plans:add-decision to append.)\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"hosted-chat-pi-bearer-hardening-2026-10-02","title":"Hosted customer chat and New Session receive exact-tool PI bearers","status":"draft","created":"2026-10-02","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Hosted customer chat and New Session receive exact-tool PI bearers\nslug: hosted-chat-pi-bearer-hardening-2026-10-02\nstatus: draft\ncreated: 2026-10-02\nupdated: 2026-10-16\n---\n\n## Goal\nImplement the D-422/D-424 follow-up so hosted customer chat and New Session receive a short-lived MCP bearer bound to the authenticated hosted principal and an exact canonical tool allowlist. The server must enforce expiry and exact tool names; the superuser token must never enter customer-readable config.\n\n## Scope\n- Add durable finite expiry and exact tool-name grants to the existing PI session authority; enforce on tools/list and every direct or nested tool dispatch.\n- Wire hosted owner-trust chat running as the customer to mint and use the PI bearer.\n- Wire D-424 New Session so psu remains the service-user supervisor while its agent CLI runs as the customer and receives only the scoped PI bearer through the existing hosted identity wrapper.\n- Revoke grants at the end of their caller lifecycle; fail closed when the authenticated principal, bearer, grant, or expiry is missing.\n\n## Excluded\n- The HUD's “launch failed: failed to fetch” control-plane/UI diagnosis from source turn 22 remains separately scoped.\n- The cloud sign-in cross_origin_blocked report from source turn 25 is unrelated and excluded.\n- Do not repeat completed P-325/P-326 work. Do not place the operator superuser token in customer-readable files, and do not rely on ?tools= as an authorization check.\n\n## Acceptance\n- PI grants have persisted finite expiry and exact canonical tool-name authorization bound to the verified hosted principal/workspace/session.\n- Expired, ended, wrong-principal, or non-allowlisted grants are denied on list and direct/nested dispatch, even when the broad capability category matches; query filters cannot expand authority.\n- Hosted customer chat and D-424 New Session receive only the scoped bearer; missing grants fail closed, the superuser credential is absent, psu stays the service-user supervisor, and desktop/dev launch behavior remains unchanged.\n- Regression tests cover grant creation, expiry, revocation, exact-name allow/deny, hosted chat, and New Session. Coordinate live customer acceptance through WI-10001480's current acceptance owner.\n\n\n## Product shaping\n\nAudience: customers using hosted workspace chat and New Session.\n\nProblem: the customer OS account cannot safely receive the operator superuser bearer, and a query-only tool filter cannot authorize MCP calls.\n\nOutcome: both entry points receive a finite, caller-bound PI grant for exact tools while the existing service/customer process boundary remains intact.\n\nNon-goals: HUD fetch-error diagnosis, cloud sign-in, repeating completed BYOC P-325/P-326, or redesigning the hosted wrapper.\n\nSource authority: the original plan scope/acceptance and governing BYOC D-422/D-424. Original owner source recovered through sessions:read: session_turn:claude:9439bf55-2aad-428e-a6e9-18e25c927358:20 (chat has no tools), :22 (HUD failed-to-fetch, excluded), and :25 (cloud sign-in, excluded). The intervening source turns 21/23/24/26/27 were read as context. orders:get #772 confirms the chat report and its disposition.\n\nScenarios: a valid customer can use granted tools; removing ?tools= cannot add tools; another principal, expired or revoked grant is denied; closing/cancelling the caller revokes its grant; desktop/dev follows its current launch path.\n\n\n\n## Requirements\n\n**R-1 — Only a valid hosted grant authenticates.**\n\n```requirement\n\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Bind every hosted PI bearer to the verified hosted principal, workspace and caller session for a finite lifetime.\",\n    \"rationale\": \"A customer must never inherit operator authority or another customer session's grant.\",\n    \"constraints\": [\n      \"No grant from an unverified/missing hosted principal.\",\n      \"Missing expiry or grant fails closed.\",\n      \"Revoke at caller lifecycle end.\"\n    ],\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"byoc-cloud-workspaces-gcp-aws-azure-2026-08-22#D-422\",\n      \"byoc-cloud-workspaces-gcp-aws-azure-2026-08-22#D-424\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"A hosted PI bearer authenticates only while its persisted principal, workspace, session, expiry and revocation state match the verified caller.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"An expired, revoked, missing-grant or wrong-principal/workspace/session bearer is accepted.\",\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"integration\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Exercise mint/read/end against persisted PI state with positive control and each mismatched or expired identity; check finite expiry and revocation after cache warm-up.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/agent-mcp/src/auth.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/agent-mcp/src/provisioning.test.ts\",\n        \"libs/papercusp/libs/db/src/pi-session-ttl-tool-allowlist-migration.integration.test.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n```\n\n\n\n**R-2 — Exact tools bound every dispatch.**\n\n```requirement\n\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Enforce an exact canonical tool-name grant at tools/list and every direct or nested dispatch, intersected with existing capabilities.\",\n    \"rationale\": \"A display query or broad capability category cannot be the authorization boundary.\",\n    \"constraints\": [\n      \"Dropping or expanding ?tools= cannot expand authority.\",\n      \"Nested tools:invoke/code dispatch preserve the same principal.\",\n      \"Do not widen capability checks.\"\n    ],\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"byoc-cloud-workspaces-gcp-aws-azure-2026-08-22#D-422\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"List, direct call and nested dispatch expose or execute only the exact granted canonical tool names that also pass the existing capability checks.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"Any route lists or executes an ungranted tool, accepts a lookalike/alias expansion, or bypasses capability denial.\",\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"integration\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run allow/deny matrices with same-capability peer tools, empty/missing grants, altered query filters, direct calls and nested dispatch. Revoke/expire the session between dispatches and confirm denial.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/agent-mcp/src/server-dispatch.test.ts\",\n        \"libs/generic/tooldef/src/dispatch-stack.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/agent-mcp/src/auth.test.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n```\n\n\n\n**R-3 — Hosted chat uses its scoped bearer.**\n\n```requirement\n\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Restore Papercusp tools for customer-run owner-trust chat without exposing the operator superuser token.\",\n    \"rationale\": \"The D-421 isolation boundary intentionally withheld the old owner mount.\",\n    \"constraints\": [\n      \"Mint before the customer-UID spawn.\",\n      \"Fail closed without the verified principal or grant.\",\n      \"Revoke on success, failure and cancellation; finite expiry backs crash cleanup.\"\n    ],\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"byoc-cloud-workspaces-gcp-aws-azure-2026-08-22#D-422\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"A hosted customer chat turn receives only its principal-bound PI bearer and exact selected MCP toolset, with lifecycle cleanup and no operator superuser credential in customer-readable configuration.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"Hosted chat lacks the intended scoped mount, receives the operator credential, borrows another caller grant or retains a usable grant after its lifecycle.\",\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"integration\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Inspect the backend-bound MCP mount/config for customer and desktop/public controls; exercise grant mint/cleanup across success, failure and cancellation; reject missing identity before spawn.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/operator/__tests__/converse-toolset.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/operator/__tests__/converse.test.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n```\n\n\n\n**R-4 — New Session preserves the customer boundary.**\n\n```requirement\n\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Give D-424 New Session's customer-side agent CLI only a scoped PI bearer while psu remains the service-user supervisor.\",\n    \"rationale\": \"The customer cannot read Papercusp service code or its superuser credential.\",\n    \"constraints\": [\n      \"Reuse the existing hosted identity wrapper and toolchain.\",\n      \"Do not copy psu into the customer toolchain.\",\n      \"Desktop/dev behavior stays unchanged.\",\n      \"Coordinate a bounded customer acceptance run without reopening completed BYOC work.\"\n    ],\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"byoc-cloud-workspaces-gcp-aws-azure-2026-08-22#D-424\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"Hosted New Session keeps psu under the service identity and launches only the child agent CLI through the existing customer wrapper with the scoped PI bearer and no operator superuser token in customer-readable state.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"psu runs as the customer, the child runs as service user, customer state contains the operator credential, or desktop/dev launches change.\",\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"integration\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Trace launch-su/bootstrap to hosted psu environment and actual child command/config; test customer positive case, missing grant refusal, lifecycle revocation and desktop controls. Retain bounded live customer acceptance evidence separately before final acceptance.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/workspace-host/hosted-agent-identity.test.ts\",\n        \"apps/operator/scripts/psu-launcher-hosted-customer.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/bootstrap-su-bearer-non-transit.test.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n```\n\n\n\n## Design\n\nReuse the existing PI authority (packages/agent-mcp/src/provisioning.ts and auth.ts), shared MCP listing/dispatch authorization, and generic dispatcher. Extend the existing pi_sessions record and hosted-principal resolution seam as needed; do not add a parallel grant service or tool.\n\nReuse converse-toolset.ts/converse.ts for hosted chat and the D-424 hosted-agent-identity/psu environment plus bootstrap/launcher seams for New Session. The service parent may retain its own operator authority; only the scoped PI credential may cross into the customer child/config.\n\nCapability checks remain an independent intersection with the exact name grant. Expiry/revocation must be checked on each request and nested dispatch, including already-resolved principals and cached authentication. Missing hosted identity/grant/expiry fails closed.\n\nCompatibility for non-hosted callers must be explicit and tested; a nullable legacy allowlist must not silently become a hosted exact-tool grant.\n\nImplementation order stays P-001 → P-002 → P-003. P-003 is an engineering-derived regression/acceptance guard for the owner-requested behavior, not a new product promise.\n\n### Bar-to-work map for this plan\n\n| Requirement | Work | Evidence plane |\n\n| --- | --- | --- |\n\n| R-1 | P-001 | tree |\n\n| R-2 | P-001 | tree |\n\n| R-3 | P-002 | tree |\n\n| R-4 | P-002 | tree |\n\n\n\n## Now\n\nPreparation owner: WI-6554700010014128 (su-5a50dd3f-edeb-44fe-bb15-b817032771f1), authorized single-agent route. Draft admission remains in force.\n\n2026-10-15 readback: rev4 had no Requirements/Design, no first-class clauses, no local Decisions, no recorded activation/completion audit, no linked plan work-items, and empty prior-attempt history. The spec-triad preparation is being repaired here.\n\nReuse evidence: WI-10003615 is done; its persisted expiry/exact allowlist, MCP filtering and customer chat mount exist in current source. Treat its stored tests as historical evidence, not proof of this plan's full current contract.\n\nRemaining implementation questions: current converse minting explicitly lacks a hosted membership principal; PI allowed_tools is nullable for legacy compatibility; New Session's scoped bearer path needs full trace and tests. These are evidence-backed gaps to resolve after admission.\n\nWI-10001480 is done and the parent BYOC plan is shipped. Its former live owner is not assumed to hold this plan's acceptance; register a bounded P-003 acceptance handoff when implementation is ready.\n\nNext: audit the recovered original owner source; inspect the seeded acceptance rubric/first-class clauses, persist the acceptance class, obtain the required independent spec-quality review, then start only after admission succeeds. No owner-only approval or independent review is waived.\n\n\n## Phase 1 — PI grant authority\n\n- **P-001** `todo` Add a durable finite expiry and exact canonical tool-name allowlist to PI sessions, bound to the verified hosted principal/workspace/session. Enforce both grant dimensions at tools/list and every direct or nested tool dispatch; preserve capability checks and fail closed. importance: high\n\n## Phase 2 — Hosted chat and New Session\n\n- **P-002** `todo` Mint and propagate the scoped PI bearer to hosted owner-trust chat and the D-424 New Session agent CLI. Keep psu as the service-user supervisor, run only the child CLI as the customer through the existing hosted wrapper, and keep the operator superuser token out of customer-readable config. blocked-by: P-001 importance: high\n\n## Phase 3 — Regression and acceptance\n\n- **P-003** `todo` Add project-suite regression coverage for expiry, exact-name authorization, revocation, list/direct/nested dispatch, hosted chat, and New Session. Coordinate live customer acceptance through WI-10001480's current owner; leave the separate HUD fetch and cloud sign-in reports out of scope. blocked-by: P-001, P-002 importance: high\n\n## Decisions\n\n### D-001 — Acceptance BAR amendment\nDate: 2026-10-16\nAmendment-Id: amend-43aeb95cdf53309c403480db\nRequest-Hash: 5129ddbb2a58020af7db8799355ec85b236801c42d4c5a77cda02d109932980f\nActor: su-5a50dd3f-edeb-44fe-bb15-b817032771f1\nReason: Apply independently approved correction from nonexistent check path to the registered converse-toolset test, retaining the original outcome and scope.\nApproved-By: system:judge/su-470f18ef-0ef8-4fc2-983d-eefa3036b078\nApproval-Ref: thread-post:1184635\nApproved-At: 2026-10-16T14:37:56.668Z\nRubric revision: 3 → 4\nSubject plan revision: 7 → 8\nChanged BARs: R-3\nPrior evidence, grades, vetting, author verdicts, and ship verdicts remain audit history and are revision-ineligible.\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"acceptance-blender-evidence-driven-learning-redesign-2026-09-04","title":"Blender evidence-driven learning redesign acceptance","status":"active","created":"2026-10-03","owner":"su-aa2d6526-7743-44c8-85f9-edc95df6da16","archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Blender evidence-driven learning redesign acceptance\nslug: acceptance-blender-evidence-driven-learning-redesign-2026-09-04\nstatus: active\ntemplate: rubric\ncreated: 2026-10-03\nupdated: 2026-10-03\nowner: su-aa2d6526-7743-44c8-85f9-edc95df6da16\n---\n\n# Blender evidence-driven learning redesign acceptance\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** Rubric-template plan (template:rubric). (re-evaluated in the same write by the scope-write cascade, P-030/P-031)\n\nOwner-authorized follow-up. SELF implementation in AUTO; planning and source audit in progress, no product edit or shipped claim.\n\n**Next:** Audit current owner source, seed complete acceptance contracts and activate normally; implement P-001 onward under manual locks.\n\n## Promoted\n\n<!-- plan-pipeline: do not edit this block manually -->\n- [ ] WI-10005850 — Add a prepared-workspace beginner entry and recommended existing interactive defaults; retain honest no-ready-workspace guidance and an explicit advanced BYOC path. Validate and lint the extended sou… <!-- P-001 -->\n- [ ] WI-10005851 — Extend the lesson/controller and existing owner-bound session/chat controls for useful read-only notes-to-action-plan work, result review, revision practice and an independently written second task; … <!-- P-002 -->\n- [ ] WI-10005852 — Teach goal/context/review/approval/correction/verification, distinguish guide/agent/workspace stop semantics and costs, and extend existing help/voice with strict privacy-safe recovery categories. <!-- P-003 -->\n- [ ] WI-10005853 — Extend canonical unit/integration/Chromium/a11y/regression tests and docs, run current-build and required affected proof, bind exact evidence and pass independent test-adequacy review; preserve origi… <!-- P-004 -->\n- [ ] WI-10005854 — Observe real novice independent-task/approval/stop/cost acceptance, verify authenticated exact hosted artifact and rollback/default enablement, obtain normal independent plan acceptance, and ship thr… <!-- P-005 -->\n## Background\nAvi requested a follow-up to cloud-app-live-tutorial-2026-10-01 after a source-based review found its infrastructure-first/tool-inventory endpoint insufficient for novice independence. Owner request session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:5; approved suggestions are the assistant review session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:7 adopted explicitly by authorization session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:8. This is a distinct next lesson/UX contract, not a duplicate plan or a silent rewrite of the original plan's BAR.\n\n## Requirements\n**R-1 — Beginner entry without cloud administration.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"An authorized user can choose an already prepared healthy workspace and use the existing interactive agent defaults without supplying cloud credentials or configuring a machine. No eligible workspace yields an honest preparation/administrator explanation and an explicit advanced BYOC route, never an automatic billable provision, launch, repair or permission bypass.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:5\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:8\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The beginner entry allows an authorized user to select a prepared healthy workspace without supplying cloud-provider credentials or configuring a machine.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A prepared-workspace user must configure a provider, an unauthorized/unhealthy workspace is accepted, or any lesson action causes a hidden product mutation.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"tree\",\n      \"An authorized user can choose an already prepared healthy workspace and use the existing interactive agent defaults without supplying cloud credentials or configuring a machine. No eligible workspace yields an honest preparation/administrator explanation and an explicit advanced BYOC route, never an automatic billable provision, launch, repair or permission bypass.\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"e2e\",\n      \"integration\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run current-build prepared-workspace, no-workspace, unhealthy-workspace and advanced-BYOC journeys; assert exact user-action transport calls, permission scoping, recommended existing launcher defaults and zero tutorial-origin provisioning.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"apps/operator/lib/onboarding/cloud-tutorial-cloud.integration.test.tsx\",\n        \"apps/operator/e2e/cloud-tutorial.spec.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-2 — Useful first result and correction practice.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"The beginner path turns supplied meeting notes into a read-only action plan, teaches goal/context/output constraints, and lets the user explicitly request a revision. Each result is correlated to its own user request/session; inspection of a successful first result and successful revision is required and unrelated or failed outputs never certify progress.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:5\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:8\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The beginner lesson accepts guided-work completion only after the user reviews successful correlated first-task and revision answers.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A tool-inventory answer is the beginner outcome, a revision is not taught/exercised, or failed/unrelated results satisfy completion.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"tree\",\n      \"The beginner path turns supplied meeting notes into a read-only action plan, teaches goal/context/output constraints, and lets the user explicitly request a revision. Each result is correlated to its own user request/session; inspection of a successful first result and successful revision is required and unrelated or failed outputs never certify progress.\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"e2e\",\n      \"integration\",\n      \"unit\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run reducer and real session controls with first-result, revision, wrong-session, stale-response, pending/failure and inspect-before-success counterexamples. Preserve the v1 advanced first-agent path and never issue tools or outward-facing writes from the lesson.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/onboarding/cloud-tutorial-lesson.test.ts\",\n        \"apps/operator/lib/onboarding/cloud-tutorial-session.integration.test.tsx\",\n        \"apps/operator/e2e/cloud-tutorial.spec.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-3 — Independent second task and safe working relationship.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"The user can formulate a different second read-only task without a canned prompt, review its result, and is taught how to request a plan, explicitly approve consequential actions, correct an answer and verify it. Copy distinguishes pausing/closing the guide from stopping an agent and stopping a billed workspace; model and retained-resource costs remain explicit. Guide controls never masquerade as task cancellation or resource shutdown.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:5\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:8\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The beginner lesson accepts final completion only after the user reviews the successful correlated answer to a different self-written read-only task.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"The second task is merely replayed from a sample, completion can be clicked through without a successful correlated independent request, or safety copy implies guide pause stops agents/billing.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"tree\",\n      \"The user can formulate a different second read-only task without a canned prompt, review its result, and is taught how to request a plan, explicitly approve consequential actions, correct an answer and verify it. Copy distinguishes pausing/closing the guide from stopping an agent and stopping a billed workspace; model and retained-resource costs remain explicit. Guide controls never masquerade as task cancellation or resource shutdown.\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"e2e\",\n      \"integration\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Drive free-form second-task submission/review and refusal/delay recovery. Assert no sample fallback for blank input, correct cross-request evidence, explicit safety/cost explanations and real existing stop/navigation semantics without hidden cancel/stop writes.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"apps/operator/lib/onboarding/cloud-tutorial-session.integration.test.tsx\",\n        \"apps/operator/lib/onboarding/cloud-tutorial-guide.integration.test.tsx\",\n        \"apps/operator/e2e/cloud-tutorial.spec.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-4 — Private and actionable recovery.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Existing lesson Help and speech can explain a strictly allowlisted recovery category and relevant plain-language next action while staying within lesson advisory authority. Raw errors, credentials, tenant/provider identifiers and transcripts do not enter help/TTS/model context or analytics; unknown failures get an honest non-diagnostic fallback. Help cannot approve, complete, launch or retry product actions.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:5\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a10007-ad0d-7f13-baa3-570f3f19811e:8\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The lesson help context contains only bounded public lesson status and allowlisted recovery categories.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A raw/private value reaches help/TTS/telemetry, unsupported diagnostic detail is claimed, or advisory Help triggers a product mutation or domain success.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"tree\",\n      \"Existing lesson Help and speech can explain a strictly allowlisted recovery category and relevant plain-language next action while staying within lesson advisory authority. Raw errors, credentials, tenant/provider identifiers and transcripts do not enter help/TTS/model context or analytics; unknown failures get an honest non-diagnostic fallback. Help cannot approve, complete, launch or retry product actions.\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"integration\",\n      \"unit\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Exercise approved recovery categories, invalid/extra-field inputs and secret-shaped inputs at the authenticated server boundary; inspect exact model context and voice payload. Test AI/TTS outage and same-user/workspace lifecycle cancellation.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/onboarding/cloud-tutorial-help.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/onboarding/cloud-tutorial-help.integration.test.ts\",\n        \"apps/operator/lib/onboarding/cloud-tutorial-guide.integration.test.tsx\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-5 — Integrated compatibility and accessible current-build proof.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"The existing real test suites detect beginner-path progression, independent tasks, v1 progress compatibility, tenant switching, reload/resume, error recovery, keyboard/focus, reduced motion and speech fallback. Source-native specs reuse the component registry and existing tutorial IR. Avi asked to investigate failure rates approaching zero, usefulness and adoption, then approved this complete plan, AUTO execution and route:self through shipped status. Avoidable failures should approach zero; honest no-expert outcomes and measured exhausted capacity must remain explicit rather than hidden.\n\n## Background and measured baseline\nOriginal seven-day call window ending 2026-10-03 04:44Z: 301 completed calls / 135 caller IDs, including 148 general and 152 rubric-vetting calls. The extended matched completed-call cohort ending 05:01Z has 89 dispatch-enabled general calls with 48 feedback receipts, and 151 dispatch-enabled vetting calls with 120 receipts. Sixty general calls deliberately disabled dispatch and are not delivery failures. Counts exclude API/transport-failed calls. Receipt is not usefulness; expired rows can carry answers. These are historical snapshots, not current success promises.\nConfirmed incident EI-24933744867161288: four managed conversions logged native-confirmed seed delivery but were stopped as kickoff-proof-timeout; managed host never writes the parent's receipt. Source support gap WI-10002749 is existing work. Evidence-source and refill fixes EI-24833606853730057 / WI-10005360 were present on staging but absent from observed release build d740fc3802. Some launcher-only fixes do become live directly from the canonical tree: do not generalize release staleness to every process.\n\n## Product shaping\n\nThis restores the missing brief for already approved scope; it does not change any outcome, method, floor, cohort, independent acceptance requirement or execution route. Original owner turns were re-read on 2026-10-14 before authoring it. Partition every row exactly once into checked, unavailable, or residual. Preserve failures inside checked; do not hide them as unavailable. Healthy requires zero avoidable failures, no residual/unmeasured rows, and at least one native-confirmed substantive answer. A measured capacity wall is unavailable and never itself passes. All-unavailable/no-success is unknown.\\n\\nDeterministic bounded review: fix windowStart to the owner-authorized implementation start (2026-10-03T05:21:32.561Z) and windowEnd to the matrix artifact snapshot cut before reviewing quality. Population is this requester's consultations attributed to P-001..P-007 or their stamped work-items in that window, with substantive answers; retain missing requester project decision evidence as unknown rather than exclude it. Strata are same-backend dispatch, cross-backend dispatch, and archive/retrieval-only advice. Select the earliest eligible thread by creation timestamp then conversation id from each nonempty stratum, then fill from the remaining earliest eligible threads globally to eight distinct threads. Record the complete eligible population, stratum and selection rule, chosen eight ids, and any smaller population/shortfall; never backfill with unrelated historical threads or create calls to reach a quota. Useful = answers the stated unresolved decision with grounded actionable advice; partial = some relevant advice but a material question remains; contradictory = advice conflicts with inspected authoritative evidence or another recommendation and the conflict is documented. Requester decisions require requester-authored confirmed/rescoped/reversed/moot project decision evidence plus cited plan Decision where applicable. Missing project decision evidence is unknown, never inferred from receipt, silence, reviewer prose or subsequent code. Review quality and decision separately, including reason and exact post/Decision refs. Shortfall or unknown requester evidence is disclosed and cannot be silently scored healthy. This bounded current-build cohort does not estimate or overwrite historical fleet reliability/usefulness rates.\\n\\nManual-provenance artifact: docs/evidence/get-feedback-reliability-usefulness-adoption-2026-10-03-live.json, committed immutable bytes named by commit and SHA-256. The present registered scorecard resolver has no consult/pipeline lineage instrument, so check instrumentKey:none declares this explicit manual measurement; it is not an automatic pass.\\n\\nOwner sources19/22 remove mandatory reporting. Requester evidence is recovered from normal project work (existing decisions, task completion, source changes and answer consumption); missing evidence stays unknown/shortfall and no agent is required to submit a separate report. No parallel consultation service, ledger, monitor, cron, tool or persona. Defaults remain ON for routine delivery; no unregistered dark flag. (Pre-superseded next, no longer actionable: Avi reviews the detailed summary and draft; only after scope/approach approval and execution-route selection should the implementing session re-read the full conversation, record the activation audit and activate the plan.)\n\n## Background\n\nVerification already exists. Current source links promoted work-items to immutable spec revisions, requires current per-clause proof when the gate applies, distinguishes proposed/committed/ratified completion authority, and enforces contrastive root-cause records for successful bug/capability-gap fixes. The task is coverage and consistent discharge, not a new verification system.\n\nMeasured 2026-10-03 in the canonical staging source: plan-workitem-promotion-run.ts:827-839 attaches current immutable clause edges; complete.ts:3445-3476 chooses spec-gate invocation using declared changed/deleted paths or explicit specAdequacy; spec-test-adequacy-gate.ts:470-504 resolves the graph but returns non-applicable when no eligible clause resolves; spec-enforcement-eligibility.ts keeps historical/draft/unreconciled lanes distinct. These are source observations, not a census of live item outcomes or a demonstration that every possible bypass is currently exploitable.\n\n\n\n## Source conversation and provenance\n\nOriginal owner question: session_turn:codex:01a100bc-ce0b-7983-8066-c1591a881150:1 — how plan/item verification works, whether invariants/falsifiers carry through, and whether work-item verification should be added.\n\nRecommendation incorporated by reference: session_turn:codex:01a100bc-ce0b-7983-8066-c1591a881150:4 — tighten existing coverage, including standalone and no-file-change outcomes, rather than create another system.\n\nCurrent owner directive: session_turn:codex:01a100bc-ce0b-7983-8066-c1591a881150:5 — 'write this into a plan and show me the detailed summary'.\n\nR-1 through R-8 and P-001 through P-009 are agent-derived proposed decomposition of that recommendation, not owner-approved implementation decisions. The draft preserves questions and acceptance conditions for review; activation must map those owner turns and mark derived item provenance explicitly.\n\n\n\n## Scope and boundaries\n\nIn scope: admission/promotion contract coverage, immutable inheritance, applicability for standalone and verification-only work, successful completion-route parity, proof adequacy/freshness, appropriate non-code/manual evidence, migration of unreconciled active work, honest pickup/UI visibility and durable regressions.\n\nOut of scope: replacing the spec/BAR/scorecard substrate; new contract tables, bespoke verification tools or parallel services; weakening rootCauseVerification, grading independence or accepted requirements; blanket mandatory E2E/mutation tests for every outcome regardless of risk; retroactive regrading/reopening of shipped historical work; authoring a parallel monitor; force-deploying through a red gate.\n\nNew policy should be default-ON for its approved eligible cohort. Preserve established adoption boundaries; do not add an unregistered default-OFF feature flag. A policy exception is a recorded applicability/exemption decision, not silently treating missing proof as pass.\n\n\n\n## Requirements\n\n**R-1 — Every in-scope outcome has a resolved contract.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Every newly admitted substantive behavior-changing work-item, whether plan-bound or standalone, resolves its affected active behavior clauses or explicitly promotes a new clause; absence of a contract never counts as successful verification.\",\n    \"rationale\": \"Agent-derived implementation proposal answering Avi's verification questions; Avi authorized saving this proposal, not implementation.\",\n    \"constraints\": [\n      \"Reuse the existing versioned spec/BAR/evidence substrate.\",\n      \"Do not weaken existing causal or independent-grading checks.\",\n      \"Draft only until owner approval and route selection.\"\n    ],\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a100bc-ce0b-7983-8066-c1591a881150:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a100bc-ce0b-7983-8066-c1591a881150:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"Every newly admitted substantive behavior-changing work-item, whether plan-bound or standalone, resolves its affected active behavior clauses or explicitly promotes a new clause; absence of a contract never counts as successful verification.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"An in-scope feature, bug, change, or behavior-changing task reaches authoritative successful completion with no resolved obligation and no valid explicit exemption.\",\n    \"mandatory\": true,\n    \"role\": \"outcome\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"plan-bound behavior changes\",\n      \"standalone behavior changes\",\n      \"behavior-changing task classification\",\n      \"record-only and administrative boundaries\"\n    ],\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"integration\"\n    ],\n    \"passRatings\": [\n      \"healthy\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Use a table-driven applicability matrix and real datastore-backed admission/completion cases; contrast each applicable case with a genuine non-code or administrative control. preserve failure controls as well as passes.\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-2 — Plan obligations survive promotion with exact identity.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Promotion, pickup and cross-plan linking preserve every applicable invariant/behavior, concrete falsifier, verification policy and exact clause revision/fingerprint through the existing many-to-many graph; That plan is shipped; this is a narrow follow-up for remaining coverage/close-path boundaries, not a restart of its completed implementation.\n\nRespect that plan's #D-018: historical coverage reporting and truncation behavior must not be silently reinterpreted as proof of a complete enforced census. Any widening to new/adopted work is explicit in this plan and its tests.\n\nReuse machine-enforced-terminal-criteria-2026-09-05#D-011: the existing rootCauseVerification gate is stronger than a presence check. Do not replace it with a weaker duplicate. Reuse unified-requirement-contract-2026-09-05 and its current Intent / Acceptance / Verification model.\n\n\n\nCreation-time prior-art review (2026-10-03): work-item-completion-boundary-integrity-2026-08-20 is shipped and repaired atomic universal-coverage refusal/checkpoint-clearing provenance; its acceptance-work-item-completion-boundary-integrity-2026-08-20 rubric is superseded. evidence-complete-work-item-completion-preflight-2026-08-14 is superseded because generic under-evidenced closes already remain proposed and do not count toward burn-down. acceptance-design-to-code-coverage-seam-2026-09-02 is a superseded acceptance rubric for evidence falsifiability/instrument behavior. None of these historical siblings is an open implementation lane for missing-contract or zero-file-change obligation coverage.\n\nWhy this is a separate follow-up: leave those shipped/superseded records immutable and reuse their implemented machinery. This draft addresses the currently source-measured applicability boundary and narrow cohort adoption rather than reimplementing their existing generic evidence/preflight or provenance fixes. Creation's duplicate override is justified only by this reviewed scope distinction, not by a clean lexical search.\n\nCompatibility rule: do NOT resurrect a blanket generic completion preflight. Existing evidence-only insufficiency still records a proposed claim under the established record-and-warn/authority model. This plan's hard refusals are limited to explicitly applicable mandatory behavior obligations in the approved new/adopted cohort, composing with the already hard per-clause/causal gates. Record-only attempts remain available as notes and cannot manufacture successful settlement.\n\n### One applicability and discharge path\n\nExtend the existing behavior-contract resolver and enforcement-eligibility logic into the shared classifier consumed by admission, pickup, completion and rendered views. Use existing item-kind/family, typed outcome/contract relations and server-observed evidence; never infer an exemption solely from title prose, task labeling, no filesChanged or no source-plan stamp.\n\nFor newly eligible substantive behavior changes, require explicit affected-clause links or a promoted new active clause before authoritative successful completion. Reuse the existing ad-hoc clause scope and plan/spec verbs for standalone work; do not introduce another editable contract registry.\n\nAt successful close, resolve current obligations independently of whether code paths were declared. Validate current proof and settled grading before completion/state writes. Preserve recordOnly as annotation only. P-001 enumerates alternate successful terminal writers; each must invoke or preserve the same semantics rather than routing around complete.ts.\n\nTreat successful verification-only work as discharging an existing behavior obligation, not as requiring an artificial source edit. Preserve historical evidence when a revision changes; proof for the older revision does not become current by a status flip.\n\n\n\n### Evidence and exemptions\n\nEach applicable clause needs a precise behavior/invariant, an observation that falsifies it, the verification procedure, required scope/layers and current evidence policy. Ordinary unit tests, integration/E2E paths, negative calibration, mutation/counterexample or operational/manual evidence are selected by the existing clause/class/risk rules—not a blanket new test ladder.\n\nReuse spec-evidence-store, recorded testing runs, spec-test-adequacy evaluation and existing scorecard/grading-audit authority. Tests must distinguish a broken implementation from a repaired one; non-empty text or an unrelated green helper is insufficient. No caller-supplied fingerprint assertion can manufacture server-measured freshness.\n\nLegitimate non-code, administrative, candidate and historical cases have explicit applicability or exemption reasons and appropriate retained outcome evidence. Existing hard defect-causality and universal-coverage checks remain intact. Unknown/unavailable evidence is represented explicitly and cannot establish acceptance.\n\n\n\n### Safe legacy adoption\n\nProduce a bounded dry-run census with explicit population, omitted/unknown rows and live owners; it is not complete unless the query population was actually exhausted. Separate new/adopted, unreconciled active, historical and candidate cohorts.\n\nUse existing per-plan/ad-hoc reconciliation. Repair missing clauses/falsifiers/methods/links using the canonical writers and the recorded BAR amendment path when meaning changes. Coordinate active holders; do not seize claims or bypass file locks. Apply idempotent bounded batches and preserve original revisions, evidence history and accepted outcomes.\n\nDo not add a background routine solely for rollout. Reuse the existing reconciliation/reporting surfaces; future monitoring or schedule authoring requires a separate explicit request.\n\n\n\n### Human and agent view\n\nExtend existing claim/pickup/read and work-item/plan views to expose exact obligations, current/missing/stale/unknown/exempt proof and completion authority separately from lifecycle state. The displayed enforced set and refusal reasons derive from the same classifier as the gate. Refusals name clause/work-item identity, the failed obligation and a repair path through existing tools.\n\n\n\n### Bar-to-work map for this plan\n\n| bar | implementing plan items | evidence plane |\n\n|---|---|---|\n\n| R-1 | P-001, P-002, P-003 | tree |\n\n| R-2 | P-002, P-004 | tree |\n\n| R-3 | P-001, P-003, P-008 | tree |\n\n| R-4 | P-004, P-008 | tree |\n\n| R-5 | P-001, P-005, P-008 | tree |\n\n| R-6 | P-006, P-008 | tree |\n\n| R-7 | P-007, P-008 | tree |\n\n| R-8 | P-008, P-009 | tree |\n\n\n\n## Phase 1 — Applicability and contract inheritance\n\n- **P-001** `dropped` Establish the finite applicability/entry-path matrix and baseline: plan-bound and standalone behavior changes, behavior-changing tasks, verification-only closes, non-code/manual work, recordOnly, duplicate/discard, historical/draft/unreconciled scopes and every actual successful terminal writer found in source. Record source measurements and add failing regression controls for the intended coverage widening. importance: normal — note: Dropped by owner (Avi 2026-10-06): see D-004 — no measured case for the enforcement (WI-10005914 census, WI-10006249 escape rate).\n\n- **P-002** `dropped` Extend existing admission, plan promotion and standalone/ad-hoc linking so eligible work resolves every affected clause with immutable revision/fingerprint identity; preserve many-to-many/cross-plan coverage and historical proof, with idempotent promotion and registered unit/PostgreSQL integration tests. importance: normal blocked-by: P-001 — note: Dropped by owner (Avi 2026-10-06): see D-004 — no measured case for the enforcement (WI-10005914 census, WI-10006249 escape rate).\n\n\n\n## Phase 2 — Consistent completion and adequate proof\n\n- **P-003** `dropped` Enforce current resolved obligations across the successful terminal entry paths enumerated by P-001, independent of empty/omitted filesChanged or specAdequacy; reject missing/inadequate/stale required proof before successful completion/state writes, preserve recordOnly and state/authority/burn-down semantics, and add entry-path regression tests with real persistence. importance: normal blocked-by: P-002 — note: Dropped by owner (Avi 2026-10-06): see D-004 — no measured case for the enforcement (WI-10005914 census, WI-10006249 escape rate).\n\n- **P-004** `dropped` Close evidence-adequacy/freshness coverage gaps using the existing binding/evaluator/scorecard substrate; test falsifier calibration, required scenarios/layers, actual entry-path/oracle reachability, current source/test/fixture/environment identities and settled grading audits. Preserve contrastive root-cause verification verbatim and failing/repaired evidence history. importance: normal blocked-by: P-003 — note: Dropped by owner (Avi 2026-10-06): see D-004 — no measured case for the enforcement (WI-10005914 census, WI-10006249 escape rate).\n\n- **P-005** `dropped` Implement intentional non-code/manual/administrative/historical applicability and exemption handling with retained evidence and replication procedures; ensure relabeling or absent changed paths cannot exempt active behavior obligations, and add paired legitimate-exemption and evasion tests. importance: normal blocked-by: P-004 — note: Dropped by owner (Avi 2026-10-06): see D-004 — no measured case for the enforcement (WI-10005914 census, WI-10006249 escape rate).\n\n\n\n## Phase 3 — Adoption and visibility\n\n- **P-006** `dropped` Extend the existing reconciliation/adoption flow with a bounded dry-run cohort census and idempotent per-object repairs; migrate approved unreconciled active work without rewriting accepted BAR meaning, losing historical proof, reopening shipped work or taking peer claims. Add real datastore-backed adoption/history/ownership regressions. importance: normal blocked-by: P-005 — note: Dropped by owner (Avi 2026-10-06): see D-004 — no measured case for the enforcement (WI-10005914 census, WI-10006249 escape rate).\n\n- **P-007** `dropped` Expose the shared resolved obligations and evidence/authority states through existing pickup/read/UI surfaces; distinguish terminal/proposed/committed/ratified, name explicit exemptions and actionable failures, and add API/component plus actual current-build journey tests. importance: normal blocked-by: P-005 — note: Dropped by owner (Avi 2026-10-06): see D-004 — no measured case for the enforcement (WI-10005914 census, WI-10006249 escape rate).\n\n\n\n## Phase 4 — Independent acceptance and shipment\n\n- **P-008** `dropped` Run the registered adversarial acceptance matrix through the real public entry paths and PostgreSQL persistence, including zero-file-change verification, standalone missing-contract, cross-plan/revision churn, weak/stale/skipped proof, pending grading, relabeling and alternate-close controls. Confirm normal affected-test registration and keep enumerated coverage plus owned residue. This is additional acceptance; every earlier item ships its own tests. importance: normal blocked-by: P-006, P-007 — note: Dropped by owner (Avi 2026-10-06): see D-004 — no measured case for the enforcement (WI-10005914 census, WI-10006249 escape rate).\n\n- **P-009** `dropped` Update canonical docs through docs:author, perform the current-tree completion audit, obtain outside-lineage independent acceptance grading and explicit author judgment, then verify normal final promotion/shipment separately from staging acceptance. Report exact artifact evidence; respect live gate ownership and never force past red without explicit owner approval. importance: normal blocked-by: P-008 — note: Dropped by owner (Avi 2026-10-06): see D-004 — no measured case for the enforcement (WI-10005914 census, WI-10006249 escape rate).\n\n\n\n## Verification and acceptance procedure\n\nBefore implementation activation, re-read the full owner conversation and register plans:audit phase:activation with requirement mappings and derived itemProvenance. The draft is not activation-audited and must not be treated as ready/active.\n\nEvery implementation item includes conventional project-framework tests in the same change. Extend existing unit/integration suites; add the planned E2E spec under apps/operator/e2e and register it in normal selection. Required test layers come from each R-N, not from a universal maximal suite.\n\nUse testing:run and existing evidence-binding/evaluation tools so run identities, failure controls and freshness are reproducible. Use dev:pipeline_position with the exact changed path/test class to select the current-build acceptance route. Ordinary implementation acceptance runs on current staging/isolated build, not deployed green main.\n\nAcceptance battery: eligible no-contract refusal; inherited identity/loss controls; standalone and cross-plan coverage; no-file-change and explicit-attestation parity; each inventoried successful close path; skipped/filtered/helper-only/stale/weak-oracle/missing-scenario proof; pending/failed grading audits; positive passing controls; legitimate non-code/manual/admin/historical controls; bounded/idempotent adoption; displayed-gate parity.\n\nEnumerate the matrix population and place each case once in checked/notChecked/notApplicable with explicit owned residue. Do not claim every route/case is verified from a partial inventory or truncated result.\n\nFinal plan acceptance requires the completion audit, current adequate requirement proof, vetted as-built acceptance rubric, outside-lineage grading and explicit author acceptance. Final normal-pipeline promotion/deployment has its own shipped-artifact verification; no staging test is relabeled as shipment proof.\n\n\n\n## Proposed design decisions\n\n1. Reuse one contract graph and one canonical applicability/discharge policy; no duplicate store or checkbox-based verification system.\n\n2. Required proof follows the promised behavior, not filesChanged, the presence of a plan stamp or a caller's convenient item label.\n\n3. Close only the declared eligible-cohort gap; preserve genuine non-code/manual/historical and administrative outcomes with explicit reasons.\n\n4. Draft status is an approval boundary. The current authorization is to write and explain this plan only.\n\n\n\n## Risks and open review points\n\n- Classifying behavior-changing tasks incorrectly can create either bypasses or impossible non-code obligations; P-001/P-005 must prove both sides.\n\n- Alternate terminal writers may have distinct semantics. Inventory before changing them; do not conflate discard or historical reconciliation with successful remediation.\n\n- Legacy adoption can freeze live work if widened wholesale. Keep finite cohorts, explicit owners, dry-run evidence and idempotent repair.\n\n- Proof revision/identity bookkeeping can create expensive re-grading churn. Reuse current matching/freshness rules and preserve unaffected evidence rather than inventing a new identity layer.\n\n- UI claims must not exceed source completeness or evidence authority. Unknown/truncated stays visible.\n\n- Avi still needs to approve implementation scope and choose execution route/model/account/carry if a fleet is desired. No route is being offered or launched by this drafting task.\n\n\n\n## Planning record\n\nAuthoring work-item: WI-10005914. Sources were re-read in this conversation; the plan is a source-grounded proposal, not an implementation completion claim. Implementation files changed: none.\n\n## Decisions\n\n### D-001 — Draft-only authorization and conversation provenance\nDate: 2026-10-03\nAvi authorized saving and explaining this proposal, not implementation. Keep lifecycle draft and do not call plans:start, admit implementation work, schedule work or launch a fleet. Before later ready/active transition, re-read the complete source conversation and record the activation audit with derived item provenance; then obtain Avi's approval and execution-route choice. Owner sources: session_turn:codex:01a100bc-ce0b-7983-8066-c1591a881150:1 and :5; incorporated agent proposal: the same session's :4. These proposed implementation choices are reviewable, not owner-approved rulings.\nRelated: P-001, P-009\n\n### D-002 — Reuse existing contracts and preserve proposed-authority compatibility\nDate: 2026-10-03\nReuse first-class-spec-clauses-and-prior-attempt-briefs-2026-08-20#D-012/#D-013 and machine-enforced-terminal-criteria-2026-09-05#D-011. No parallel registry, new generic completion preflight, replacement causal schema or verification checkbox. Existing generic evidence-only insufficiency remains a retained proposed claim and does not count toward burn-down. The new hard-gate scope is only explicit mandatory behavior obligations in the approved new/adopted cohort. Creation-time duplicates were read: shipped work-item-completion-boundary-integrity-2026-08-20 fixed atomic coverage/checkpoint provenance; its acceptance rubric and evidence-complete-work-item-completion-preflight-2026-08-14 and acceptance-design-to-code-coverage-seam-2026-09-02 are superseded historical scopes, not this implementation lane. \n\nMeasured: plans:get of those Objective/Approach/Now/Background sections on 2026-10-03 returned the historical scopes stated above. packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/complete.ts:3533-3579 already hard-refuses incomplete successful defect causality records.\nRelated: P-001, P-002, P-003, P-004, P-005\n\n### D-003 — Behavior-owned obligations, explicit exemptions, bounded adoption\nDate: 2026-10-03\nProposed policy: whether mandatory proof applies is derived from the resolved behavior contract and approved eligibility cohort, not solely a source-plan stamp, filesChanged or a convenient task/manual label. Apply the same policy to pickup, success settlement and the rendered view; preserve recordOnly as notes, legitimate non-code/manual evidence, administrative discard and historical/candidate exemptions. New approved eligible work defaults to enforcement; migrate unreconciled active work through existing bounded dry-run/idempotent adoption with peer ownership and accepted BAR meaning intact. Do not weaken historical/truncation boundaries from first-class-spec-clauses-and-prior-attempt-briefs-2026-08-20#D-018. \n\nMeasured: 2026-10-03 source reads of packages/operator-core/lib/plan-workitem-promotion-run.ts:827-839 show revision-edge attachment; packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/complete.ts:3445-3476 conditions spec-gate invocation on paths or attestation; packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/spec-test-adequacy-gate.ts:470-504 returns non-applicable when no eligible clause resolves. P-001/P-008 must turn the precise matrix into durable controls; this is not a claim of a complete live-item census.\nRelated: P-001, P-003, P-005, P-006, P-007, P-008\n\n### D-004 — Dropped by owner: no measured case for the enforcement\nDate: 2026-10-06\n[owner:Avi 2026-10-06, interactive AskUserQuestion answer \"Drop it\"] Avi dropped this draft after two read-only measurements. (1) Census (comment on WI-10005914): the zero-file-list skip affects at most ~50 closes in 30 days, and a sample of them were genuine no-code work. (2) Escape rate (WI-10006249): the share of code-changing closes named as the cause of a later bug is about 3% for standalone change items, bug fixes and spec-clause plan features alike (n=8 sample per kind). No measured case justifies the R-1 clause requirement or the R-3 completion gate; Avi's stated concern was avoiding the friction the first BAR/verification rollout caused. Nothing from this plan was implemented.\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"acceptance-generalized-integrations-google-migration-cupboard-workflows-2026-10-05","title":"Acceptance: generalized provider integrations, Google migration and portable Cupboard workflows","status":"superseded","created":"2026-10-05","owner":"su-a973d2b0-0677-4a5b-b483-93676730c9e9","archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Acceptance: generalized provider integrations, Google migration and portable Cupboard workflows\nslug: acceptance-generalized-integrations-google-migration-cupboard-workflows-2026-10-05\nstatus: superseded\ntemplate: rubric\ncreated: 2026-10-05\nupdated: 2026-10-06\nowner: su-a973d2b0-0677-4a5b-b483-93676730c9e9\n---\n\n# Acceptance: generalized provider integrations, Google migration and portable Cupboard workflows\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** Rubric-template plan (template:rubric). Its structured fields (characteristic,\ncriteria, ratingScale, methodRef) live in `template_data`, queried via\nrubrics:list/get/search; this body is the narrative model/method context. Status\n`active` ⇒ a active rubric.\n\n**Next:** An independent reviewer (or the owner/su) ratifies a proposed rubric by promoting\nthis plan to `active` (rubrics:ratify / plans:set-plan-status); the proposer cannot\nself-ratify. Agents read/write the rubric structured, never\nby parsing this markdown.\n\n## Decisions\n\n(Use plans:add-decision to append.)\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"acceptance-pot-review-integration-mode-2026-10-05","title":"Acceptance BAR — Pot working-copy mode: a pot's combined, tested work reaches the main repo only through a PR","status":"superseded","created":"2026-10-05","owner":"su-56e2f83b-010d-4f42-b750-19bc8fde6ea5","archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Acceptance BAR — Pot working-copy mode: a pot's combined, tested work reaches the main repo only through a PR\nslug: acceptance-pot-review-integration-mode-2026-10-05\nstatus: superseded\ntemplate: rubric\ncreated: 2026-10-05\nupdated: 2026-10-06\nowner: su-56e2f83b-010d-4f42-b750-19bc8fde6ea5\n---\n\n# Acceptance BAR — Pot working-copy mode: a pot's combined, tested work reaches the main repo only through a PR\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** Rubric-template plan (template:rubric).
