Retain receipt53 as OPEN negative evidence when its immutable fences differ.\"}}\n```\n\n## Design\n\n### Bar-to-work map for this plan\n\n| bar | implementing plan items | evidence plane |\n|---|---|---|\n| R-1 | P-001, P-004, P-005 | live |\n| R-2 | P-003, P-005 | live |\n| R-3 | P-002, P-003, P-005 | live |\n| R-4 | P-001, P-003, P-004, P-005 | live |\n| R-5 | P-001, P-002 | live |\n| R-6 | P-003, P-005 | live |\n| R-7 | P-005 | live |\n\n\n### Proposed sources, in priority order\n\n1. **Primary provider changes:** [official OpenAI documentation changelog](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/changelog), [Claude Platform release notes](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview), [Gemini API release notes](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog), plus official engineering/research posts and model deprecation notices. Watch developer changes, not just launch headlines.\n2. **Upstream code:** GitHub Releases/API and changelog diffs for Papercusp's real dependencies plus shortlisted tooling: MCP SDKs/spec, coding CLIs, agent frameworks, durable-workflow tools, retrieval/local inference and evaluation tools. Derive the actual watchlist from package manifests/lockfiles and existing Papercusp review reports. Verify license, maintenance and released capability; popularity is discovery, not evidence. [GitHub releases API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/releases/releases).\n3. **Research:** arXiv cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.LG, cs.SE, filtered by the Papercusp topics above, plus [Hugging Face Daily Papers](https://huggingface.co/papers) as a discovery/prioritization layer. [arXiv RSS documentation](https://info.arxiv.org/help/rss.html). Read original paper/repo for claims; distinguish preprint results from shipped capability.\n4. **News discovery:** Google News targeted topics/searches; Techmeme for clustered industry coverage; direct TechCrunch AI, Ars Technica, MIT Technology Review and Reuters reporting. Independent original journalism is valid evidence for industry/security/business stories; technical capability claims still need documentation, released code or paper evidence.\n5. **Core AI aggregators:** smol.ai AINews (https://news.smol.ai/), TLDR AI (https://tldr.tech/ai/archives), AlphaSignal (https://alphasignal.ai/). Follow their upstream links; preserve discovery provenance; verify automated/social summaries. No sole-source dependence.\n6. **Supplemental analysis:** Last Week in AI (https://lastweekin.ai/), Import AI (https://importai.substack.com/), Ben's Bites (https://www.bensbites.com/), The Rundown AI (https://www.therundown.ai/), Simon Willison, Latent Space and The Batch. These are checked only on their publication days; weekly sources are not treated as fresh daily reporting. Distinguish sponsorship/vendor relationships.\n7. **Optional machine search:** GDELT DOC API (no new paid subscription needed) and Brave News Search API only if an existing authorized credential is available. Do not purchase subscriptions or promise supported feeds without reachability/terms checks. Google News feed discovery must be tested; unsupported RSS is not our only ingestion path.\n\nPrefer official RSS/Atom and APIs when available; otherwise bounded page fetch/diff. Do not invent an official RSS feed for a site that offers only HTML. Web search is supplemental discovery; reports must resolve citations to primary sources. External queries must not contain private Papercusp source, secrets or unreleased design details.\n\n### Daily run contract\n\nCollect -> normalize date/version/canonical id -> deduplicate against previous successful reports -> shortlist -> fetch primary evidence -> compare to Papercusp's existing implementation/plans -> write brief -> `reports:publish` -> `reports:get` readback -> deliver a one-line in-app notification with the returned report link.\n\nReport: dated **Papercusp AI Brief**, short executive summary, up to 5-10 material items, grouped **Act now / Worth testing / Watch**. Each item: what changed, announcement/event dates, why it matters, existing Papercusp seam or overlap, confidence/limitations, recommended next action and primary links. Include breaking changes/security notices first, skipped/unavailable sources, run window and runtime/cost. Produce an explicit \"no material updates\" report on quiet days; do not fill it with stale stories.\n\n### Reuse and delivery\n\nUse `reports:publish|get|list` and the existing Reports-library viewer work. Finish or coordinate the minimal owner-view path within `reports-library-2026-09-15`; do not create a second store or duplicate those implementation items. A broader first-class Research tab/project/evidence/decision workspace is OUT OF SCOPE unless Avi adds it.\n\nThe setup plan is NOT itself the daily template. P-004 creates a separate reusable scheduled template containing ONLY the daily procedure, so setup work is never rerun every morning. Native route: `plans:set-schedule` then `plans:arm-schedule`; confirm per-item success, not merely the wrapper's top-level ok.\n\nSuggested recurrence: `FREQ=DAILY;BYHOUR=9;BYMINUTE=0;BYSECOND=0`, `tzid=America/New_York` pending Avi's confirmation. 09:00 means start time, not a guarantee the finished report is present at 09:00; ask whether Avi instead wants it ready BY 09:00. `concurrency=skip`, no backlog flood. Validate actual scheduled research dispatch: current schedule executorKind accepts feature/chunk, NOT the retired research-task kind. Use the existing registered blueprint-operation/execution seam if available; never accidentally dispatch the coding spine or hand-roll a new scheduler.\n\n### Execution architecture\n\nExtend the existing research blueprint with a bounded morning AI brief operation targeting the built-in non-code task kind and researcher role. Materialize a repo-less dedicated harness through harness:create; this is a scoped instance of the existing engine, not a new service or scheduler. The operation receives the approved source URLs/topics, 24-hour lookback, publication policies and max-items bound. Pin its structured result schema to report id, dated edition, citation/source counts and incomplete-source disclosure. Declare only required read/fetch, work-item and report-publish/read tools; no code/file-write, external-send or paid-subscription authority. Use plans:set-schedule.schedule.operation to dispatch through system:blueprint-operation with the native occurrence request key. All runs publish through the Reports library.\n\nCanonical source artifacts: libs/papercusp/packages/harness/blueprints/morning-ai-intelligence/blueprint.yaml and its conventional orchestrator blueprint unit test. The YAML is an extends:research child, produced and validated through blueprint:extend before persistence. Source-list and result-contract fixtures belong in the real test suite. A testable structured contract is preferred over a bare prompt or a bespoke orchestration loop.\n\n### Authorization and open choices\n\nAvi's session turn 13 grants AUTO and direct/self execution through shipped status. In-app publication, the 09:00 America/New_York recurrence and scheduled research spend are within that approved objective. Do not send external email/social posts or buy paid data subscriptions. A broad Research hub remains out of scope. Re-audit the full source conversation after meaningful changes.\n\nChosen defaults: start at 09:00 (not ready-by), daily including weekends; primary-first/free-access source mix plus aggregators above; in-app report library and notification. Keep collection bounded; no monetary budget cap, as explicitly approved by Avi in D-004. Use the existing research execution seam; do not hand-roll a scheduler.\n\n## Phase 1 — One-time setup, after approval\n\n- **P-001** `todo` Bind the existing research execution path, derive its bounded read-only tool scope and record the proven Research history/provenance gap; audit approved source conversation and plan admission first. — note: ← WI-10007222 blocker cleared\n- **P-002** `blocked` Integrate with the other agent's Reports-library publisher/viewer; coordinate retry-safe publication and latest-series navigation, then verify owner-visible links and dated history. Do not implement or claim their UI lane (D-001). blocked-by: P-001\n- **P-003** `blocked` Configure the source watchlist and daily run procedure using existing fetch/search/report surfaces; add canonical fixture tests for freshness, deduplication, coverage and citations. blocked-by: P-001\n- **P-004** `blocked` Author and validate the separate daily template, set the confirmed local-time recurrence, then arm it through the native autonomy gate only after report-view readiness and explicit approval. blocked-by: P-002, P-003\n- **P-005** `blocked` Run one end-to-end brief, verify real research dispatch, report readback, owner-visible link/history and next morning fire; independently accept the setup against the requirements. blocked-by: P-004\n\n## Verification\n\nImplementation tests must be added to the project's conventional suites, not throwaway scripts. No implementation tests were run for this draft. Instrument checks marked none are draft placeholders: bind the actual operational/e2e check and test artifacts after the approved design, before activation or acceptance; they are not executable proof. Current evidence is authoritative plan/work-item reads, current blueprint/migration/navigation/tool source, and fetched official source pages. A stored publish record is not proof of a rendered accessible page; verify the actual viewer before claiming delivery.\n\n## Decisions\n\nNo execution decisions have been ratified. Proposed reuse and policies above await Avi's review.\n\n### D-001 — Owner-assigned split: this session owns AI intelligence, another agent owns the shared Reports library\nDate: 2026-10-07\nAffects: reports-library-2026-09-15\nOwner directive, Avi, 2026-10-07: \"I put another agent on our reports-library-2026-09-15 plan. they will start it soon, You will focus on the ai report plan\". This session is the direct/self AI-report lane; it must not implement or claim the other agent's Reports-library UI lane. P-002 is henceforth an INTEGRATION DEPENDENCY and acceptance check, not permission to implement reports-library P-006/P-007/P-008/P-009. Continue independent source collection, relevance scoring, cited composition, research dispatch and scheduling preparation while the Reports UI is built; only final owner-view/link acceptance depends on that UI.\n\nReuse the existing shared reports:publish/get/list/search surfaces and viewer. No separate AI-news report table, report reader, search index or scheduler. Recommended details (proposed, not owner-ratified): use an existing series tag for the AI brief; new days are separate editions, supersedes is only a correction to the SAME edition; require retry-safe publication keyed to the run before recurring activation; make a dated report, its coverage and source URLs explicit. The authority split is owner-directed; the technical improvements need the normal review/acceptance in the Reports lane.\n\nMeasured: reports-library-2026-09-15 Requirements R1-R11 and Design were read on 2026-10-07; packages/operator-core/lib/report-library.ts publishReport generates a new randomUUID report_id and inserts a new row; agent-tools/reports/publish.ts has no requestKey argument. Current source already reuses one report store and allows immutable correction lineage. This is an integration-design finding, not a completed runtime duplication reproduction. More detail: WI-10007198.\nRelated: P-001, P-002, P-003, P-004, P-005\n\n### D-002 — Research producer and daily-template execution contracts are pinned and tested; recurring safety remains an acceptance gate\nDate: 2026-10-07\nAffects: papercusp-ai-brief-daily-2026-10-07\nMeasured: libs/papercusp/packages/harness/blueprints/morning-ai-intelligence/blueprint.yaml and packages/operator-core/lib/blueprint/morning-ai-intelligence.test.ts use the existing research operation/schema validator. Extend the existing GoalPackagesRail rather than introduce another package/goal store. Expose the existing standing/package identity through narrowed client types and existing resolver fields as needed. Featured cards and compact strips share one pure model and one render path. Reuse the existing goals.detail cache for real summaries; the goal popup continues using its own existing single detail payload. Treat an active but dormant/lost holder as attention, and unknown liveness as unknown. Keep actual spend windows beside each amount. Suppress only the current instance that is represented above the ordinary board. Priority lanes link to existing plans; outcome rows link to existing work items. Tracked WI-6554700010019655.\nRelated: P-001\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"papercusp-server-crash-loop-startup-cleanup-2026-10-07","title":"Alert on unregistered server crash loops and clean up failed PostgreSQL boot","status":"awaiting-acceptance","created":"2026-10-07","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Alert on unregistered server crash loops and clean up failed PostgreSQL boot\nslug: papercusp-server-crash-loop-startup-cleanup-2026-10-07\nstatus: awaiting-acceptance\ncreated: 2026-10-07\nupdated: 2026-10-16\n---\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** Implementation verified and completion audit #2 recorded against 25a4d821622e1af0a9bd4036aed076717e358fc9. Original repairs are committed on WI-10006517; P-001 verification corrected the integration stop-spy dependency identity. Focused tests passed 149 reconciler, 53 desktop, 4 embedded-PG. Plan acceptance remains blocked at independent rubric vetting, before proof binding/grade; no ship/deploy claim.\n\n**Next:** Coordinator su-08effe51-78b5-4d54-a1ff-c82b159eaf20 must identify an already authorized independent vetter or obtain Avi's authorization to change the one-agent limit; then vet/attest current rubric before bind/cards/grade. Retrieval-only consult conv-mv94989s-0000-034fc33ce1f54bdba3ab8dff5fac706d returned no_qualified_responder.\n\n## Background\nA fresh journal query measured 2,577 matching non-zero exits since 2026-10-03 02:16 EDT; systemd reports NRestarts=2577 and the packaged service is inactive/dead now. The earlier 3,572 count is retracted and is not a measured value. The existing supervisor checks NRestarts for registered services, while the unregistered host census only lists FAILED units. Migration errors occur inside startEmbeddedPostgresServer before ensurePostgres returns a handle, so serve.ts cannot clean up that postmaster.\n\nThis execution plan reuses critical-process-supervisor-2026-07-04 decisions D-001 and D-002. That design plan has all six items terminal and is awaiting acceptance; this bug also needs embedded-Postgres boot cleanup, so a focused execution plan keeps the new defect and its acceptance evidence together.\n\n## Requirements\n**R-1 — Active unregistered crash loops.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Detect non-transient restart loops among unregistered systemd user services.\",\"rationale\":\"The failed-unit-only census misses Restart=on-failure units that remain active between exits.\",\"constraints\":[\"Report the restart loop without taking restart authority away from systemd.\"],\"sourceRefs\":[\"WI-10006517\",\"critical-process-supervisor-2026-07-04#D-002\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"When an unregistered, non-transient unit's NRestarts increases by at least three within five minutes, the reconciler reports one alert for that episode; subsequent reconciliations in the same episode do not duplicate it.\",\"falsifier\":\"The threshold crossing is missed, a transient unit is included, a registered unit's behavior regresses, Papercusp restarts the unit, or the same episode emits duplicate alerts.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run the unit reconciler tests for restart-count threshold detection, latching, transient exclusion, and report-only behavior.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/supervision/unit-reconciler.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n**R-2 — Bounded service restarts.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Set an explicit start limit on the packaged papercusp-server.service unit.\",\"rationale\":\"A deterministic failure should eventually become failed so the supervisor's existing failed-unit alert can report it.\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"WI-10006517\",\"critical-process-supervisor-2026-07-04#D-001\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"The packaged papercusp-server.service explicitly sets StartLimitIntervalSec=600 and StartLimitBurst=6, matching critical-process-supervisor D-001.\",\"falsifier\":\"Either value is missing or differs from the D-001 interval and burst.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run the registered desktop sidecar installation test and inspect the packaged unit assertions for both start-limit values.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"requirements\"}}}\n```\n\n**R-3 — Startup failure cleanup.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Stop embedded Postgres gracefully when startup or migrations fail before the server handle is returned.\",\"rationale\":\"The outer serve.ts cleanup cannot stop a process through a handle that startup never returned.\",\"constraints\":[\"Rethrow the original startup error after cleanup.\"],\"sourceRefs\":[\"WI-10006517\",\"session_turn:codex:01a11496-1de8-7f11-9361-c4737dbec8ce:7\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"If startup or migrations fail after the embedded Postgres process starts but before startEmbeddedPostgresServer returns its handle, the startup path stops Postgres and then rethrows the original error.\",\"falsifier\":\"A started Postgres process is left running, cleanup masks the startup error, or serve.ts is required to clean up through a handle that was never returned.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run a focused failure-path regression test that observes graceful shutdown and the original migration error.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"requirements\"}}}\n```\n\n**R-4 — Regression coverage.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Add registered project regression coverage for all three WI-10006517 repairs.\",\"rationale\":\"The failure class must be caught by the project test suite if it returns.\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"WI-10006517\",\"session_turn:codex:01a11496-1de8-7f11-9361-c4737dbec8ce:8\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Registered regression tests cover unregistered active-loop detection, the packaged StartLimit values, and graceful embedded-Postgres cleanup on migration failure.\",\"falsifier\":\"Any of the three behaviors lacks a regression test in its project's registered runner, or the focused tests fail.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run each owning focused test file with its documented runner and record the measured results on WI-10006517.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"requirements\"}}}\n```\n\n## Design\n### Bar-to-work map for this plan\n| bar | implementing plan items | evidence plane |\n| R-1 | P-001 | tree |\n| R-2 | P-001 | tree |\n| R-3 | P-001 | tree |\n| R-4 | P-001 | tree |\n\n### Reuse and boundaries\nExtend unit-reconciler.ts and its module-local flap state; do not add a registry, scheduler, or parallel health store. Keep the unregistered-unit path report-only and exclude transient units. Use the existing systemd unit template and embedded-postgres-server startup lifecycle.\n\n## Phase 1 — implementation\n- **P-001** `done` Implement the three WI-10006517 repairs with focused project regression tests; run the owning test files and record the measured result. importance: high — note: ← WI-6554700010014270 completed (done)\n\n## Decisions\n- Apply critical-process-supervisor-2026-07-04 D-001: use the existing three-restarts-in-five-minutes detector and the 600-second/six-start systemd limit.\n- Apply critical-process-supervisor-2026-07-04 D-002: extend the current reconciler and ephemeral in-module state, with systemd retaining restart authority.\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"plan-audit-report-workspace-and-sidebar-2026-10-06","title":"Navigable audit reports and generic Plans-sidebar audit generation","status":"ready","created":"2026-10-07","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Navigable audit reports and generic Plans-sidebar audit generation\nslug: plan-audit-report-workspace-and-sidebar-2026-10-06\nstatus: ready\ncreated: 2026-10-07\nupdated: 2026-10-15\n---\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** ⚠ BAR READINESS BLOCKED (2026-10-07, after decision-added): bar_snapshot_rubric_revision_mismatch, bar_snapshot_proof_inadequate, bar_snapshot_grading_missing, bar_snapshot_vetting_missing. Registering the plan before code edits.\nNext: Audit activation inputs, claim the implementation lane, then implement and verify.\n\n**Next:** Before mutating BAR state, run dev:pipeline_position { path: \"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/plans/with-plan-lock.ts\", marker: \"synchronizeAcceptanceBarSubjectRevision\" } to distinguish a stale serving build from a live guard. If the synchronizer is not deployed, land/redeploy it first; otherwise re-seed or amend atomically so subject and rubric revision pins agree.\n\n## Promoted\n\n<!-- plan-pipeline: do not edit this block manually -->\n- [ ] WI-10007050 — Implement and test the shared navigable report renderer and original-snapshot adapter; preserve all existing evidence. <!-- P-001 -->\n- [ ] WI-10007051 — Extend and test the existing audit engine for validated plan/visible/workspace scope and complete evidence publication. <!-- P-002 -->\n- [ ] WI-10007052 — Implement and test durable run status, immutable report history, authenticated report routes and truthful retry/failure behavior using existing artifact storage. <!-- P-003 -->\n- [ ] WI-10007053 — Implement and test sidebar and per-plan audit actions, history, in-app report navigation and responsive browser journey. <!-- P-004 -->\n- [ ] WI-10007054 — Verify integrated browser/security/read-only behavior, record completion evidence, promote and verify the actual release artifact, then satisfy independent acceptance and ship this plan. <!-- P-005 -->\n## Background\n\nAvi requested redesign of the existing agent-authored audit at http://localhost:39303/ and a generic user-initiated plan audit→report workflow from the Plans sidebar. He approved the proposal by directing this session to write the plan, enter AUTO, and carry it personally to shipped now.\n\n## Requirements\n\n**R-1 — Navigable, evidence-preserving reports.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Redesign the existing localhost:39303 audit for usable navigation without losing its original evidence.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1127d-5f42-7921-a2cf-66b96f0c00fd:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1127d-5f42-7921-a2cf-66b96f0c00fd:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The report provides category navigation, searchable sortable compact results, a focused readable detail view, stable selection links, full JSON export, and responsive keyboard-accessible navigation while retaining original rows and evidence.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"Any original row/evidence disappears or navigating/filtering cannot reach its detail.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"legacy snapshot\",\n      \"large portfolio\",\n      \"desktop/mobile\",\n      \"keyboard\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"e2e\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run registered focused automated tests and exercise the corresponding current-build browser journey; for final shipment verify exact promoted artifact through the release pipeline.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/plan-audit-report.test.ts\",\n        \"apps/operator/e2e/plan-audit.spec.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-2 — Reusable scoped audit generation.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Make audit to report generation generic for one plan, filtered plans, or the workspace.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1127d-5f42-7921-a2cf-66b96f0c00fd:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1127d-5f42-7921-a2cf-66b96f0c00fd:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The existing audit engine honors a validated explicit scope and publishes a complete report whose declared coverage matches its selected population.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"Scope silently widens/narrows, unknown selected plans disappear, or another workspace is included.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"single plan\",\n      \"filtered click-time snapshot\",\n      \"workspace\",\n      \"scope errors\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"integration\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run registered focused automated tests and exercise the corresponding current-build browser journey; for final shipment verify exact promoted artifact through the release pipeline.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/unshipped-plans-audit.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/__tests__/plan-audit.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/plan-audit-runs.integration.test.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-3 — Durable, truthful, read-only run/report lifecycle.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Persist audit/report status and history at a stable application destination without cleanup or plan lifecycle side effects.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1127d-5f42-7921-a2cf-66b96f0c00fd:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1127d-5f42-7921-a2cf-66b96f0c00fd:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"A report can be reopened after navigation/reload; generation and failure are explicit; retry creates a distinct immutable snapshot; audit changes only its report artifacts and never plan lifecycle, blockers, claims, or assignment.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A report is lost/overwritten, a failed run appears successful, a stalled run runs forever, or audit mutates its subjects.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"history\",\n      \"failure/retry\",\n      \"restart/stale run\",\n      \"read-only subjects\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"integration\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run registered focused automated tests and exercise the corresponding current-build browser journey; for final shipment verify exact promoted artifact through the release pipeline.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/plan-audit-runs.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/__tests__/plan-audit.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/plan-audit-runs.integration.test.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-4 — Plan-sidebar audit to report journey.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Let users initiate and revisit audit reports from the Plans sidebar and drive the approved work personally to shipped.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1127d-5f42-7921-a2cf-66b96f0c00fd:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1127d-5f42-7921-a2cf-66b96f0c00fd:5\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The Plans sidebar exposes one-plan, visible-plan, and workspace audit entry points and saved-report history; the generated report opens within the app with a back affordance; focused suite/browser verification and actual promoted release evidence are recorded before shipped.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"The feature is only agent/tool accessible, a sidebar action cannot reach its report, or shipped is asserted without verification.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"sidebar\",\n      \"single-plan action\",\n      \"history\",\n      \"app report/back\",\n      \"release verification\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"e2e\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run registered focused automated tests and exercise the corresponding current-build browser journey; for final shipment verify exact promoted artifact through the release pipeline.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"apps/operator/app/_components/plans/PlanAuditPane.test.tsx\",\n        \"apps/operator/app/_components/plans/PlansPane.test.tsx\",\n        \"apps/operator/e2e/plan-audit.spec.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-5 — Promoted artifact serves the feature.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Carry the approved feature personally to shipped and show Avi how to use it.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1127d-5f42-7921-a2cf-66b96f0c00fd:1\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1127d-5f42-7921-a2cf-66b96f0c00fd:5\",\n      \"plan-audit-report-workspace-and-sidebar-2026-10-06#D-001\",\n      \"plan-audit-report-workspace-and-sidebar-2026-10-06#D-004\",\n      \"plan-audit-report-workspace-and-sidebar-2026-10-06#D-003\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The promoted green artifact serves the all-plans audit feature and saved-report journey on the release operator. Shipment is demonstrated on that exact artifact.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"Shipment is asserted while the release operator health SHA differs from the promoted green SHA, while the all-plans sidebar to report/history/reload journey fails there, or while a tree/current-build result is substituted for deployed evidence.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"deployed\",\n    \"evidenceRuntime\": \"release-operator\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"deployed shipment\",\n      \"exact promoted artifact\",\n      \"all-plans sidebar/report/history/reload\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"browser\"\n    ],\n    \"passRatings\": [\n      \"healthy\"\n    ],\n    \"role\": \"outcome\",\n    \"mandatory\": true\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Explicitly manual final-release check: obtain the exact promoted green artifact SHA and deployment receipt from the live gate/release owner; compare release-operator servingRuntimes in dev:pipeline_position with /api/health SHA on :3070; on that build exercise Plans sidebar -> Audit all plans -> completion -> report -> history -> reload -> Back and retain screenshots/run/report IDs with SHA/time. Healthy requires all observations on the same promoted artifact. Missing/inaccessible or mismatched artifact evidence is UNKNOWN, never healthy. Current-build tests do not discharge this criterion.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"instrument\",\n      \"instrumentKey\": \"none\"\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Design\n\nRegistry-first component selection and design spec validation. Extend the existing unshipped-plans audit and PG-canonical text-artifact storage; no new app scaffold, moderation report table, independent classifier, or cleanup writer. Keep one renderer usable by generated reports and the original static snapshot. Present a compact master/detail audit workspace with category rail, search/filter/sort, readable evidence groups, full export, shareable selection, small-screen adaptation and clear snapshot/coverage limitations. Add a maintained scoped report workflow and owner-side endpoint, using existing authenticated routing and existing artifact persistence/history instead of a new database table. Scope is a click-time selection, never a silently re-derived client filter. Report status distinguishes generation, completion, failure and stale/interrupted work. Cancellation is offered only if actually supported; never imply cleanup. Histories are immutable snapshots with stable report IDs. Sidebar header handles visible/workspace audit and report history; each row/dashboard can audit one plan. Prefer an in-app report pane with Back; no fresh HTTP server per report. The original localhost report is rebuilt from its unchanged audit JSON through the shared renderer.\n\n### Bar-to-work map for this plan\n\n| bar | implementing plan items | evidence plane |\n|---|---|---|\n| R-1 | P-001 | tree |\n| R-2 | P-002 | tree |\n| R-3 | P-003 | tree |\n| R-4 | P-004 | tree |\n| R-5 | P-005 | deployed |\n\n## Phase 1 — Implement and verify\n\n- **P-001** `done` Implement and test the shared navigable report renderer and original-snapshot adapter; preserve all existing evidence. importance: high — note: ← WI-10007050 completed (done)\n- **P-002** `done` Extend and test the existing audit engine for validated plan/visible/workspace scope and complete evidence publication. importance: high — note: ← WI-10007051 completed (done)\n- **P-003** `done` Implement and test durable run status, immutable report history, authenticated report routes and truthful retry/failure behavior using existing artifact storage. blocked-by: P-001, P-002 importance: high — note: ← WI-10007052 completed (done)\n- **P-004** `done` Implement and test sidebar and per-plan audit actions, history, in-app report navigation and responsive browser journey. blocked-by: P-003 importance: high — note: ← WI-10007053 completed (done)\n- **P-005** `blocked` Verify integrated browser/security/read-only behavior, record completion evidence, promote and verify the actual release artifact, then satisfy independent acceptance and ship this plan. blocked-by: P-004 importance: high — note: ← WI-10007054 blocked (1 external blocker)\n\n## Decisions\n\n### D-001 — Route and authority\n\nAvi chose this session to implement personally and explicitly requested AUTO; do not substitute fleet/subagent implementation.\n### D-002 — Reuse and no subject mutation\n\nExtend existing audit/text-artifact/report UI paths; audit writes only its own artifacts. No plan/assignment/blocker/cleanup mutations, public publishing, credentials, or new app scaffolding.\n### D-003 — Coverage and evidence honesty\n\nRetain the original audit including archived, superseded, rubric and instance rows. Snapshot history is not a claim of fresh test execution or live deployment health. Missing evidence stays explicit. Current-build acceptance is independent of final shipment; no LIVE_GATE_OPS duplication when held by another agent.\n### D-004 — Sequencing and scope\n\nShared renderer and audit scope precede report/run routes; sidebar integration follows the routes; final verification follows implementation. Scope membership is validated at the server. No recurring audit schedule was requested.\n\n### D-005 — Dedup review\n\nRead data-scoping-audit-2026-06-22 (capability/workspace boundaries) and expandable-canonical-goal-reports-with-decision-ready-owner-2026-10-03 (GOAL snapshot expansion in the report rail). Neither implements plan-sidebar audit generation or redesigns the supplied portfolio snapshot. This is distinct owner-directed work; reuse the latter's existing report-library foundation, not its unrelated GOAL schema.\n\n### D-006 — Acceptance BAR amendment\nDate: 2026-10-07\nAmendment-Id: amend-67099e9e092bab62087635fe\nRequest-Hash: 601fdf42aff98c4fbf7ffc0984f7fd7952619923ac39430ee9c038cdebdc9070\nActor: su-a9dad156-41b6-41a9-b2e5-91ced5d4b6a4\nReason: Authenticated outside-lineage judge approved exact preview1161139. Preserve all BAR outcomes while repairing semicolon structural assertions and runnable test-check paths.\nApproved-By: system:judge/su-2ba54a1b-7e69-4b6a-9b9d-dd2cd550975c\nApproval-Ref: thread-post:1161168\nApproved-At: 2026-10-07T02:25:09.610Z\nRubric revision: 1 → 2\nSubject plan revision: 2 → 3\nChanged BARs: R-1, R-3, R-4\nPrior evidence, grades, vetting, author verdicts, and ship verdicts remain audit history and are revision-ineligible.\n\n### D-007 — Independent critique correction and evidence separation\nDate: 2026-10-07\nMeasured: thread-post:1162517 and thread-post:1162525 reject revision 2 because its tree checks cannot prove shipment or full historical census/legacy parity. Inspected executePlanAudit and the audit selector: workspace requests omitted includeHistorical and therefore used legacy exclusions. Fixing the existing action and manifest.scope, not adding a parallel audit system. The original 1351-row JSON is frozen as a canonical suite fixture; report navigation and JSON preserve contained rows/evidence, census tests cover generated membership, persistence tests cover immutability. New R-5 maps to existing P-005 and requires exact deployed artifact evidence with UNKNOWN for missing proof; R-1..4 are current-build checks. D-005 is procedural prior-art/dedup routing and reuse, not a product row-dedup requirement. Await outside-lineage approval of the full BAR amendment before applying it.\nRelated: P-001, P-002, P-003, P-004, P-005\n\n### D-008 — Acceptance BAR amendment\nDate: 2026-10-07\nAmendment-Id: amend-c53ca75e7694fd227cf3212c\nRequest-Hash: 7a991a7790b627652c2ccb08643aa222821c93675af425ed31f2e22547dae837\nActor: su-371afed7-3a96-49b7-83a6-7ca117fedbb2\nReason: Implement independent critiques thread-post:1162517/1162525 faithfully: distinguish current-build acceptance from final shipment, prove full historical census and original snapshot parity, enumerate detectors and decision provenance. D-005 is procedural dedup/reuse review, not a new product promise.\nApproved-By: system:judge/su-24dcc6e7-5539-4b73-9251-1b42d4c4db04\nApproval-Ref: thread-post:1162593\nApproved-At: 2026-10-07T16:06:42.591Z\nRubric revision: 2 → 3\nSubject plan revision: 9 → 10\nChanged BARs: R-1, R-2, R-3, R-4, R-5\nPrior evidence, grades, vetting, author verdicts, and ship verdicts remain audit history and are revision-ineligible.\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"portal-accounts-selected-vm-2026-10-07","title":"Restore selected VM accounts in the public portal Accounts pane","status":"draft","created":"2026-10-07","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: \"Restore selected VM accounts in the public portal Accounts pane\"\nslug: \"portal-accounts-selected-vm-2026-10-07\"\nstatus: \"draft\"\ncreated: \"2026-10-07\"\nupdated: \"2026-10-07\"\n---\n## Now\nImplement owner-approved A/self fix for WI-10007179. No fleet. Approval: native Codex transcript line 1228, 2026-10-07T19:18:07.283Z, owner response A. Target https://app.papercusp.com/?accountsPane=true.\n\n## Background\nAccountsTab reads accounts.pool under the hosted control provider which admits only workspaceHosts.control. The selected VM already has registered accounts. Existing portal operator relay authenticates the session and selected workspace and supports REST plus SSE; Settings already uses this boundary.\n\n## Requirements\n**R-1 — Correct source.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Display selected customer VM accounts in public Accounts pane using authenticated relay; preserve control-plane boundary.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Accounts pool and override use VM REST/SSE; Desktops remains hosted control; no shared pool reads.\",\"falsifier\":\"Accounts is routed to hosted control, or another workspace data is returned.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run portal routing and operator-relay regression suites and inspect no-selection, REST and SSE tenant assertions.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"/home/marsh-office/.papercusp-workspaces/papercusp-workspace/.papercusp/apps/portal/tests/operator-sync-endpoint.test.ts\",\"/home/marsh-office/.papercusp-workspaces/papercusp-workspace/.papercusp/apps/portal/tests/operator-relay.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n**R-2 — Truthful state and isolation.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Never report unreadable Accounts data as an empty pool.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"No-selection, pending, retries and failed account reads are explicitly described; only successful zero-row reads show empty state.\",\"falsifier\":\"A failed or blocked read says No accounts in the pool yet.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run real AccountsTab rendering suite with failure and retry fixtures plus portal selection gating tests.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"apps/operator-vite/src/components/left-sidebar/AccountsTab.test.tsx\"]}}}\n```\n**R-3 — Public acceptance.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Publish and accept exact public URL.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Authenticated public https://app.papercusp.com/?accountsPane=true renders selected avi-test migrated Claude IDs from the VM.\",\"falsifier\":\"Only backend or guest UI proof exists, or public pane is empty/unreadable.\"},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Verify served build marker, open exact public URL with owner browser session, observe account labels and VM query requests; record build and screenshot/source.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"instrument\",\"instrumentKey\":\"none\"}}}\n```\n\n## Design\nReuse the existing source-specific SyncProvider pattern used by Settings, operator-sync routes and tenant-bound operator-relay. Keep core hosted-browser allowlist unchanged. Extend shared AccountsTab's loading/error display. Background git-sync owns commits; do not operate the held live green gate. Portal standalone publishing is separately supported.\n\n### Bar-to-work map for this plan\n| bar | implementing plan items | evidence plane |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| R-1 | P-001 | tree |\n| R-2 | P-002 | tree |\n| R-3 | P-003 | deployed |\n\n## Phase 1\n- **P-001** `todo` Connect the Accounts pane to the existing selected-VM sync provider and guard source routing. Existing work-item WI-10007179.\n- **P-002** `todo` Add truthful account read states and real-suite routing, rendering and tenant isolation regression tests. blocked-by: P-001\n- **P-003** `todo` Build and publish portal, then verify exact authenticated public URL and account IDs. blocked-by: P-002\n\n## Decisions\n**D-001 — Approved execution route.** A/self in this session, owner approved. No route re-ask or fan-out.\n**D-002 — Acceptance surface.** Public portal Accounts pane. No guest pui detour, credentials recopy, weakening tenancy, or shared pool reads.\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"vinci-nimish-interview-prep-2026-10-07","title":"Vinci / Nimish Patil October 7 interview prep tab","status":"draft","created":"2026-10-07","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Vinci / Nimish Patil October 7 interview prep tab\nslug: vinci-nimish-interview-prep-2026-10-07\nstatus: draft\ncreated: 2026-10-07\nupdated: 2026-10-16\n---\n\n# Vinci / Nimish Patil interview prep\n\n## Goal\nAdd a separate Vinci / Nimish Patil October 7, 2026 interview-prep tab for Avi. Interview: Wednesday 7:00–7:45 PM EDT / 4:00–4:45 PM PDT. Preserve the existing Balaji intro tab. Owner approved this session implementing and publishing, plus online research.\n\n## Scope\nReuse the maintained ~/interview-prep HTML layout, shared sitenav.js, build-standalone.sh, verify-prep.cjs and publish-public.py. Research primary role/company/interviewer sources and public candidate interview reports. Label anonymous historical reports, aggregators' inferred content, and our own practice separately. No fabricated question bank, interviewer history or candidate metrics. The invite does not establish coding/system-design format. Keep join URLs, meeting IDs, passcodes and cancel/reschedule links private. No manual git add/commit/push; the existing maintained public-site publisher is the publication mechanism for its independent repository. No edits in Papercusp release/checkpoint or sibling worktrees.\n\n## Execution route\nThis session directly, per Avi's go-ahead. Research → build and integrate page/tab plus tests → standalone build, desktop/mobile verification, maintained publisher, resolve live URL. One integrated feature/work-item; no fleet or new app.\n\n## Requirements\n\n**R-1 — Discoverable scheduled tab.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Add a new Vinci/Nimish prep tab for the supplied October 7, 2026 interview.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"The prep collection exposes the Nimish interview page with the supplied EDT/PDT schedule and retains the existing Balaji intro.\",\"falsifier\":\"The Nimish tab is unreachable, the supplied call time differs, or the intro page disappears.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"e2e\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run the maintained external verifier `/home/marsh-office/interview-prep/run-verify.sh` from the registered interview-prep source collection; inspect new-page, shared-navigation and Answer Bank route assertions at desktop/mobile and normal/standalone variants. This is a maintained external instrument whose evidence is carried as a requirements check because the path is outside Papercusp's test router. Report separate observations for discoverability, supplied schedule accuracy, and Balaji retention; a failure in any one fails R-1. Run the script from its registered source collection `/home/marsh-office/interview-prep` (the wrapper is cwd-independent because it resolves its own directory). Record expected exit code 0 and the verifier summary containing `result: PASS`, `pagesChecked`, `navigationLinksChecked`, and `answerPanelsChecked`.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"requirements\"},\"replication\":\"Re-run `/home/marsh-office/interview-prep/run-verify.sh vinci-nimish-patil-technical.html vinci-nimish-patil-technical-standalone.html`; retain its stdout/exit result with the acceptance evidence.\"}}\n```\n\n**R-2 — Honest and actionable interview research.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Do online research on what Vinci or Nimish might ask and provide useful preparation.\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"The prep page distinguishes source-backed reports and primary facts from inferred practice, and provides relevant answer outlines without invented experience.\",\"falsifier\":\"A guessed drill is presented as a confirmed Nimish question, an unsourced interviewer/candidate claim is asserted, or the primary report/role links are missing.\"},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"For every material factual or interpretive claim in `/home/marsh-office/interview-prep/vinci-nimish-patil-technical.html`, create an evidence table with: claim text, classification (primary fact / reported / inference / practice), exact source URL, retrieval timestamp (or retained capture/archive), page location, and reviewer verdict. Use the named sources: Ashby role https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/vinci/7585965e-6910-48d5-8cfc-900d930630e8; Glassdoor report https://www.glassdoor.com/Interview/vinci4d-Interview-Questions-E10658905.htm; Vinci paper https://www.getvinci.ai/research/thermal-sensitivity-analysis-of-3d-ic-face-to-back-stacking-using-foundation-models-for-physics/; public profile https://www.linkedin.com/in/npatil1; technical references linked by the page; and retained report `/reports/rpt_c490a001-b672-44cd-ad68-44b0716f12bf`. Separately sample every answer outline for role relevance and actionable specificity, and verify no candidate experience is invented or attributed without evidence. If a source cannot be retrieved, record unknown rather than infer confirmation. The maintained verifier supplements navigation/privacy only and cannot establish research truthfulness.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"instrument\",\"instrumentKey\":\"none\"},\"replication\":\"Re-run the evidence review from the exact page source and retained report. goal declaration renders the same reorder-and-select editor used by WOE.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"The editor requires a WOE goal ID/name branch, or another goal needs bespoke UI code.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"shared-goal-property-editor\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"integration\",\n      \"e2e\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Exercise declarative opt-in and opt-out fixtures and the same registered renderer for WOE and an unrelated goal.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/typed-properties.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/datatype-display.test.ts\",\n        \"apps/operator/app/adv/hud/GoalDetailPanel.test.tsx\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/typed-properties-db.integration.test.ts\",\n        \"apps/operator/e2e/ongoing-work-ui.spec.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-14 — Shared ordered-selection semantics.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Ordering and selection are reusable data semantics with one shared effective-selection reader, separate from domain admission rules.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1172e-c2fb-78c3-9b12-3af8f82b570f:6\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1172e-c2fb-78c3-9b12-3af8f82b570f:8\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"The shared reader returns selected items in saved owner priority order for both manual collections and the WOE active-plan source.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A consumer reinterprets raw order or exclusions differently, source refresh clears policy, or the generic reader launches work or bypasses domain admission.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"shared-collection-policy\",\n      \"manual-and-discovered-collections\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"integration\",\n      \"e2e\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Bind stable identities, persisted order/exclusion overlays, default selection and optional source refresh to one pure reader; test manual data and registered plan-source adapters, including dormant exclusions and unavailable-source safety.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/typed-properties.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/datatype-display.test.ts\",\n        \"apps/operator/app/adv/hud/GoalDetailPanel.test.tsx\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/typed-properties-db.integration.test.ts\",\n        \"apps/operator/e2e/ongoing-work-ui.spec.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n**R-15 — Second-goal portability proof.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Prove an unrelated goal with a non-plan collection uses the same declaration, renderer, persistence and ordered-selection behavior.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1172e-c2fb-78c3-9b12-3af8f82b570f:6\",\n      \"session_turn:codex:01a1172e-c2fb-78c3-9b12-3af8f82b570f:8\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"A second non-WOE goal with non-plan items passes the same reorder, exclusion, reload and reselection journey without a custom component or resolver fork.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"The portability proof uses only another WOE fixture, requires goal-name branching, or bypasses the persisted typed-property write path.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"second-goal-non-plan-collection\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"unit\",\n      \"integration\",\n      \"e2e\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Create a second goal fixture with stable non-plan item identities and an owner-editable list policy; exercise the shared editor and CAS/provenance write path, refresh the read model and assert shared-reader results.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/typed-properties.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/datatype-display.test.ts\",\n        \"apps/operator/app/adv/hud/GoalDetailPanel.test.tsx\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/typed-properties-db.integration.test.ts\",\n        \"apps/operator/e2e/ongoing-work-ui.spec.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Design\n\n### Reuse-first architecture\n\nExtend existing surfaces, not a parallel system. Starting points read from the brief and current source:\n- `packages/operator-core/lib/goal-launch-settings.ts`: canonical worklist/portfolio read model, placement compiler, goal ownership/admission helpers. Existing SQL unions explicit worklist refs with goal-stamped plans; both need the same final selection gate.\n- `packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/goals/set-property.ts`: typed property write and existing worklist-attribution backfill. Current worklist writes can stamp goal attribution; automatic discovery must not trigger that bulk-ownership side effect.\n- `packages/operator-core/lib/goals/package-property-datatypes.ts`: existing typed ordered plan-ref worklist. Reuse qualified references and validation.\n- `packages/operator-core/lib/goals/portfolio-acts.ts`, `worklist-attribution-backfill.ts`, and existing goal/fleet standing-drain consumers: census actual selection and admission callers before patching.\n- `apps/operator/app/adv/hud/OngoingWorkOverview.tsx` and `GoalDetailPanel.tsx`: preserve existing presentation, sync and URL-state conventions; reuse registered components for controls.\n\nPersist owner policy, compute discovery. Preserve existing worklist priorities; minimally extend the existing goal property contract for automatic-pool behavior and durable owner exclusions after checking existing datatype/property options. Do not introduce a parallel membership table. P-002 chooses exact keys/types from the current registry, not a memorized new schema. Agent writes and background reconciliation cannot clear or reorder protected owner preferences; use existing property versions/atomic mutation semantics to prevent lost updates.\n\nUse workspace-qualified plan identity (harness plus slug) so cross-harness slug collisions cannot merge choices. Reconcile saved order with discovered active plans deterministically; new refs go to the tail. Keep dormant preference/exclusion records when a plan leaves the active pool so reactivation does not reset it. Preserve a discovery failure as unknown/unavailable, not a destructive empty-list update.\n\nSelection and runnability are separate. Effective runnable pool = discovered candidate membership, minus persistent exclusions, filtered through existing lifecycle, approval, dependency, goal-ownership, live-claim and resource admission. Surface blocked candidates with reasons; do not silently convert visibility into permission. Goal-stamped and explicit-worklist membership never override an exclusion. Revalidate the policy revision at every final new-work action boundary to close deselect-versus-launch races.\n\nNon-runnable rows may remain available as history/preferences, but never runnable. Automatic pool membership does not stamp this goal onto every active plan. Ownership changes remain in the existing actual-admission/placement operation and obey its authority gates. Other goals retain manual semantics.\n\n### Shared collection capability — approved generalization\n\nThe owner approved the generalized behavior in session_turn:codex:01a1172e-c2fb-78c3-9b12-3af8f82b570f:8 after asking for any-goal declarations in session_turn:codex:01a1172e-c2fb-78c3-9b12-3af8f82b570f:6. Extend the existing typed-property/datatype/list-display machinery; WOE is its first configuration, not a special renderer. A property declaration controls an opt-in collection: manual or approved existing-source items, stable identity, whether ordering is display-only or operational priority, per-item selection/default selection, owner/agent editing permissions, and derived status/reason annotations. These are extensions to existing strict contracts, not already-supported flags.\n\nKeep three layers separate: (1) persisted typed owner policy with CAS versions/provenance, (2) one declarative list editor using existing registry components, and (3) one effective ordered-selection reader consumed by domain adapters. No generic list code launches fleets or assumes every collection is work. WOE supplies the active-workspace-plan adapter and existing admission rules; another goal supplies manually defined non-plan items. Selected is not runnable. Blocking/status/reasons remain system-derived annotations, never owner-editable policy. Automatic discovery is read-side; owner ordering/exclusions are a persistent overlay retained when items disappear.\n\nOpt-in only: existing unconfigured/manual properties and non-WOE goals retain current behavior. Extend existing list/ref-picker/record capabilities and existing approved provider bindings before introducing a new surface. No arbitrary executable display code, user-supplied SQL, or unvalidated data-source tool names. If a new reusable datatype is necessary, register it in the existing datatype registry and explain why current types cannot represent the shape. A second non-WOE/non-plan goal must exercise the same renderer, persistence and reader, not a custom demo implementation.\n\n### Bar-to-work map for this plan\n\n| bar | implementing plan items | evidence plane |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| R-1 | P-003, P-006 | tree |\n| R-2 | P-002, P-003, P-006 | tree |\n| R-3 | P-004, P-005, P-007 | tree |\n| R-4 | P-002, P-005, P-006, P-007 | tree |\n| R-5 | P-004, P-006 | tree |\n| R-6 | P-003, P-004, P-005, P-006 | tree |\n| R-7 | P-003, P-004, P-006 | tree |\n| R-8 | P-004, P-006 | tree |\n| R-9 | P-002, P-003, P-005, P-006 | tree |\n| R-10 | P-005, P-007 | tree |\n| R-11 | P-006, P-007 | tree |\n| R-12 | P-008 | deployed |\n| R-13 | P-002, P-005, P-007 | tree |\n| R-14 | P-002, P-003, P-004, P-006 | tree |\n| R-15 | P-005, P-006, P-007 | tree |\n\n## Phase 1 — Contract and canonical pool\n\n- **P-001** `done` Re-read goal properties, related plan decisions and live claims; enumerate every existing WOE plan-picker/placement/goal-stamped/standing-drain caller, lifecycle gate and test suite. Inventory current typed-property/datatype display and collection-source contracts. Search the design registry and validate/lint the shared component spec before GUI design; record the any-goal declaration and non-plan portability fixture. Record the caller population and proposed typed owner-policy extension with exact files and admission boundaries. Acceptance: addressable caller census, reusable UI choices, current-build runtime route, and no duplicate implementation owner. importance: high — note: ← WI-10007253 completed (done)\n- **P-002** `done` Extend the shared typed-property/datatype/list-display contracts and versioned owner-policy writes for any-goal opt-in durable priorities/exclusions with backward compatibility, workspace-qualified refs and agent-write protection. Preserve legacy saved order; discovery must not stamp ownership through worklist backfill. Add enrolled persistence, invalid-ref, concurrency and other-goal regression tests with the feature. blocked-by: P-001 importance: high — note: ← WI-10007254 completed (done)\n- **P-003** `done` Implement one shared effective ordered-selection reader with manual/discovered collection adapters, then configure automatic active-workspace candidate resolution in the existing WOE goal portfolio: default-check new refs, append behind saved order, retain dormant preferences, expose selected/excluded/blocked truth, and apply lifecycle/read-failure safety without discovery claims or stamps. Add enrolled reconciliation and admission-compiler tests. blocked-by: P-002 importance: high — note: ← WI-10007255 completed (done)\n\n## Phase 2 — Backend and owner controls\n\n- **P-004** `done` Route every enumerated existing next-pick/placement/launch/goal-stamped/standing-drain consumer through effective selection and ordering, with final policy-version checks, safe atomic-step completion after deselection and existing ownership/dependency/budget/headcount gates intact. Ship per-caller negative tests and barrier-controlled race tests with the source changes. blocked-by: P-003 importance: high — note: ← WI-10007256 completed (done)\n- **P-005** `done` Extend the existing generic goal-data UI with one declaration-driven ordered/selectable list renderer, used by WOE and a second non-WOE/non-plan goal, with persistent drag priority and per-item checkboxes, visible excluded/blocked rows and reasons, keyboard reorder fallback, narrow-layout support, save-error feedback and existing sync/URL state. Reuse registered components and the canonical read/write contract; do not disturb the prior UI certification lane. Ship enrolled component tests. blocked-by: P-003 importance: high — note: ← WI-10007257 completed (done)\n\n## Phase 3 — Verification and delivery\n\n- **P-006** `done` Run and strengthen canonical unit/stateful/integration regression suites and npm run test:affected. Demonstrate new activation, priority-driven next pick, refresh/restart/agent-edit/reactivation persistence, reselection, every enumerated exclusion path, goal-stamp bypass prevention, safe deselection race and lifecycle/peer-goal/resource negatives. Verify an unrelated non-plan collection through the same declaration/renderer/CAS persistence/shared reader, plus opt-out, permission and source-failure controls. Record an explicit population/checked/notChecked/notApplicable/residue coverage partition rather than assert unbounded universal coverage. blocked-by: P-004, P-005 importance: high — note: ← WI-10007258 completed (done)\n- **P-007** `done` Select the supported isolated headless Tauri current-build route via dev:pipeline_position, satisfy its prerequisites and run the actual WOE and second-goal non-plan GUI journeys against the feature-loaded runtime. Preserve artifact/runtime identity and repeatable enrolled e2e proof; no browser-only substitute for a missing desktop route. Obtain required independent acceptance evidence. blocked-by: P-006 importance: high — note: Supported desktop acceptance is satisfied by the preserved clean12db native plans+tea run (ledger21272791, 2 pass/0 skip; verifier061034 and journeys064005/064136 pass; runtime173971 stable; terminal exit 0). Browser evidence was used only for exact R-14 freshness, not as a desktop substitute. Full release shipment remains P-008.\n- **P-008** `todo` Carry verified source through normal auto-commit, green verdict, promotion and deployment; inspect LIVE_GATE_OPS ownership before any gate operation and coordinate an existing live holder rather than duplicate the lane. Verify the exact shipped build and real WOE goal journey, publish truthful outcome and keep this item open with exact hop/blocker evidence if shipment is unavailable. blocked-by: P-007 importance: high — note: Shipment unavailable: source is committed on staging and P-002..P-007 are verified, but LIVE_GATE_OPS is held-live by su-e8a2c2bb-7cf2-4b35-af9a-37b13efc1a06 on WI-10006055. Do not duplicate gate rerun, deploy, repair, or monitoring. Required hops remain auto-commit confirmation, green verdict, promotion/deploy, then exact shipped-build and real WOE journey verification. Coordinate with the live holder; this item remains open.\n\n## Acceptance scenarios and evidence\n\n1. Active plan absent from the old saved worklist appears automatically, selected at the tail, without an attribution/claim write.\n2. Reordering two eligible plans changes the next backend pick; blocked top rows do not starve later eligible rows.\n3. Exclude a goal-stamped plan; each enumerated picker/placement/drain path rejects it.\n4. Exclusion and ordering survive refresh, new server read, restart, agent edits, active-pool churn and pause/reactivation.\n5. Explicit reselection restores eligibility only when the existing gates allow it.\n6. Completed/paused/superseded/archived/unapproved-draft plans do not launch; dependencies, peer claims, other goals, budgets and headcount are negative controls.\n7. Deselect during an atomic step: finish/checkpoint/release safely, reject the next assignment; a stale pre-toggle selection cannot dispatch new work.\n8. Discovery read failure leaves saved preferences intact and is visible as unavailable, not empty success.\n9. Real desktop controls persist or report save failure; excluded rows remain visible; keyboard/narrow-layout and prior ongoing-work presentation remain usable.\n10. Exact green shipped artifact repeats the real-data goal journey. Staging proof is separately labeled and never represented as shipment.\n\nEach source item ships enrolled tests with the feature. A typecheck is supplemental, not acceptance. No final universal claim without the P-001 caller census and explicit coverage partition. Read prior verification references rather than rerun only to reconstruct proof.\n\n## Activation and provenance\n\nAvi has now approved the generic extension and directed AUTO SELF execution through shipped status in session_turn:codex:01a1172e-c2fb-78c3-9b12-3af8f82b570f:8. This amendment keeps the draft intact until its activation audit is recorded; then activate and execute without another approval question. Before draft promotion or plans:start, use sessions:read/search to review the complete plan-related owner conversation and record plans:audit phase activation with mappings for every requirement, constraint, correction, rejection, dependency and promised follow-up. Requirements derive from the original owner request plus the owner-referenced handoff. P-001..P-008 are derived decomposition of those outcomes, not independently invented product scope. Keyboard fallback, concurrency barriers, failure feedback and qualified identity are derived correctness/usability safeguards and must be declared as item provenance, not falsely attributed to a verbatim owner request. Re-audit meaning-changing revisions.\n\n## Decisions\n\n### D-001 — Separate feature plan, shared product surfaces\n\nDate: 2026-10-07. Reuse the existing goal/portfolio/scheduler/GUI. A distinct implementation plan is justified because the related UI plan's inspected requirements cover ongoing-work presentation and certification, while this request changes candidate discovery and enforceable admission policy. Do not amend or take over its live P-004 lane.\n\n### D-002 — Visibility never grants ownership or permission\n\nDate: 2026-10-07. Automatic discovery is read-side candidate computation. Persistent owner exclusions outrank explicit worklist and goal-stamped membership. Existing activation, approval, dependencies, peer ownership and resource controls remain authoritative at the final new-work boundary.\n\n### D-003 — Owner choices survive reconciliation\n\nDate: 2026-10-07. Preserve saved order and exclusion records through refresh, agent writes, restart and lifecycle churn. Newly active plans append selected by default unless a remembered exclusion exists. Deselecting stops future work after a safe current atomic step; it is not destructive cancellation.\n\n### D-004 — Planning evidence and shipment are distinct\n\nDate: 2026-10-07. WI-10007184 closes only the creation/readback of this plan and delivery of its detailed summary. P-001..P-008 stay todo until implemented and verified. Only P-008 requires the shipped artifact; ordinary development and acceptance proceed on the feature-loaded current-build route without waiting on green main.\n\n### D-005 — Owner-approved generic collection capability and AUTO SELF shipment\nDate: 2026-10-07\nOwner authority: session_turn:codex:01a1172e-c2fb-78c3-9b12-3af8f82b570f:6 asks for any goal to declare prioritization/deselection through existing goal data, and turn :8 approves the preceding generic architecture and directs AUTO execution through shipped status. Extend existing typed-property/datatype/list-display contracts; WOE is the first configuration, not a special widget. One shared ordered-selection reader handles manual and registered discovered collections, with persistent owner overlays, CAS/provenance/permission checks and derived blocking reasons. A second non-WOE goal with non-plan data must exercise the same declaration, renderer, persistence and reader without goal-name branching. Existing consumers opt in; nonconfigured/manual goals retain behavior. Keep domain admission separate and authoritative. SELF route remains: this session implements directly; no fleet launch. Source evidence: typed-properties.ts defines registry-validated properties/CAS/edit provenance; datatype-display.ts has strict list/ref-picker/record display variants but no existing prioritization/deselection flags. This is an extension to those maintained surfaces, not a new scheduler/dashboard/table. Preserve prior R-1..R-12 and add R-13..R-15 portability contracts. No shipping by SQL, waived tests, or status-only assertion.\nRelated: P-001, P-002, P-003, P-004, P-005, P-006, P-007, P-008\n\n### D-006 — Independent item contracts distinguish code behavior from inventory and verification work\nDate: 2026-10-07\nMeasured: packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/plans/spec-quality.ts:333-440 excludes AUTO-BAR projections from independent item-contract coverage; activation of the46 seeded projections alone therefore did not satisfy the start gate. Add independent clauses for runtime work P-002..P-005 without rewriting canonical BAR behavior. P-001 is read-only caller/registry/design inventory; P-006 runs/strengthens and records canonical regression proof; P-007 runs supported desktop acceptance and certification; P-008 performs promotion/deployment and exact artifact verification. Those four operational/inventory steps receive explicit non-automated scope declarations, not fake runtime behavior. The declarations exempt only an additional runtime-behavior contract: all mapped acceptance BARs, real tests, mutation negatives, headless Tauri proof, independent certification and final deployed evidence remain mandatory and none is waived. Existing item scope/dependencies/requirements are unchanged. Independent contracts use honest agent-authored D-005 design provenance and preserve all source-origin and approval rails.\nRelated: P-001, P-002, P-003, P-004, P-005, P-006, P-007, P-008\n\n\n### D-007 — Runtime BARs belong to implementation, not prerequisite inventory\n\nDate: 2026-10-07. P-001 remains the read-only inventory/declaration step under D-006; its output is docs/evidence/woe-auto-plan-pool-p001-census-2026-10-07.json and INVENTORY-P-001. Listing it as an implementing item for runtime R-1/R-5/R-9/R-13 made the strict completion gate demand behavior implemented only by its dependent successors. Remove P-001 from those four runtime map rows and retain every true implementation/verification item. All fifteen canonical Requirements, behaviors, falsifiers, evidence planes, scopes and test layers remain byte-identical. No gate, test, mutation or final shipment obligation is waived. Retire only the four obsolete P-001 projections as superseded and unpinned through the supported spec writer, then re-audit activation. The completion gate stays strict; this corrects plan authoring, not enforcement. Diagnosis and recurrence-guard work are owned in EI-25354905476476419.\n\nRelated: P-001, P-002, P-003, P-004, P-005, P-006, P-007, P-008\n\n### D-008 — Repair proof targeting and unavailable BAR provenance without changing behavior\nDate: 2026-10-10\nMeasured 2026-10-10: protected3170 plans:get-specs returns24 runtime AUTO-BAR projections at clause@2 pinned to acceptance rubric@1; rubrics:get @1 refuses revision not found while immutable@4 resolves barSetHash f2b82da5fb0cd3affee35718883cb8dba952287a0a35d910903bf6bada0367ed and current vetted attestation EI-25629808872558086. source-bar-test-requirements.ts:23-39 requires the authentic pinned revision, so scoring remains unknown. Repair those24 sourceBar.rubricRevision pins through plans:set-specs expectedRevision CAS to readable vetted@4 after verifying every barKey/barHash/evidencePlane and BAR-set match. Neither metadata repair nor rubric vetting is work acceptance or shipment.\nRelated: P-002, P-003, P-004, P-005\n\n### D-009 — P-005 current evaluator contradiction blocks reuse of prior pass claim\nDate: 2026-10-18\n[observed] Fresh protected :3170 plans:evaluate-spec-test-adequacy for WI-10007257 returned pass:0, fail:9, unknown:0 across AUTO-BAR-R-10/13/15/3/4/6/9-P-005 and EDITOR-P-005-GENERIC/SAVE-FAILURE. Agents read/write the rubric structured, never\nby parsing this markdown.\n\n## Decisions\n\n(Use plans:add-decision to append.)\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"bulk-cleanup-risk-autonomy-2026-10-08","title":"Risk-level autonomy settings and automatic recommendation application","status":"ready","created":"2026-10-08","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Risk-level autonomy settings and automatic recommendation application\nslug: bulk-cleanup-risk-autonomy-2026-10-08\nstatus: ready\ncreated: 2026-10-08\nupdated: 2026-10-15\n---\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** Existing implementation verified from WI-10007338 and current staging policy: low/medium/high automatic, L2, medium confidence. Four draft AUTO-BAR projections activated at rev2 without behavior changes; all seven clauses are active and current spec quality structurally passes hash 41e7aa92873c007157a1276631fcac86915db7be0597cdf2ca66522a220a3659. Formal items remain open. Acceptance rubric rev2 is unvetted; ship readiness requires vetting before proof binding/cards/grading. Saved automatic run bulk-02b08a33-4c63-48fb-b3c7-b3d54c7465cd re-read complete with one auto_resolved receipt. WI-10007385 holds exact formal follow-up; independent reviewer requested from coordinator. No acceptance or shipment claim.\n\n**Next:** Coordinator supplies an existing independent rubric reviewer without launching another agent; then complete vetting, bind exact revision evidence and ledger-backed adequacy, settle independent grading, and record authorized acceptance. Continue from WI-10007385.\n\n## Promoted\n\n<!-- plan-pipeline: do not edit this block manually -->\n- [ ] WI-10007387 — Extend standing policy, settings UI and scheduled application with framework regression tests. <!-- P-001 -->\n- [ ] WI-10007388 — Enable full autonomy for every risk level and read back the persisted grant. <!-- P-002 -->\n- [ ] WI-10007389 — Verify automatic application with a bounded live recommendation sample, source-state and audit receipts. <!-- P-003 -->\n## Background\nThe audit showed L0 review-all and 8126 outstanding recommendations. The retired Queen policy is unrelated; the live Inbox standing policy is the extension point.\n\n## Requirements\n**R-1 — Risk settings.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"A place to configure autonomy by risk level\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Settings exposes and persists separate low, medium and high review or automatic choices.\",\"falsifier\":\"A row is missing, a save is not persisted, or reload loses a chosen value.\",\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run the Settings page and navigation tests; change one row and verify the save payload and reload.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"apps/operator/app/settings/autonomy/page.test.tsx\",\"apps/operator/app/settings/settings-nav-gates.test.tsx\"]}}}\n```\n\n**R-2 — Full autonomy.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Set full autonomy for all risk levels\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Current-build standing policy reads automatic for low, medium and high risk.\",\"falsifier\":\"Any risk remains review after the explicit grant.\"},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Write the owner-directed risk map through inbox:automation-policy on the containing build, then get and compare each risk.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"instrument\",\"instrumentKey\":\"none\"}}}\n```\n\n**R-3 — Automatic application.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Test recommendations apply automatically\"},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Reporting an eligible terminal recommendation automatically mutates its source and records auto_resolved without manual accept.\",\"falsifier\":\"The source stays unchanged, receipt is missing, or a revoked/stale action executes.\"},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Use bounded current-build recommendation report; inspect autoAccept, source state and triage/run receipt. Run policy revocation and saved owner-dismissal tests.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"instrument\",\"instrumentKey\":\"none\"}}}\n```\n\n## Design\nExtend StandingBulkAutomationPolicy with a per-risk map derived from the existing delegable/owner-by-right/never-auto attention classification. Reuse control.select and the existing Button/settings layout. Replace the obsolete autonomy retirement notice with current bulk-cleanup controls and expose its navigation link. Reuse the existing bulk execution path and scheduled Inbox fire to drain eligible saved recommendations, rather than adding a parallel service or routine. Missing live actions, unknown kind, insufficient evidence, Stop and revoked risk grants remain explicit refusals.\n\n### Bar-to-work map for this plan\n| bar | implementing plan items | evidence plane |\n| R-1 | P-001 | tree |\n| R-2 | P-002 | live |\n| R-3 | P-001, P-003 | live |\n\n## Phase 1 — Build and verify\n- **P-001** `todo` Extend standing policy, settings UI and scheduled application with framework regression tests.\n- **P-002** `todo` Enable full autonomy for every risk level and read back the persisted grant. blocked-by: P-001\n- **P-003** `todo` Verify automatic application with a bounded live recommendation sample, source-state and audit receipts. blocked-by: P-002\n\n## Decisions\n### D-001 — Reuse current Inbox autonomy rather than retired Queen ceilings\nThe source read shows the old Queen policy page is a permanent retirement notice. The current live authority is attention/automation-policy.ts; this task extends that surface. Scope is bulk queue recommendations, not session AUTO mode or global retired agent tiers.\n\n### D-002 — Shared policy contract and separation from Plans cleanup lane\nDate: 2026-10-08\nStandingBulkAutomationPolicy adds riskLevels?: Record<'low'|'medium'|'high','review'|'automatic'>; bulkRiskAutonomy derives legacy defaults. Existing attention delegation supplies risk; explicit high automatic is an owner grant. This session owns standing policy/API, Settings UI and Inbox automatic application. Peer su-2c2b6ea4 owns plan-cleanup-only files and integrates against the shared policy.
