Next repair: Vet the current acceptance-rubric criteria BEFORE binding proof or emitting adequacy cards (amend → vet → attest → bind → cards → grade): a vetting critique usually becomes an amendment, and proof bound first must then be re-bound.. (re-evaluated in the same write by the scope-write cascade, P-030/P-031)\n\nDraft rev 1 written 2026-10-15 by su-24b36795 under owner directive #1912 [owner:Avi]: write the plan, AUTO mode, carry to shipped. Route: self (this session implements). Nothing started yet. Evidence: report rpt_1e5ad09a-bd94-433a-8800-72d28940efae, WI-6554700010014783, WI-6554700010014853.\n\n**Next:** Activation: re-read the source turns (sessions:search session:'self' for directives #1909-#1912), plans:audit phase:'shaping' then phase:'activation' with itemProvenance, then plans:start. First build items: P-009 (measure boot tokens per client, read-only) and P-001 (acceptance criteria as a live view of requirements).\n\n## Promoted\n\n<!-- plan-pipeline: do not edit this block manually -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014972 — Acceptance criteria read live from requirement blocks (R-1); retire the rubric-copy amendment cascade for path/method-only changes; vet once at activation. <!-- P-001 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014973 — Auto-bind and refresh evidence from test_runs at a containing commit (R-2). <!-- P-002 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014974 — Mechanical test adequacy replaces per-clause judge cards for test-checked requirements (R-3). <!-- P-003 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014975 — plans:audit proposes citations from edit records and commit attribution (R-4). <!-- P-004 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014976 — Remove the vetting attestation card and its grading-integrity audit from the ship gate (R-5). <!-- P-005 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014977 — Implementer verdict becomes accept/reject on the independent grade (R-6). <!-- P-006 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014978 — No acceptance grading or acceptance item while build items are open (R-7). <!-- P-007 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014979 — Tool failures filed from the invocation ledger; drop the hand-capture mandate for plain tool failures (R-8). <!-- P-008 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014980 — Measure boot tokens per client and model (Codex included) and size limits for guaranteed working room (R-9). <!-- P-009 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014981 — Short core prompt plus on-demand reference sections (R-10). <!-- P-010 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014982 — Host enforces continuation identity; drop the coord:whoami mandate (R-11). <!-- P-011 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014983 — Carry preloads the predecessor's tools (R-12). <!-- P-012 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014984 — Host writes the mechanical respawn checkpoint; agent writes judgment only (R-13). <!-- P-013 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014985 — Skip wakes with no delta (R-14). <!-- P-014 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010014986 — Re-run the paperwork and restart measurement on post-change plans and publish (R-15, R-16). <!-- P-015 -->\n## Product shaping\n\n**Audience.** Agents carrying plans to shipped; Avi, who waits on them.\n\n**Problem.** Measured 2026-10-15 on `slack-asana-reproduced-bug-fix-pr-workflow-2026-10-08` (six agents, Oct 8–15, 8,849 tool calls, ~128 agent-hours; report rpt_1e5ad09a-bd94-433a-8800-72d28940efae, WI-6554700010014783, WI-6554700010014853):\n- About 26% of time went to acceptance proof and repairing review machinery, versus about 39% building. Whole-plan acceptance (P-008) took 23.4 h across 69 sessions while three build items were still open.\n- 229 hand evidence bindings for 22 clauses; 31 judge test-adequacy cards; 4 rubric amendments, each resetting vetting and grading; rubric at rev 6 needing re-vetting.\n- 298 of 479 `improvements:capture` calls (62%) hand-reported tool failures already in the invocation ledger.\n- The four Codex agents ran 216 sessions (median 13.1 min). Each spent ~6.7 calls / ~1.8 min starting up and ~2.6 calls shutting down (~22 h total). 37 sessions (17%) did no work. Restarts were triggered at ~94% context; prior findings EI-23349469130065495 and EI-23744538757758407 show the fixed prompt and tool schemas filling most of the limit at boot.\n\n**Outcome.** Acceptance proof is derived from requirements, the test ledger and commit records, not hand-copied. Review layers that only check a previous review layer are gone. A session boots with guaranteed working room, its identity and tools already settled, and writes only judgment when it restarts.\n\n**Non-goals.** Keep one independent final grade by an agent outside the implementer's lineage. Keep recorded decisions, root-cause proof on bug closes, and owner-authority gates. Do not weaken code-truth auditing; only change who writes the citations. Unlike `review-system-rework-reduction-2026-09-23`, this plan removes steps rather than speeding them up.\n\n**Source turns.** [owner:Avi 2026-10-15] directive #1909 (which paperwork can be automated or removed), #1910 (read derived-status-not-hand-written-2026-10-12 first), #1911 (what would you do for \"cut the restart tax\"), dialog answer \"One combined plan\", #1912 (write it into a plan, AUTO mode, carry to shipped).\n\n**Scenarios.**\n1. An implementer changes a test path named by a requirement. The acceptance view updates; no amendment, re-vet, attestation or re-grade is triggered.\n2. A requirement's named tests pass at a commit containing the code. Its evidence is bound and kept current without an agent call.\n3. A plan with open build items asks for acceptance grading and is told which build items remain, instead of being graded.\n4. A tool call fails. The failure is filed from the ledger; the agent is not asked to report it.\n5. A Codex or Claude session restarts. It boots well below its limit, is already bound to its identity, has its prior tools loaded, and resumes work in its first call.\n6. A wake fires with nothing new for the agent. No session is started.\n\n## Requirements\n\n**R-1 — Acceptance criteria are a live view of plan requirements.**\n\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Read acceptance criteria from the plan requirement blocks at read time instead of a hand-maintained rubric copy.\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"owner-directive:1909\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"After a test-path-only edit to a plan requirement, the next acceptance read shows the new test path without a rubric amendment.\",\"falsifier\":\"A test-path-only requirement edit leaves a stale criterion or produces an amendment-required, vetting_stale or proof_stale refusal.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"tree\",\"requiredScope\":[\"P-001\"],\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run the live-view tests over a fixture plan before and after a path-only edit.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/rubrics/acceptance-live-requirements.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n**R-2 — Evidence binds itself from the test ledger.**\n\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Bind and refresh requirement evidence automatically when its named tests pass at a commit containing the code.\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"owner-directive:1909\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"A passing ledger run of every named test file at a commit containing the requirement code produces a current evidence binding without an agent call.\",\"falsifier\":\"Evidence stays unbound after a qualifying pass, binds from a run that predates the code, or stays current after a later failing Timeout before reservation removes own queue ticket without stopping readers. No generation cancellation, lease removal, new lock/key, tool, table, daemon, flag or config.\n\nTradeoff: continuous readers can exhaust the install's existing finite budget without mutation; this preserves current readers' availability instead of extending a waiting writer into a workspace outage. It does not promise a bounded successful install under an unbroken stream of readers. Tests must distinguish opt-in/new-reader availability from default writer preference, cover timeout cleanup and an injected acquisition race, and run maintained installer/full mutex suites. Retain R16 UNKNOWN and D004-D007 qualifications.\nRelated: P-015\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"change-kind-declared-proof-2026-10-15","title":"Agents declare what kind of change they are making; closing the item requires that kind's proof","status":"ready","created":"2026-10-15","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Agents declare what kind of change they are making; closing the item requires that kind's proof\nslug: change-kind-declared-proof-2026-10-15\nstatus: ready\ncreated: 2026-10-15\nupdated: 2026-10-22\nfrozenTests: pilot\n---\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** ⚠ BAR READINESS BLOCKED (2026-10-18, after decision-added): bar_snapshot_proof_inadequate, bar_snapshot_grading_missing, bar_snapshot_vetting_missing. Next repair: Vet the current acceptance-rubric criteria BEFORE binding proof or emitting adequacy cards (amend → vet → attest → bind → cards → grade): a vetting critique usually becomes an amendment, and proof bound first must then be re-bound.. (re-evaluated in the same write by the scope-write cascade, P-030/P-031)\n\nAPPROVED by Avi 2026-10-15 [owner-dialog session_turn:claude:882acbeb-97c3-427a-9109-b1dc33c9b9d3:8]; builder su-525713ec, holding EI-26049391397809141 and plan lane P-001. Then P-002..P-005.\n\n## Promoted\n\n<!-- plan-pipeline: do not edit this block manually -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010017143 — Close enforcement: add the `change-kind-proof` contract requirement in work_items:complete, accept `completion.kindEvidence`, and check each declared kind with the existing validators, including the … <!-- P-002 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010017144 — Stack defaults: detect the repo's stack from its manifests, name the default tool in claim receipts and refusals, and let Papercusp's serving-runtimes classes override the route. (R-3) <!-- P-003 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010017145 — Safeguards: require a reason for late or narrowed declarations, add the UI-looking-files tripwire, and add the `change-kind-mismatch` audit. (R-4) <!-- P-004 -->\n- [ ] WI-6554700010017146 — Agent instructions and live check: update tool guidance and the su persona close paragraph within the prompt-weight budget, author an agent-insights doc via docs:author, then run every kind through t… <!-- P-005 -->\n## Goal\nAn agent cannot mark a work-item done until it has produced the proof its declared change kind calls for. A UI change needs a recorded run of the real app; a service change needs a live call; and so on. It works in any repo with built-in defaults, and no user writes an adapter. Source item: EI-26049391397809141.\n\n## Product shaping\n**Audience.** Avi (owner), and every agent that closes work-items in any Papercusp harness, including Claude and Codex sessions.\n\n**Problem.** WI-6554700010010469 changed the agents-running pill and closed as done with only Vitest renders. Its own coverage listed \"header closed\" and \"header expanded\" as checked, so the agent knew it was a UI change, yet nothing made it drive the real app. GUI testing was enforced by prompt text alone. Today's only close-time UI check runs when the agent itself chooses the `verifiedHow:'live-drove-ui'` label. The `geometry-unverified` audit finds such closes only afterwards.\n\n**Outcome.** The agent states the kind(s) of change it is making, and the system trusts that statement. A successful close then has to carry the proof each declared kind requires. The requirements and the default test tool come bundled. A repo with no configuration still gets sensible enforcement.\n\n**Non-goals.**\n- Deciding the kind from changed file paths (bundler graphs, globs, per-repo selectors). Avi replaced that design on 2026-10-15.\n- Per-repo adapter files users must write.\n- Changing how discard closes (dropped, wontfix, duplicate) or record-only completions work.\n\n**Source turns.** session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:0 (asks for enforcement below the prompt). :13 (generalize beyond what \"UI\" means in this repo). :15 (bundled defaults; the agent declares the kind and the system enforces it). :20 and session_turn:claude:882acbeb-97c3-427a-9109-b1dc33c9b9d3:0 (plan first; this session builds it).\n\n**Scenarios.**\n1. An agent claims a pill-counter fix and declares `ui` + `service`. At close it cites only Vitest. The close is refused, and the message says this harness is a Tauri app and names `scripts/verify-tauri-headless.sh` plus the missing proofs: a recorded run, build containment, each named state, and one check that tells a right result from a plausible wrong one.\n2. Same agent re-runs: a headless Tauri check of closed, open and closed states with 3 running / 1 thinking, plus a live call to the roster query. The close lands done.\n3. An agent in a web-app harness nobody configured declares `ui`. The refusal names a headless browser (Playwright) as the default tool, and a recorded browser run satisfies it.\n4. An agent declares `logic` but changed `.tsx` files. The close asks for a one-line reason. With the reason it lands and is listed for later review; without it, it lands as not counted toward done.\n5. An agent declares `ui` at claim, then switches to `docs` at close. The switch needs a recorded reason.\n\n## Requirements\n\n**R-1 — The agent's declared change kinds are stored on the work-item.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"The agent supplies the kind(s) of change it is making, from a bundled catalog, and the system records and trusts that declaration.\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:15\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"After an agent declares a non-empty set of catalog change kinds on a work-item, work_items:get returns that set as the current change kinds of the item.\",\"falsifier\":\"An unknown kind or an empty changeKinds set is accepted, or work_items:get does not show the declared kinds as the current change kinds.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"tree\",\"requiredScope\":[\"checkpoint\",\"claim\",\"complete\",\"create with assign_to\",\"empty set refused\",\"unknown kind refused\"],\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"integration\",\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run change-kind-catalog.test.ts and change-kinds.integration.test.ts for catalog/storage constraints, then change-kinds.handlers.integration.test.ts against private PostgreSQL. The latter invokes the real create(assign_to), claim, checkpoint and complete handlers and reads current kinds through the real work_items:get handler after every declaration; an omitted handler call or get projection must fail the test.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/change-kind-catalog.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/change-kinds.integration.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/change-kinds.handlers.integration.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n\n**R-2 — A successful close carries the proof each declared kind requires.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Enforce verification below the prompt: the system forces the agent to produce the proof its declared change kind calls for before the item can close done.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:0\",\n      \"session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:15\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"work_items:complete refuses a successful close that lacks any proof the bundled catalog lists for a declared kind, naming each missing proof.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A ui-declared close citing only Vitest lands done; or a kind is accepted without its listed proof; or the catalog lets a ui close land without a recorded real-app run artifact that passes the live-drove-ui checks, build-containment proof, coverage of each named state, or a distinguishing check; a service close without a live call against the current build; a migration close without an apply to a disposable database; a background-job close without an isolated-runtime run; a logic close without a test run; or a no-code-change close with a non-empty filesChanged.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"background-job\",\n      \"config\",\n      \"docs\",\n      \"logic\",\n      \"migration\",\n      \"multi-kind close\",\n      \"no-code-change\",\n      \"service\",\n      \"test-only\",\n      \"ui\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"integration\",\n      \"unit\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run the behavioral per-kind table in change-kind-proof.test.ts, the real work_items:complete handler against private PostgreSQL in complete.change-kinds.integration.test.ts, and the source-wiring guard complete.change-kinds.test.ts. Then independently verify the promised every-kind request/refusal/success sequence through the real MCP surface on the current :3170 build; retain exact build and request/response evidence separately from the automated suite.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/change-kind-proof.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/complete.change-kinds.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/complete.change-kinds.integration.test.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n\n**R-3 — Defaults come bundled and pick the test tool from the repo's stack.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Bundle defaults so no user defines adapters; what counts as UI in another repo is handled without repo-specific configuration.\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:13\",\"session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:15\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"With no configuration, the claim receipt and any refusal name the headless Tauri runner for a Tauri desktop repo, a headless browser for a web-app repo, and an agent-named tool that must still produce a recorded artifact for an unrecognized stack.\",\"falsifier\":\"An unconfigured harness gets no enforcement or no named tool, a Tauri repo is pointed at a browser, or the unknown-stack path accepts a close with no recorded artifact, or a repo whose declared current-build test route names a different tool still gets the stack default.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"tree\",\"requiredScope\":[\"papercusp override\",\"tauri repo\",\"unknown stack\",\"web repo\"],\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run change-kind-stack-detect.test.ts for actual completion refusals on Tauri, web, unknown-stack and Papercusp override fixtures; run claim.test.ts, especially R3 claim receipt stack defaults, for the actual claim handler receipts. Both receipt and refusal guidance must match the stack without per-repo configuration.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/change-kind-stack-detect.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/claim.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n\n**R-4 — Picking a cheaper kind leaves a trace.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Keep trusting the agent's report cheap: declaring late or switching to a cheaper kind needs a recorded reason, and UI-looking files without a ui kind raise a non-blocking warning that is reviewed later.\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:15\",\"session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:20\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"A close with an unexplained late, narrowed or UI-mismatched change-kind declaration never counts as done.\",\"falsifier\":\"A first-at-close declaration or reasonless retry lands proposed or done instead of being refused, a reasonless narrowing or UI mismatch counts as done, or a supplied reason is missing from declaration history or the change-kind-mismatch audit.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"tree\",\"requiredScope\":[\"first declared at close: refuse the reasonless first attempt and retry\",\"mismatch audit listing with a logic-only control\",\"narrowed kinds: proposed without reason\",\"supplied reason persisted in declaration history\",\"ui-looking files without ui: proposed without reason\"],\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"integration\",\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run change-kind-proof.test.ts for the first-at-close refusal, refusal on a reasonless retry and reasoned success. Run change-kind-declaration-reason.test.ts for narrowed declarations. Run complete.change-kind-reasons.integration.test.ts against private PostgreSQL to verify reasonless narrowing/UI mismatch lands proposed and out of burn-down, supplied reasons persist and permit an otherwise valid done close, and the ordinary change-kind-mismatch audit lists reasoned closes with a logic-only control. Keep complete.change-kinds.test.ts as the source-wiring guard. Check every required scenario explicitly; wiring-only proof is insufficient. Also run complete.change-kinds.integration.test.ts: its real-handler/private-PG D-001 sequence must refuse first-at-close, refuse the reasonless retry, then land the reasoned close done.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/change-kind-proof.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/complete.change-kinds.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/complete.change-kind-reasons.integration.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/change-kind-declaration-reason.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/complete.change-kinds.integration.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n\n**R-5 — Every change-kind declaration is kept in a history that work_items:get returns.**\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"The agent supplies the kind(s) of change it is making, from a bundled catalog, and the system records and trusts that declaration.\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:15\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Every change-kind declaration on a work-item adds one entry, with its declarer, time and step, to the change-kind history that work_items:get returns.\",\"falsifier\":\"A declaration is dropped or overwritten without a history entry, or work_items:get omits the history or any entry's declarer, time or step.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"tree\",\"requiredScope\":[\"checkpoint\",\"claim\",\"complete\",\"create with assign_to\",\"history kept\"],\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"integration\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run change-kinds.integration.test.ts for declaration history storage and change-kinds.handlers.integration.test.ts against private PostgreSQL for public tool readback. Declare through the real create(assign_to), claim, checkpoint and complete handlers; after each, work_items:get must return current kinds and the complete oldest-first history with declarer, parseable timestamp, step, kinds and reason, preserving earlier entries through the final done close.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/change-kinds.integration.test.ts\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/change-kinds.handlers.integration.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n\n**R-6 — A close carrying every declared kind's proof lands done.**\n```requirement\n{\n  \"intent\": {\n    \"request\": \"Enforce verification below the prompt: the system forces the agent to produce the proof its declared change kind calls for before the item can close done.\",\n    \"sourceRefs\": [\n      \"session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:0\",\n      \"session_turn:claude:ae72b685-aaa1-48a2-b96c-f0568bef8961:15\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"acceptance\": {\n    \"condition\": \"A close that owes no change-kind reason lands as done once it carries every proof the bundled catalog lists for each declared kind.\",\n    \"falsifier\": \"A close that owes no change-kind reason and carries every proof the bundled catalog lists for each declared kind is refused or does not land done, for any single kind or for a multi-kind close.\",\n    \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n    \"requiredScope\": [\n      \"background-job\",\n      \"config\",\n      \"docs\",\n      \"logic\",\n      \"migration\",\n      \"multi-kind close\",\n      \"no-code-change\",\n      \"service\",\n      \"test-only\",\n      \"ui\"\n    ],\n    \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n      \"integration\",\n      \"unit\"\n    ]\n  },\n  \"verification\": {\n    \"method\": \"Run the behavioral per-kind table in change-kind-proof.test.ts, the real work_items:complete handler against private PostgreSQL in complete.change-kinds.integration.test.ts, and the source-wiring guard complete.change-kinds.test.ts. Then independently verify the promised every-kind request/refusal/success sequence through the real MCP surface on the current :3170 build; retain exact build and request/response evidence separately from the automated suite.\",\n    \"check\": {\n      \"kind\": \"tests\",\n      \"files\": [\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/change-kind-proof.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/complete.change-kinds.test.ts\",\n        \"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/work_items/complete.change-kinds.integration.test.ts\"\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## Design\n- **Reuse.** The close check becomes one more entry, `change-kind-proof`, in `WORK_ITEMS_COMPLETION_CONTRACT`, set through the existing `setContractRequirement` seam in `complete.ts`. Per-kind proof reuses the existing validators in `completion-audit.ts`: `isBackedLiveDroveUiClaim`, `verifyLiveDroveUiArtifacts` and the scratch-retention check for ui; `isBackedLiveServiceClaim` for service; the test-runner check for logic. The layout-file heuristic (`touchesLayoutBearingFiles`) becomes the tripwire. ui build containment reuses `verify-tauri-headless.sh`'s `VERIFY_TAURI_ASSERT_SNAPSHOT_CONTAINS` check and the verification-harness evidence directory it already retains.\n- **New surfaces.** One catalog module (kinds, per-kind proof, default tool per stack) and one migration from the allocator for declared kinds and their history. `work_items.nature` means work/record/event, so it cannot hold this.\n- **Evidence shape.** `verifiedHow` is a single label, so a multi-kind close carries `completion.kindEvidence: [{ kind, ... }]`, one entry per declared kind. A single-kind close may keep using today's root fields.\n\n### Bar-to-work map for this plan\n| bar | implementing plan items | evidence plane |\n|---|---|---|\n| R-1 | P-001 | tree |\n| R-2 | P-002, P-005 | tree |\n| R-3 | P-003 | tree |\n| R-4 | P-004 | tree |\n| R-5 | P-001 | tree |\n| R-6 | P-002, P-005 | tree |\n\n## Open choices (my defaults; Avi to confirm)\n1. **When the declaration is mandatory.** Default: it is accepted at create, claim and checkpoint, and is hard-required only at a successful close; declaring first at close needs a reason. Reason: `scheduler:get_next` and plan promotion claim an item before the agent has read it, so a hard claim-time requirement would break them.\n2. **Missing proof.** Default: the close is refused (the item stays open), matching today's `live-drove-ui` check. Alternative: it lands as proposed and does not count toward done.\n3. **Work in flight at cutover.** Default: items claimed before this ships close with a warning instead of a refusal.\n\n## Phase 1 — Declare and enforce\n- **P-001** `done` Catalog and storage: add the bundled change-kind catalog (kinds, per-kind proof, default tool per stack), a migration for declared kinds plus history, `changeKinds` on create/claim/checkpoint/complete, and the read-back on work_items:get. (R-1) — note: ← WI-6554700010014786 completed (done)\n- **P-002** `done` Close enforcement: add the `change-kind-proof` contract requirement in work_items:complete, accept `completion.kindEvidence`, and check each declared kind with the existing validators, including the ui extras (build containment, named states, distinguishing check). (R-2) — note: ← WI-6554700010017143 completed (done)\n- **P-003** `done` Stack defaults: detect the repo's stack from its manifests, name the default tool in claim receipts and refusals, and let Papercusp's serving-runtimes classes override the route. (R-3) — note: ← WI-6554700010017144 completed (done)\n- **P-004** `done` Safeguards: require a reason for late or narrowed declarations, add the UI-looking-files tripwire, and add the `change-kind-mismatch` audit. (R-4) — note: ← WI-6554700010017145 completed (done)\n\n## Phase 2 — Teach and verify\n- **P-005** `done` Agent instructions and live check: update tool guidance and the su persona close paragraph within the prompt-weight budget, author an agent-insights doc via docs:author, then run every kind through the real MCP surface on :3170. (R-2) — note: ← WI-6554700010017146 completed (done)\n\n## Decisions\n\n### D-001 — The change-kind declaration is required at a successful close, accepted earlier\nDate: 2026-10-15\n[owner:Avi 2026-10-15, owner-dialog session_turn:claude:882acbeb-97c3-427a-9109-b1dc33c9b9d3:8] Avi chose \"Required at close\". changeKinds is accepted at work_items:create (with assign_to), work_items:claim, work_items:checkpoint and work_items:complete. A successful terminal close requires a current declaration. When the first declaration arrives at close, changeKindReason is required and stored. Reason recorded with the choice: scheduler:get_next and plan promotion claim an item before the agent has read it, so a claim-time requirement would break them.\n\n### D-002 — A close missing a declared kind's proof is refused; the item stays open\nDate: 2026-10-15\n[owner:Avi 2026-10-15, owner-dialog session_turn:claude:882acbeb-97c3-427a-9109-b1dc33c9b9d3:8] Avi chose \"Refuse the close\". Same behavior as today's live-drove-ui check: the completion record is kept and returned, but the terminal state transition is refused (stateError) and the reply names each missing proof and the default tool for the repo's stack.\n\n### D-003 — Items claimed before the cutover close with a warning, not a refusal\nDate: 2026-10-15\n[owner:Avi 2026-10-15, owner-dialog session_turn:claude:882acbeb-97c3-427a-9109-b1dc33c9b9d3:8] Avi chose \"Warn only for them\". An item whose current claim began before the change-kind gate shipped, and that has no declaration, closes with a changeKindWarning instead of a refusal. The cutover instant is a code constant set to the release time of P-002. Every claim after it is enforced.\n\n### D-004 — Acceptance BAR amendment\nDate: 2026-10-15\nAmendment-Id: ckdp-atomic-bars-rev1-to-2-v2-apply\nRequest-Hash: 874e4af1df77312d8bc394dc8c41457ae94507525eea685ac7a422bc82628c9b\nActor: su-525713ec-714a-4ca8-a30e-4248231e5593\nReason: Repair after outside-lineage objection thread-post:1183286: models stay one sentence; R-1 restores non-empty (model + falsifier + requiredScope), R-2 says lands it done and lists every per-kind proof in its falsifier, R-3 restores the repo test-route override as a falsifier. R-4 unchanged from the previous preview. Agreed with peer su-f71daefd (P023 frozen-tests pilot) over coord, threads coord-send-66564696… and coord-send-f6ed0db6…. [peer:su-f71daefd + self, not an owner directive]\n\n1. P-001 is done and stays outside the pilot.\n2. P-002 (WI-6554700010017143) cannot get an honest red-first manifest: its source was written before its tests, and those tests are the implementer's (frozen-tests-gate.ts:92 refuses them as implementer lineage). P-002 closes under the existing gates BEFORE the plan frontmatter becomes frozenTests: pilot. No retroactive red-first claim is made for it.\n3. The frontmatter flip to frozenTests: pilot happens only after P-002 is done AND su-f71daefd sends an explicit ready-to-enroll. From that revision on, frozenTestsClosureRefusal requires a manifest for every remaining item's close.\n4. su-f71daefd independently authors the P-003, P-004 and P-005 manifests. The red calibration has to predate the binding's createdAt (frozen-tests-gate.ts:158).\n5. The implementer (su-525713ec) makes no P-003, P-004 or P-005 source edits until that item's manifest is registered or su-f71daefd declines the item.\n\n### D-008 — The cutover constant is a placeholder until P-002 is live, then re-pinned to the release instant; an unknown claim start warns\nDate: 2026-10-18\nDate: 2026-10-18. [self-imposed reading of D-003, not an owner directive]\n\n1. D-003 sets the cutover to \"the release time of P-002\", which is unknown until the :3070 deploy that carries P-002. A guessed instant earlier than that deploy (the previous 2026-10-18T04:00Z) would let claims taken between it and the deploy be refused by code that was not live when they were taken.\n2. So CHANGE_KIND_GATE_CUTOVER is a placeholder (2026-10-21T00:00:00.000Z) deliberately later than any realistic release, which makes the first release warn-only. Once :3070 serves P-002, the constant is re-pinned to that release instant (read from the deploy record) and shipped. That re-pin is what makes D-003 literally true. The P-005 live check on :3170 runs after the re-pin.\n3. A claim with no known start (no takenAt and no createdAt) is treated as pre-cutover: warn, never refuse.\n4. The tests derive their pre- and post-cutover fixtures from the constant, so moving it strands none of them.\n\nMeasured: packages/operator-core/lib/change-kind-proof.ts:299-301 claimPredatesChangeKindCutover returns true when the start is null; complete.ts:4991 passes existing.takenAt ?? existing.createdAt; work-items.ts:669 maps issue-family takenAt from engineer_issues.assigned_at (a view over work_items.taken_at), which claimIssue sets (issues-engineer.ts:3352) and markIssueProgress does not (issues-engineer.ts:3523 sets only last_progress_at).\n\n### D-009 — A first declaration at close with no reason is refused (P-002); 'lands as proposed' is R-4's ui-mismatch path\nDate: 2026-10-18\nDate: 2026-10-18. [self-imposed reading of owner D-001 and R-4, not an owner directive]\n\n1. D-001 [owner:Avi 2026-10-15] says that when the first declaration arrives at close, changeKindReason \"is required and stored\". R-4's condition says the same (\"first declaring at close, requires changeKindReason\"), and its falsifier is \"a late declaration needs no reason\". R-4's \"Without a reason it lands as proposed, not counted toward done\" sentence is about the ui-looking-files mismatch close.\n2. So the P-002 gate (change-kind-proof.ts) REFUSES a reasonless first-at-close declaration and names `changeKindReason`. The close-time declaration from a refused attempt is recorded, but it does not count as an earlier declaration, so a reasonless retry is refused too.\n3. The P-002 integration case that expected 'lands proposed' predated that code and had been red since 03:15Z (test_runs 21361283..21363371). It now asserts refuse / refuse-on-retry / reasoned close lands done.\n4. P-004 (R-4) owns the 'lands as proposed' behavior for the ui mismatch and any narrowing semantics. Its independent red-first tests (P023 pilot, su-f71daefd) should not assume a reasonless first-at-close declaration lands proposed; if they need that, it is a P-004 change to this gate, recorded as a new Decision.\n\n### D-010 — P-003 closes before prospective enrollment; remaining source releases require verified manifests\nDate: 2026-10-18\nAffects: spec-driven-tooling-integration-2026-10-05\nExecution ruling linked to spec-driven-tooling-integration-2026-10-05 P-023, under its existing AUTO/self pilot authority.\n\nMeasured: current plans:items has no blocked-by dependencies on P-002/P-003/P-004/P-005. P-004/WI-6554700010017145 and P-005/WI-6554700010017146 are open/unassigned. P-003 source cutoff6503e508985de4ddc67fca0c91ad3cad418ae52e at2026-10-18T04:43:11-04:00 is confirmed by source git log and actual implementer reply coord-send-b2b75de704cabd02ba7b807078697e631ae244ac74ba389e077ed47cefa49ea8; no superseding release/authorization was found.\n\nD-007 remains governing, with this chronology correction: P-003 is now a pre-enrollment exclusion. Preserve its earlier independent assertion-red evidence/test-only pins, but do not register it as retrospective pilot enforcement or claim pilot effectiveness. Both P-002 and P-003 must successfully terminal-close under current ordinary gates BEFORE frozenTests:pilot is set.\n\nP-004/P-005 retain the existing independent-author/source hold. Their work-items will carry typed blockers on one declared readiness event. The P023 author emits that event ONLY after both prior items close, explicit readiness/opt-in readback, current test-only bindings55305/55298 and their calibration are verified, and both manifests have been registered and read back. That is the source release; no source edits before it. No source rollback or duplicate implementation is requested.\n\nThese queue-visible blockers close the coordination gap left by an otherwise prose-only source hold. Candidate partial enrollment remains distinct from the parent D-020 three-plan cohort.\nRelated: P-002, P-003, P-004, P-005\n\n### D-011 — Retract untraceable manual pin 55305 from AUTO-BAR-R-4-P-004@4; its substance is preserved in the retraction reason\nDate: 2026-10-21\nDate: 2026-10-21. Its evidenceRef is free text with no durable rerun anchor ('test-run <id>'), so classifySpecEvidenceLineage rates it unknown.\n2. 55305's content is sound: test_runs 21362565 (change-kind-declaration-reason.test.ts, fail, local, clean tree, 577d230455) and 21363663 (complete.change-kind-reasons.integration.test.ts, fail, local, clean tree, 2565e1a6f1) exist and are the pre-release assertion reds it names.\n3. Its author su-f71daefd is presence-state 'recorded' (not wakeable, idle 7h31m, context critical) and did not answer the 08:0xZ re-pin request; the blocker is stranded.\n4. The D-010 source release that consumed 55305 already happened (10-18 15:00Z); this does not change the frozen test bytes or P023's manifests.\n5. Reversible: anyone in the P023 lane may rebind the pin with a 'test-run 21362565' anchor.\nRelated: P-004, D-007, D-010\n\n### D-012 — Correction to D-011: retracting 55305 broke P-004's frozen-tests anchor; repair needs a re-freeze by its author\nDate: 2026-10-21\nDate: 2026-10-21. It is also the anchor of WI-6554700010017145's frozen-tests manifest (payload._frozenTests = { revision:1, bindingId:55305, redRunIds:[21362565,21363663], frozenAt:2026-10-18T14:59:18.893Z }). frozen-tests-gate.ts freezeBinding refuses a withdrawn binding, so after the 08:44Z retraction the P-004 close at ~08:46Z on :3170 was refused with frozen_tests_binding_unavailable_or_stale. D-011's premise that the retraction lost nothing was false: its substance survives in the reason, but its gate role does not.\n2. What survives: R-4 traceability is now unblocked, and the D-011 reasoning about 55305's free-text evidenceRef still holds.\n3. Repair: the gate accepts a re-freeze only from 55305's author (su-f71daefd) or that author's lineage (registerFrozenTests: frozen_tests_only_binding_author_can_register, frozen_tests_refreeze_requires_original_author), and the implementer lineage is barred from authoring the pin. So su-f71daefd must (a) bind a NEW manual test-only pin on AUTO-BAR-R-4-P-004@4 over the same two frozen files (change-kind-declaration-reason.test.ts, complete.change-kind-reasons.integration.test.ts), with a durable anchor (structured test-run refs plus details.instrument), and (b) register it with expectedRevision:1, the same redRunIds, and a decision whose frozen-tests fence names { itemId: WI-6554700010017145, fromRevision:1, toRevision:2, previousBindingId:55305, bindingId:<new>, reason }. That fence decision is added once the new binding id exists.\n4. WI-6554700010017146's frozen anchor (55298) is live and untouched.\n5. Lesson: before retracting any manual binding, check whether a work-item payload._frozenTests.bindingId names it.\n\n### D-013 — Re-freeze P-004 and P-005 frozen tests to revision 2\nDate: 2026-10-22\n[peer:su-f71daefd] Restore the P-004 and P-005 independent frozen-test manifests to revision 2. Because the immutable clause revisions advanced, the original independent freezer author must re-freeze the unchanged test bytes once more before closure.\nRelated: P-004, P-005\n\n### D-015 — Re-freeze unchanged P-004/P-005 tests after structured falsifier clause revisions\nDate: 2026-10-22\n[peer:su-f71daefd] Re-freeze P-004 and P-005 to manifest revision 3 after the structured falsifier scenario updates. The new test-only pins 63928/63929 target AUTO-BAR-R-4-P-004@5 and SPEC-P-005@3 respectively. Original independent authorship and canonical red runs [21362565,21363663] / [21363325] are preserved. These file-set freeze pins assert no passing implementation proof or clause adequacy.\n\nMeasured: 2026-10-22 canonical staging, git status --porcelain for the three frozen test paths was empty. sha256sum: P-004 unit c2edc9e5bb1e98d48f8f057506e9124c165e51138a399b31bfb3a5466b6e3d54; P-004 integration 803fd2f85122b524449f770658dd4c448dd8045dd81a3552577662724d6cbb1e; P-005 guidance 1703723944477c50b12616569929cd88a975dc7bf4e1bd3b65ba035aa4f43e48. Each matches the revision-2 frozen bytes in D-013.\n\n```frozen-tests\n{\"itemId\":\"WI-6554700010017145\",\"fromRevision\":2,\"toRevision\":3,\"previousBindingId\":63657,\"bindingId\":63928,\"reason\":\"AUTO-BAR-R-4-P-004 advanced to revision 5 after structured falsifier scenarios; unchanged frozen test bytes and canonical red calibration re-pinned by the original independent author\"}\n```\n\n```frozen-tests\n{\"itemId\":\"WI-6554700010017146\",\"fromRevision\":2,\"toRevision\":3,\"previousBindingId\":63658,\"bindingId\":63929,\"reason\":\"SPEC-P-005 advanced to revision 3 after structured falsifier scenarios; unchanged frozen test bytes and canonical red calibration re-pinned by the original independent author\"}\n```\nRelated: P-004, P-005\n\n### D-016 — Acceptance BAR amendment\nDate: 2026-10-22\nAmendment-Id: ckdp-wholeplan-r4-outcomes-and-behavioral-checks-20261022-v3\nRequest-Hash: 378bd7efa13d161a3091e4004c6bff874a37b518e34dccc926a06d22fd7c2c6c\nActor: su-dc2412ed-9732-4888-812e-8adc9e8039c9\nReason: Independent critique thread-post:1195972 (WI-6554700010020484, eligible reviewer8257/applierdc241) found R4 contradicts owner D001/D009 first-declaration refusal, and R2/R4/R6 check.files contain only a source-wiring test. Preserve all six BAR scopes, correct the refused/proposed distinction, retain reason/history/audit, and require behavioral unit plus real-handler private-PG integration proof. No production behavior changes or evidence waiver.\nApproved-By: su-8a5cf920-6984-45c1-b9b4-7ca3cc76d0ba\nApproval-Ref: thread-post:1196045\nApproved-At: 2026-10-22T15:29:04.700Z\nRubric revision: 4 → 5\nSubject plan revision: 35 → 36\nChanged BARs: R-2, R-4, R-6\nPrior evidence, grades, vetting, author verdicts, and ship verdicts remain audit history and are revision-ineligible.\nRequirements re-rendered from the amended criterion: R-2, R-4, R-6\n\n### D-017 — Acceptance BAR amendment\nDate: 2026-10-22\nAmendment-Id: ckdp-rev5-handler-detectors-and-public-get-20261022-v1\nRequest-Hash: 29b43a63235dece458b7d9614b48b9e51c7950a5615e8ec2613fdd73cf973aca\nActor: su-dc2412ed-9732-4888-812e-8adc9e8039c9\nReason: Independent final-hash critique thread-post:1196171 found detector gaps: R1/R5 storage helpers do not prove real handler/get wiring; R3 lacks claim receipt checks; R4 lacks the existing real-handler D001 sequence. Add focused private-PG real-handler/readback suite, retain storage tests, bind existing claim.test.ts and complete.change-kinds.integration.test.ts. All six promises/scopes and frozen anchors63928/63929 are preserved; no production semantics or live-evidence obligations change.\nApproval: not required — every change is additive (R-1, R-3, R-4, R-5)\nRubric revision: 5 → 6\nSubject plan revision: 37 → 38\nChanged BARs: R-1, R-3, R-4, R-5\nPrior evidence, grades, vetting, author verdicts, and ship verdicts remain audit history and are revision-ineligible.\nRequirements re-rendered from the amended criterion: R-1, R-3, R-4, R-5\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"cupboard-customization-page-and-my-submissions-2026-10-15","title":"Cupboard & customization: a public papercusp.com/cupboard page + a \"My submissions\" view","status":"superseded","created":"2026-10-15","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Cupboard & customization: a public papercusp.com/cupboard page + a \"My submissions\" view\nslug: cupboard-customization-page-and-my-submissions-2026-10-15\nstatus: superseded\ncreated: 2026-10-15\nupdated: 2026-10-15\n---\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** ⛔ PLAN CLOSED — SUPERSEDED 2026-10-15. Nothing in this plan is actionable. Anything below this line is the last pre-superseded snapshot, kept for history: it described work that is finished or abandoned, so do not start from it. Read frontmatter `status`, not this prose, to learn whether a plan is live (stamped by plans:set-plan-status).\n\n⚠ BAR READINESS BLOCKED (2026-10-15, after item-dropped): bar_snapshot_cohort_incomplete, bar_snapshot_rubric_missing, bar_snapshot_bar_set_empty. Next repair: Repair the server-owned adoption epoch/cohort seed on the subject plan.. (re-evaluated in the same write by the scope-write cascade, P-030/P-031)\n\nDRAFT — planning only [owner:Avi 2026-10-15 [turn:self]: \"First write all of these into a plan or plans\" / \"Just write the plan or plans meanwhile\"]. 8 items across two phases: My submissions (P-001–P-004, papercusp repo) and the public /cupboard page (P-005–P-008, papercusp-public-site repo + local-authoring gaps). Findings verified 2026-10-15: no my-submissions view exists anywhere; identity commerce is built but not live (0 paid listings on the live Worker), so the page says \"(coming soon)\"; rules have no create verb; events have no local authoring path. NO code written.\n\n**Next:** none — the plan is superseded. (Pre-superseded next, no longer actionable: Owner answers Q1 (sequencing) and Q2 (execution route) in \"## Open questions\"; then run plans:audit { phase:'activation' }, activate, and plans:start.)\n\n## Product shaping\n\n**Source turn:** owner directive #1933 [owner:Avi 2026-10-15, interactive]: \"see our architecture page at papercusp.com/architecture — I want to make a similar kind of page for our cupboard+customization … 1. Do we have a place where users can see the things that they submitted to the cupboard? If not you'll need to write a plan for adding that. The user should walk away understanding how they can contribute things to the cupboard and also just make custom things locally like rules, events, tools, and identities. Is the commerce layer for identities working yet? If not we can just add a (coming soon) next to it and just explain to them how to create the rest.\"\n\n**Audience:** people evaluating or already using Papercusp who want to change how their agents behave, or share what they built.\n\n**Problem:**\n1. Nothing public explains customization and sharing. The architecture page covers the Cupboard in one card (\"Plugins & marketplace\").\n2. A publisher cannot see what they submitted. Public browse returns only `review_status='approved'`, unlisted-excluded rows (`papercusp/apps/operator-public/src/db.ts` ~L994). A pending or rejected listing is visible only by `GET /listings/:id` if you already know the id. The desktop Cupboard has kind / claim / hive filters but no \"mine\" filter. The Worker already has `listCreatorDrafts({ ownerId })` but only an operator route (`GET /admin/creator-drafts`) uses it.\n\n**Outcome:**\n- `papercusp.com/cupboard`, built in the same visual style as `/architecture`, explains two paths: **make it locally** (rules, events, tools, identities, plus themes, templates, recipes and rubrics) and **share it** (publish → review → others install → update or delist).\n- In the app's Cupboard, a **My submissions** view lists every listing and draft the user published, with its state (pending review / approved / rejected with reason / delisted) and a delist action. An agent can answer \"what have I published?\"\n- Identities are explained in full. **Paid identities are marked \"(coming soon)\".**\n\n**Non-goals:** turning on identity commerce; changing moderation policy; a public web storefront; deploying the site without the leader gate.\n\n**Scenarios:**\n- S1: A visitor reads the Tools section and asks their agent to make a tool (`meta:define-tool`). It works locally, with no Cupboard involved.\n- S2: A user publishes a rule (`cupboard:publish-rule`, which lands as pending). The publish result points to My submissions, where it shows \"Pending review\". Later it shows \"Approved\" or \"Rejected: <reason>\".\n- S3: A user asks an agent \"what have I put on the Cupboard?\" The agent calls `cupboard:my-listings` and gets the same list.\n- S4: A visitor reaches Identities and sees how to author one (`identities:create` / `blueprint:extend`) and publish it, with \"Sell it per use — coming soon\".\n\n## Verified facts the page must match (as of 2026-10-15; re-verify at P-005)\n\n- **Identity commerce is built but not live.** Done in agent-economy-flywheel-2026-08-30: per-use offer publishing (P-015), funded-activation gate (P-016), dependency-tree component split (P-019), and the hash-chained ledger, journal and reconciliation (P-040/P-042/P-043). Still open: inference metering while a priced identity runs (P-017), itemized statements (P-018), the two-peer testnet paid-identity journey (P-020), the mainnet cutover (P-039) and the owner-gated company/bank setup (P-045, needs-human). The live Worker (`cupboard.papercusp.com`) has **0** paid listings (`/listings?paid=1`). Its only offer is Papercusp's own prepaid BYOC credits. So the page says **\"(coming soon)\"**.\n- **Local authoring today:** tools via `meta:define-tool`; identities via `identities:create` / `identities:validate` / `identities:preview` or `blueprint:extend`; rules are a `rule.json` package (async = a reaction `on` an event that fires a class verb; sync = a guard or context provider at one client hook sink) in `~/.papercusp/rules/installed/<name>/`, and **no create/validate verb exists**, so users hand-write the JSON (P-008a). **Events: no local authoring path exists.** A key enters `event_key_registry` only via `registerEventKey` / `claimEventKey`, and outside the store itself those are called only from a Cupboard event install (`cupboard/install-event-io.ts`) or an identity that bundles an event package (`blueprint/package-event-key-resources.ts`). A user cannot define a new event locally without a publish/install round trip (P-008b). [verified 2026-10-15 by bounded grep over packages/operator-core/lib, packages/agent-mcp/src, apps/operator/lib, apps/operator/bin]. Rejected listings carry an operator `review_reason` on the Worker row, so My submissions can show it.\n- **Sharing:** one publish verb per kind (`cupboard:publish-{rule,event,plugin,app,template,theme,recipe,rubric,plan,goal,datatype}`, `blueprint:publish`), then `cupboard:unpublish`. Policy kinds (rules, events, blueprints/identities, apps) publish **pending** operator review; inert kinds (e.g. themes) publish approved.\n\n## Page outline (papercusp.com/cupboard)\n\nWritten for a reader who should leave knowing how to customize locally AND how to share. Same visual system as /architecture (numbered sections, a hero diagram, internals on zoom).\n\n1. **Hero — \"Make Papercusp yours.\"** One diagram of the loop: *make it locally → use it → publish → review → others install → update / delist*. Two entry doors: \"Customize your build\" and \"Share what you made\".\n2. **Two ways to customize.** Local (private to your machine, no review, instant) vs Cupboard (shared, reviewed, installable by anyone). Everything you share starts local.\n3. **What you can make** — one card per kind, each with: what it changes, \"ask your agent: …\", the verb behind it, where it lives on disk, and how to share it:\n   - **Tools** — new agent capabilities (`meta:define-tool`); share as a plugin or pack.\n   - **Identities** — who an agent is: duties, tools, rules, docs and events bundled into one portable package (`identities:create` / `blueprint:extend`, then `blueprint:publish`). **Sell an identity per use — (coming soon).**\n   - **Rules** — \"when X happens, do Y\" (async) or \"never let an agent do Z\" (sync guard / context) — `rule.json`; share with `cupboard:publish-rule`. Copy depends on P-008a.\n   - **Events** — the vocabulary rules and agents wait on; today shared via `cupboard:publish-event` or bundled inside an identity. Copy depends on P-008b.\n   - Also: themes, templates (whole apps), recipes, rubrics, plans/goals, datatypes, plugins and standalone apps.\n4. **Sharing on the Cupboard.** Publish verb per kind; which kinds go to review (rules, events, identities/blueprints, apps) vs publish instantly (themes); claiming a listing; updating and delisting.\n5. **Your submissions.** Where to watch them (the in-app My submissions view, or ask \"what have I published?\") and what each state means (draft, pending review, approved, rejected with reason, delisted).\n6. **Trust & safety.** Review, content pinning and signing, permissions you grant at install, uninstall.\n7. **What's next.** Paid identities and per-use pricing (coming soon), with no dates promised.\n\n## Open questions (owner)\n\n- **Q1: sequencing** [owner:Avi 2026-10-15 deferred: \"First write all of these into a plan or plans\" / \"Just write the plan or plans meanwhile\"]. Options presented: (a) My submissions + P-008 gaps first, page last (current blockedBy encoding: P-006 ← P-003, P-005, P-008); (b) page first with \"My submissions — coming soon\", updated later; (c) page only, submissions later. If (b) or (c) is chosen, drop P-003/P-008 from P-006's blockedBy.\n- **Q2: execution route** — not chosen yet. Nothing is implemented until the owner approves the plan and picks a route.\n\n## Design notes\n\n- Site page lives in the separate repo `papercusp-public-site/` (`/home/marsh-office/.papercusp-workspaces/clones/papercusp-public-site`): new `src/cupboard.html` plus a `build.py` route mirroring the `/architecture` block, and nav links from home and `/architecture`. Same dark theme, self-contained, no new script hosts.\n- My submissions reuses existing seams: Worker auth (`resolveGithubBearer`), `listCreatorDrafts`, the `@papercusp/sync` resolver for the desktop read, nuqs for the view selector, and `cupboard:unpublish` for delist. No new table.\n\n\n## Phase 1 — My submissions\n\n- **P-001** `dropped` Worker `GET /me/listings` (papercusp/apps/operator-public/src/routes): authenticated via `resolveGithubBearer`, returns every listing the caller's GitHub identity published in ANY review state (pending / approved / rejected + reviewer reason) and unlisted rows, plus the caller's creator drafts via the existing `listCreatorDrafts({ ownerId })`. Never leaks another publisher's non-approved rows. Vitest tests in apps/operator-public/src/__tests__ (own rows across states; foreign pending row excluded; 401 when unauthenticated). Record the decision before P-006 copy is final. — note: Moved, not abandoned (owner directive #1935): P-001..P-004 → cupboard-my-submissions-2026-10-15 P-001..P-004; P-005..P-007 → papercusp-com-cupboard-page-2026-10-15 P-001..P-003; P-008 → agent-authored-rules-events-and-authoring-gap-audit-2026-10-15 (rules P-002..P-004, events P-005..P-007).\n\n\n\n"},{"harness_slug":"papercusp","plan_slug":"disk-durable-headroom-2026-10-15","title":"Durable disk headroom: HDD cold tier, expire-by-default agent files, Postgres retention, growth-rate alarm","status":"ready","created":"2026-10-15","owner":null,"archived":false,"template_slug":null,"origin":"local","is_blender_origin":false,"content":"---\ntitle: Durable disk headroom: HDD cold tier, expire-by-default agent files, Postgres retention, growth-rate alarm\nslug: disk-durable-headroom-2026-10-15\nstatus: ready\ncreated: 2026-10-15\nupdated: 2026-10-18\n---\n\n## Now\n\n**State:** ⚠ BAR READINESS BLOCKED (2026-10-18, after decision-added): bar_snapshot_evidence_plane_unmet, bar_snapshot_work_contract_missing, bar_snapshot_proof_missing, bar_snapshot_grading_missing, bar_snapshot_proof_inadequate, bar_snapshot_vetting_stale. Next repair: Re-vet the current acceptance-rubric criteria before binding more proof or commissioning grading (amend → vet → attest → bind → cards → grade).. (re-evaluated in the same write by the scope-write cascade, P-030/P-031)\n\nAvi renewed the durable-fix/shipment directive; WI-6554700010017033 owns reconciliation under AUTO, direct route and 60-second work continuation. D-018 records the measured root placement and execution sequence. Investigation report rpt_e2dc1402-baa7-4ee6-ac64-462112d05799 was published and fully read back with owner visibility. Root was still99%/~35GiB free at the last23:57Z check; this is not remediated or shipped. Existing P008/P009 and P011 owners retain their lanes.\n\n**Next:** WI-6554700010017033: inspect the196.5GB root-resident verification-harness store and its source placement/retention writers, classify safe root bulk and implement an independent durable placement fix; reconcile P010's actual interlock before any database mutation. Preserve live peer claims and existing native evidence; do not repeat grading as a substitute for restoring physical headroom.\n\n## Product shaping\n\n**Audience.** Avi (owner) and every agent on the papercusp dev box: they all share `/` (1.9 TB NVMe) and `/mnt/data` (8 TB NVMe).\n\n**Problem.** Disk exhaustion has recurred 7 times since 2026-09-26. Each fix deleted things after the fact; nothing limits what gets created. The hourly cleanup only deletes path classes it already recognizes and stalls on ~5k special files in `/tmp`. Postgres grows ~10 GB/day with no row retention. Cold bulk (kopia repo 2.7 TB, backups, Debug/back copies) sits on the fast NVMe while ~13 TB of HDD is idle. (Measured 2026-10-15; report rpt_c1ebeabc-b49d-4700-9730-ee9f2a629c0a.)\n\n**Outcome.** Steady state: `/` ≥400 GB free, `/mnt/data` ≥2 TB free, cold tier ≥50% free. A new growth source is named within an hour and alarms fire on \"full in <7 days\", not only on low free space.\n\n**Non-goals.** Shrinking the 1.1 TB swapfile (a memory problem, needs a reboot). Deleting owner data: owner data is only ever moved, never deleted. sdb1 (old Windows leftovers) stays untouched.\n\n**Source turns.** Owner directive #1899 (session 956a3058, 2026-10-15 ~12:40Z): \"we are low on disk space … Investigate the isue and fix it durably … what is the best target we can expect to acheive … I want a real durable fix\". Owner dialog answer, turn 9 (13:11Z): emergency = \"Move to HDD\"; fix + targets (root 400+ GB, /mnt/data 2+ TB) = \"Approve; you build it\"; agent-folder expiry = \"3 days\". Owner turn 13:14Z asked to \"keep the data, format, and move the data\"; on inspection sda2 held only random bytes, and the owner dialog at 13:18Z answered \"Format it\" for sda2.\n\n**Scenarios.**\n1. An agent copies a full repo plus node_modules into scratch for a one-off check and forgets it. Three days after its last write it is deleted automatically; its `node_modules` goes after one day.\n2. An agent needs an evidence bundle for a week. It pins the bundle with an owner, a reason and an expiry, and the bundle survives until then.\n3. A new tool starts writing 20 GB/hour somewhere nobody has classified. The hourly census names it within an hour, and the growth-rate alarm fires long before the disk fills.\n4. Kopia backups and the papercusp backups live on an HDD separate from the working data, so a dead NVMe does not take the backups with it.\n\n## Requirements\n\n**R-1 — Cold tier online.**\n\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Format the idle HDD space as the cold tier\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:9\",\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:14\",\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:15\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"The idle HDD space is formatted and mounted persistently: sda2 is XFS at /mnt/cold-a and the sdb tail (sdb3) is XFS at /mnt/cold-b, both mounted from /etc/fstab by UUID with nofail, and both surviving a reboot.\",\"falsifier\":\"findmnt shows either mount missing after a reboot, or its fstab line lacks UUID= or nofail.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"live\",\"requiredScope\":[\"/etc/fstab\",\"/mnt/cold-a\",\"/mnt/cold-b\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run findmnt /mnt/cold-a /mnt/cold-b and grep both UUIDs in /etc/fstab for nofail; after the next reboot repeat findmnt.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"instrument\",\"instrumentKey\":\"storage:cold-mounts-reboot\"}}}\n```\n\n**R-2 — Cold bulk moved.**\n\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Move cold bulk to the HDD cold tier and keep the data\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:9\",\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:14\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"The kopia repo, /mnt/data/papercusp-backups and the owner Debug*/back copies live on the cold tier (moved, verified by equal entry count and byte total, source removed; owner data never deleted). Their writers and readers are repointed, and a backup run succeeds after the move.\",\"falsifier\":\"Any moved directory has an entry or byte mismatch in the move log, a source was removed without a VERIFY line, or kopia snapshot fails after cutover.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"live\",\"requiredScope\":[\"/mnt/cold-a/meta/MOVES.log\",\"/mnt/cold-b/meta/move-owner-copies.log\",\"kopia repository\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Read the move logs for VERIFY1/VERIFY2/DONE per directory; run kopia repository status and kopia snapshot list for a snapshot newer than the cutover.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"instrument\",\"instrumentKey\":\"storage:cold-bulk-cutover\"}}}\n```\n\n**R-3 — Agent files expire by default.**\n\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Agent folders are deleted 3 days after their last write\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:9\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Every agent-owned root expires entries 3 days (72 h) after their last write (owner decision). Build dirs (node_modules, Cargo target) inside them expire after 1 day [derived from the approved report design]. Unclassified agent paths under known agent parents default to expiring; owner and system paths stay on an explicit protected list.\",\"falsifier\":\"A path under a known agent parent with no class resolves to keep, or an owner root resolves to a deletable class.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"tree\",\"requiredScope\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/storage/retention-policy.ts\"],\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run packages/operator-core/lib/storage/retention-policy.test.ts. Require positive expiry controls for unclassified entries inside known agent-output parents, 72-hour agent and 24-hour build ceilings, and named top-level run output. Require positive preservation controls for credentials/keys/backups/live state in ~/.papercusp, checkout harness state outside agent roots, and wh-release-* review directories, including names containing an id or date. Interpret known agent parents using Decision D-001; never treat the whole mixed-state ~/.papercusp directory as expire-by-default. Missing class coverage or a protected path resolving to a deletable class fails this tree/unit criterion.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/storage/retention-policy.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n**R-4 — Pins.**\n\n```requirement\n{\n \"intent\": {\n  \"request\": \"Agents can pin anything they need longer\",\n  \"sourceRefs\": [\n   \"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:9\"\n  ]\n },\n \"acceptance\": {\n  \"condition\": \"An explicit pin (owner, reason, expiry) is the only way to keep an agent entry past its default. Pins are queryable, and expired pins stop protecting.\",\n  \"falsifier\": \"A pinned entry is classified deletable before its expiry, or an expired pin still protects.\",\n  \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n  \"requiredScope\": [\n   \"packages/operator-core/lib/storage/retention-pins.ts\"\n  ],\n  \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n   \"unit\"\n  ]\n },\n \"verification\": {\n  \"method\": \"Run the pin unit tests covering live, expired and listed pins.\",\n  \"check\": {\n   \"kind\": \"tests\",\n   \"files\": [\n    \"packages/operator-core/lib/storage/retention-pins.test.ts\"\n   ]\n  }\n }\n}\n```\n\n**R-5 — Size caps.**\n\n```requirement\n{\n \"intent\": {\n  \"request\": \"Agent roots have size caps\",\n  \"sourceRefs\": [\n   \"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:9\"\n  ]\n },\n \"acceptance\": {\n  \"condition\": \"Each agent root has a size cap. Over the cap, entries are evicted oldest first until it is under the cap; pinned entries are exempt and reported.\",\n  \"falsifier\": \"Eviction removes a newer entry before an older one, removes a pinned entry, or stops while still over cap.\",\n  \"evidencePlane\": \"tree\",\n  \"requiredScope\": [\n   \"packages/operator-core/lib/storage/disk-reclaim.ts\"\n  ],\n  \"requiredTestLayers\": [\n   \"unit\"\n  ]\n },\n \"verification\": {\n  \"method\": \"Run the disk-reclaim unit tests for the size-cap cases.\",\n  \"check\": {\n   \"kind\": \"tests\",\n   \"files\": [\n    \"packages/operator-core/lib/storage/disk-reclaim.test.ts\"\n   ]\n  }\n }\n}\n```\n\n**R-6 — Reclaim completes every run.**\n\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Fix it durably: the standing reclaim must finish every run\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:0\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"The standing reclaim skips sockets, fifos and device files, runs with the privilege needed inside agent roots, completes within its budget, and writes a receipt per run.\",\"falsifier\":\"A run over a tree containing sockets and fifos errors, stalls past budget, or writes no receipt.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"deployed\",\"requiredScope\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/storage/disk-reclaim.ts\"],\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"integration\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Run the maintained disk-reclaim integration suite over real sockets, FIFOs, privileged trees, holder safety, continuation and budget failures, preserving its exact source/test/runtime provenance. In addition execute the bound read-only native SQL probe over the preceding 24 hours on main-server-Precision-7865-Tower. It requires an actual start in each hourly bucket and exactly one matching terminal receipt for every non-dry run in the workspace/host scope. Each receipt must have explicit real-run identity, complete=true, policyExhausted=true, empty errors, arrays of entries/delegates without failures, and a finishedAt between start and the standing default 15-minute deadline. Missing, malformed, duplicated, orphaned, hostless, partial or unfinished evidence cannot pass. A passing fixture alone cannot establish standing-host adoption; the required deployed integration layer and native receipts are separate proof obligations. The SQL does not exercise destructive reclaim or start a new disk walk.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"probe\",\"probe\":{\"kind\":\"sql\",\"sql\":\"WITH time_bounds AS (SELECT (extract(epoch FROM now())*1000)::bigint AS until_ms,\\n(extract(epoch FROM now()-interval '24 hours')*1000)::bigint AS since_ms), activity AS (\\nSELECT action, details FROM harness_shared.audit_log, time_bounds w\\nWHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND actor='system:disk-retention'\\nAND action IN ('disk-retention:started','disk-retention:receipt')\\nAND ts BETWEEN w.since_ms AND w.until_ms\\nAND details->>'dryRun' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'\\nAND (details->>'host'='main-server-Precision-7865-Tower' OR details->>'host' IS NULL)\\n), starts AS (SELECT details FROM activity WHERE action='disk-retention:started'),\\nreceipts AS (SELECT details FROM activity WHERE action='disk-retention:receipt'),\\npopulation AS (SELECT s.details, (SELECT count(*) FROM receipts r\\nWHERE r.details->>'id'=s.details->>'id' AND r.details->>'startedAt'=s.details->>'startedAt'\\nAND r.details->>'host'=s.details->>'host') AS terminal_count\\nFROM starts s), invalid AS (\\nSELECT 1 FROM population WHERE terminal_count<>1 OR details->>'dryRun' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false' OR details->>'host' IS DISTINCT FROM 'main-server-Precision-7865-Tower'\\nUNION ALL SELECT 1 FROM receipts r WHERE\\nr.details->>'id' IS NULL OR r.details->>'startedAt' IS NULL OR r.details->>'finishedAt' IS NULL\\nOR r.details->>'dryRun' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false' OR r.details->>'complete' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' OR r.details->>'policyExhausted' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'\\nOR r.details->>'host' IS DISTINCT FROM 'main-server-Precision-7865-Tower'\\nOR jsonb_typeof(r.details->'errors') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR r.details->'errors'<>'[]'::jsonb\\nOR jsonb_typeof(r.details->'entries') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'\\nOR jsonb_typeof(r.details->'delegates') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'\\nOR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.details->'entries') e WHERE e->>'status'='failed')\\nOR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.details->'delegates') d WHERE d->>'ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true')\\nOR (r.details->>'finishedAt')::timestamptz < (r.details->>'startedAt')::timestamptz\\nOR (r.details->>'finishedAt')::timestamptz > now()\\nOR (r.details->>'finishedAt')::timestamptz > (r.details->>'startedAt')::timestamptz + interval '15 minutes'\\nOR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM starts s WHERE s.details->>'id'=r.details->>'id'\\nAND s.details->>'startedAt'=r.details->>'startedAt' AND s.details->>'host'=r.details->>'host')\\n), coverage AS (SELECT bool_and(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM starts s\\nWHERE (s.details->>'startedAt')::timestamptz >= now()-interval '24 hours'+h*interval '1 hour'\\nAND (s.details->>'startedAt')::timestamptz < now()-interval '24 hours'+(h+1)*interval '1 hour')) AS complete\\nFROM generate_series(0,23) h)\\nSELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*) FROM starts)>0 AND (SELECT complete FROM coverage)\\nAND (SELECT count(*)=count(DISTINCT details->>'id') FROM starts)\\nAND (SELECT count(*)=count(DISTINCT details->>'id') FROM receipts)\\nAND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invalid) THEN 'pass' ELSE 'unknown-or-failed' END AS verdict\",\"schemaRevision\":\"live\",\"maxRows\":1,\"allowUnscoped\":false,\"expect\":{\"path\":\"$.rows[0].verdict\",\"op\":\"eq\",\"value\":\"pass\"}}}}}\n```\n\n**R-7 — Heavy output off root.**\n\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Fix it durably: heavy build output stays off root\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:0\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Each named heavy producer places its default heavy build output on /mnt/data rather than the root filesystem.\",\"falsifier\":\"Default placement resolves under / for a cargo target or repo copy.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"tree\",\"requiredScope\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/scratch-git-clone.ts\",\"papercusp-desktop/bin/lib/claim-target-dir.sh\",\"papercusp-desktop/bin/mac-vm-launch.py\",\"scripts/agent-capacity/host-admission.ts\",\"scripts/agent-capacity/load-driver.ts\",\"scripts/agent-capacity/record-session.ts\",\"scripts/agent-capacity/session-process.ts\"],\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Execute the maintained producer suites named in check. For each Linux shared-host producer, observe the default destination on a device distinct from / and explicit root-device or symlink-to-root destinations refused or redirected before mkdir, replacement cleanup, generation reads, QEMU, or heavy writes. Cover Cargo allocator slots-enabled/disabled and explicit targets, scratch Git clones, Mac storage-trial fresh/resume destinations, and capacity copy/overlay entrypoints. Verify exact source and ledger provenance; missing producer evidence is unknown. Retained unit/fixture passes do not establish deployed adoption. Before claiming the live runtime outcome, bind actual current producer source identity and a native root-device refusal/default-destination falsifier in the serving execution route. Any default on root, root-device write admitted, unknown device admitted, or missing named producer proof fails acceptance. Dedicated guest-VM storage contracts remain distinct and unenumerated producers are not certified by these runs.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"tests\",\"files\":[\"papercusp-desktop/test/claim-target-dir.test.js\",\"packages/operator-core/lib/agent-tools/capability/git.test.ts\",\"papercusp-desktop/test/mac-vm-watchdog.test.js\",\"scripts/agent-capacity/host-admission.test.ts\",\"scripts/agent-capacity/session-process.test.ts\",\"scripts/agent-capacity/load-driver.test.ts\",\"scripts/agent-capacity/record-session.test.ts\"]}}}\n```\n\n**R-8 — Postgres retention.**\n\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Postgres retention\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:9\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"Tool-invocation, routing and telemetry tables keep 30 days via a scheduled routine. Archived transcript files move out of the database to compressed files on the cold tier. Expected about 80-100 GB back once, then roughly flat.\",\"falsifier\":\"Rows older than 30 days remain after a routine run, or archived transcript bytes stay in the database.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"live\",\"requiredScope\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/storage/table-retention.ts\"],\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Read the maintained native telemetry-retention receipt and current per-category oldest-row ages, then verify cold archive integrity and every applicable serving reader's positive cold-fallback binding. Require a completed non-dry routine receipt with all configured targets complete; measured ages at or below each table-retention target; a passing cold-archive integrity result; and an explicit containsColdFallback=true binding for every applicable serving runtime. Missing, stale, malformed, incomplete, or unbound evidence is unknown and cannot pass.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"instrument\",\"instrumentKey\":\"storage:postgres-retention-30d\"},\"replication\":\"Use the maintained storage/retention-interval-evidence adapter and rubric-instrument-registry platform rescore seam; preserve the exact source and serving-runtime identities in the results ledger.\"}}\n```\n\n**R-9 — Early warning.**\n\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Growth-rate alarm\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:9\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"An alarm fires on full in under 7 days and on floors (root <250 GB, /mnt/data <1 TB, cold <20% free). The census runs hourly and names the top growers.\",\"falsifier\":\"A synthetic 7-day-to-full trend or a floor breach produces no alarm.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"deployed\",\"requiredScope\":[\"packages/operator-core/lib/storage/storage-growth-alarm.ts\"],\"requiredTestLayers\":[\"unit\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Read the maintained native storage-growth-alarm observation and its persisted notification, then independently verify the four-volume native census, complete 24-hour hourly coverage, exact 250 GB root/1 TB data/<20% cold floors, seven-day full projection, and non-empty top-grower attribution. Require matching host/build identity, complete non-truncated per-device samples, and a notification whose payload exactly matches the recomputed native decision. Missing, stale, hostless, incomplete, or unbound receipt/alarm evidence is unknown; a persisted payload that differs from the recomputed floor/growth decision fails.\",\"check\":{\"kind\":\"instrument\",\"instrumentKey\":\"storage:disk-headroom-alarm-native\"},\"replication\":\"Use the maintained storage-growth-alarm measureNativeDiskHeadroomAlarm adapter and native audit/toast/census ledgers; preserve source build SHA, host, observation ID, and notification ID in the results ledger.\"}}\n```\n\n**R-10 — Targets held.**\n\n```requirement\n{\"intent\":{\"request\":\"Hold the best achievable target\",\"sourceRefs\":[\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:0\",\"session_turn:claude:956a3058-a3e5-440a-ba0d-68f4f36bc6ed:9\"]},\"acceptance\":{\"condition\":\"A 72 h soak holds root at or above 400 GB and /mnt/data at or above 2 TB free with every reclaim run completing. The superseded plan and stale sibling WI-10007751 are closed into this one.\",\"falsifier\":\"Any hourly df sample in the soak window is below either floor, or a reclaim receipt is incomplete.\",\"evidencePlane\":\"live\",\"requiredScope\":[\"/\",\"/mnt/data\"]},\"verification\":{\"method\":\"Read the maintained native disk census and reclaim start/receipt ledgers for the exact completed 72-hour host-scoped window. Require a real non-dry reclaim start in each hourly bucket and exactly one matching terminal receipt for every start, with no duplicate or orphan receipts; each run must finish, exhaust its policy, and have no errors or failed entries/delegates.
